report.text:
# Go total-traverse fusion and native record fast wrappers

The baseline is the complete measured Box + array-fusion + Tree/Sum working tree on compiler HEAD `62f362fbd2dc90a4ac86c0423d21a3424deaeaf4`. The snapshot preserves all tracked/untracked changes, 2,483 source files, all 207 source/binary hashes matching the previous archive, previous after-core/after-all executables, official README and a direct todo.before copy. Existing benchmark documents and the initial dirty diff are retained. New changes are compared with this frozen working tree, not HEAD. No commit or push is made.

The official 37-case Go total is 9.335966958 ms. Historical Go/C indicators are 1.063643379171× / 6.555264143569× / 4.546005242372× / 3.620462001691× (ratio of totals / arithmetic mean / median / geometric mean). This baseline retains the preceding full-suite fail-last traverse result rather than substituting its isolated diagnostic. C37 remains fixed at 8.777346938669927 ms. All 739 protected benchmark/reference files and 269 library/FFI sources retain their hashes.

## Empirical selection and compiler changes

An earlier controlled-copy probe of the actual record actions measured median decreases of 9.13% for medium records and 12.75% for large records, with zero allocations in both variants. The generated native wrapper initially exceeded Go's inlining budget (85, then 81 units). An equivalent unsigned interval test brings the actual generated public workers to cost 80 and makes them inline in their actual consumer actions. The isolated real-source smoke verifies that inlining, 198 wrapper/cold-worker comparisons and the prepared-action results 1072/1272. These worktree diagnostics use an older runtime baseline and are not substituted for the current official measurements.

The existing complete affine-record recognizer now permits a small public native fast path with a typed cold helper. Eligibility requires a self-recursive module worker with a native record result, one direct Int-field update and a constant delta of −1, 0 or 1. Field name, record size, module name and input values do not determine admission. Nested/multiple updates, other deltas, unknown calls, captured increments, unmatched recursion and helper-name collisions preserve the original generation.

The public native ABI and boxed wrapper remain unchanged. The cold helper contains the complete original emitted body. The fast interval is `0 < n && n <= 2147483647`, expressed equivalently as `uint64(n)-1 < 2147483647`. Within this interval, one final Int32 reduction preserves the original repeated modulo-32 addition, including wide native seeds and delta zero. Count zero keeps the cold body's unchanged wide value; all other out-of-range counts retain the original loop. Only a value-copy of the record parameter changes; borrowed fields/buffers and caller argument evaluation remain intact.

The traverse candidate follows the earlier isolated producer-fold probe (1214 → 474.8 ns, 8192 bytes → 0). That historical diagnostic suggested the opportunity but is not a new measurement of this implementation. Current evidence includes a real optimized-IR dump and an unchanged benchmark smoke returning 752500 with explicit activation and no intermediate array.

ArrayTraverseFold recognizes a canonical Array/Maybe traverse immediately consumed by a certified indexed integer fold. The adjacent callback must directly construct canonical Just with a total closed primitive Int payload; indexed callbacks are also supported. Captures, unknown calls, Nothing, mapper branches, custom dictionaries and uncurried/staged applications retain the original path. Each typed layer is checked, including consistent specialization of repeated type variables.

The consuming Let must have the canonical tag tests and failure branch, with its Just branch folding field zero of the same binding. An intervening Let/effect blocks the fusion. EffectPure is admitted only within an already executing effect block, preserving when computation occurs. Arguments and dictionaries are captured in their original order before any buffer read. The closed mapper executes before the fold callback for each index; source buffers are read-only. Existing integer narrowing, Number multiplication and imported-local renaming are retained. The existing arrayFold metadata and cache-v3 descriptor/absence keys are reused; no new schema is introduced.

Exactly 13 source/test/fixture files are transferred from the isolated worktrees: five compiler sources, four test files and four fixtures, including nine new files. Independent transfer checks verify all other baseline source files, including Box, array fusion and Tree/Sum. No runtime, FFI, benchmark or C reference is transferred or modified. The separate Effect.Ref and take/checksum investigations are outside this wave.

## Build, scope and correctness

The native bootstrap checks 561 TAST modules / 349,468 types: frontend 42.1 s, generation 193.2 s and Go compilation 44.6 s. All 205 final source hashes remain fixed; 208 source/binary hashes identify the measured compiler. The pre-existing PrivateSTRegions shadowing warning retains unchanged source provenance. Disk space was checked before bootstrap (13.41 GiB, above the 8 GiB minimum).

All 633 core sections are byte-identical. Seven of the 683 AppAll sections change, with unchanged headers, runtime, FFI, entry points, initialization order and timing/batching harness. The three record workers gain a fast path and typed cold helper. Nine bounded function comparisons verify three preserved preparation bodies, three original cold bodies and three unchanged native ABIs, normalizing only function names and generated package/runtime aliases. Original opaque calls, saved-action capture/replay, projection guards, fallback lookup, sums and public boxing remain in place.

Package placement changes: the medium record's getter, preparation and fast worker move to the shared package while its cold helper stays in p_root. The small record's fast worker/prepared action remain shared, with its cold helper in p_root. The large record remains in p_root. AppLibrary changes only the qualification of the medium preparation getter; registrations, labels and order are unchanged. These layout changes can influence other timings, so an unchanged action is not assumed immune to full-binary context changes.

The successful traverse changes inside its timed saved action. Its opaque input is still read on every invocation, followed by the same ordered dictionary/mapper/input captures. The intermediate array, always-Just result and consuming checksum become one loop with the same mapper and checksum arithmetic. Failure-traverse action bodies remain unchanged; Nothing-producing and unknown callbacks do not gain a new shortcut. The four directly changed measured actions are successful traverse and the three record sizes.

The main combined JS bundle passes six focused Node entries: three record-wrapper tests with 10,314 generated-Go checks and three traverse tests with 1,480 checks. The earlier isolated runs of those same tests are not counted again. Separate related suites report 12 passing entries each. Record checks include delta −1/0/1, zero/wide counts and seeds, cold fallback, name collisions, value-copy behavior and borrowed-field identity. Traverse checks include canonical/dictionary admission, evaluation order, alias mutation before buffer reading, imported locals and wide-value multiplication.

The source fixtures pass on their isolated JS-host compilers and on the final combined main native compiler. The preliminary worktrees use their older runtime; the final native manifests identify the measured main version. Record source behavior is checked in Release and Dev; its increment1→2 warm/clean cache transition and obsolete-helper removal are checked in Release. Traverse checks three ABI-preserving callback/seed/eligibility transitions in each of Release and Dev: six transitions total, with 19 observations in its initial profile and 60 in the traced unknown-callback profile. Its 21 observable logs agree between JS-host and final native-host runs. Twelve final native record phase logs are retained.

The actual record actions are rerun before and after on this wave's executables: 1,134 immutable-input observations, 108 intentional external-alias observations and 36 separate compact-record alias observations per build. These reuse proven scripts, not historical executions. They exercise Apply, the actual FFI callback conversion and forced fallback. Inputs, expected values and stdout agree byte-for-byte across builds; source, binary and artifact hashes are checked.

The actual successful-traverse action similarly passes 159 canonical Int32 observations (53 inputs, independent JavaScript Number/Int32 oracle) and a distinct 156 native int64 observations (52 inputs, BigInt oracle) per build. Its real seed is zero; general seeds and fallback callbacks belong to the compiler fixtures. It retains two preparation opaque calls and one per action. Both domains preserve identical before/after inputs, expected values and stdout. Diagnostic overlays change the supplied inputs only; production FFI and benchmark sources remain unchanged.

## Measurement incident and complete replacement

During the first 12-process measurement series, a sibling source-review script unintentionally performed quadratic work by repeatedly cleaning the remaining Go file for every function. Its Python process consumed CPU for an estimated 30–50 seconds. The exact overlap was not timestamped. The whole first series is therefore excluded, rather than selecting or correcting individual samples. Its 37 raw files remain byte-identical under campaign-contaminated, with original-to-retained path relocation and hashes documented in measurement-contamination.json. Correctness checks remain valid; those timings are not used below or in the README.

After termination of that process and confirmation that all agents had stopped computational work, the entire same 12-process AB/BA/AB campaign was repeated on the unchanged executables. Only this replacement is official. The faulty script is reconstructed from its recorded tool-call source; no original launch hash exists, so no byte-for-byte attestation of that earlier script is claimed. The corrected bounded nine-function review ran after the complete timing window. Both versions and incident metadata are retained.

## Official paired measurements

| Case | Official Go baseline (µs) | Paired before (µs) | After (µs) | Paired change | Go/C before → after |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| `foldable/traverse-maybe-1000` | 1.187042 | 1.177770 | 0.479253 | -59.308% | 27.8928× → 11.3500× |
| `record/set-small-1000` | 0.009515 | 0.009597 | 0.009175 | -4.397% | 8.5431× → 8.1674× |
| `record/set-medium-1000` | 0.019712 | 0.020101 | 0.019089 | -5.035% | 17.9068× → 17.0053× |
| `record/set-large-1000` | 0.037540 | 0.037071 | 0.032764 | -11.618% | 27.3384× → 24.1621× |

A separate post-timing check calls the actual saved actions through runtime.Apply with their original opaque inputs and checks every result. AllocsPerRun records traverse changing from 1 to 0 allocations per action; all three record actions remain at 0. It performs 1,000 iterations plus a warm-up and initial check (1,002 checks per fixed case/build), temporarily using one GOMAXPROCS as specified by AllocsPerRun. These are four repeated expected cases, not a varied-input corpus. No timing from this check replaces the campaign.

All four indicators use the same 37 Go/C pairs: primary App14 medians and AppAll23 library medians. C37 remains 8.777346938669927 ms.

| Indicator | Official baseline | Paired before | After |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Ratio of totals | 1.063643× | 1.055504× | 1.055523× |
| Arithmetic mean μ | 6.555264× | 6.496767× | 5.904443× |
| Median Q₂ | 4.546005× | 4.515829× | 4.505682× |
| Geometric mean G | 3.620462× | 3.584361× | 3.450821× |

Relative to the fresh paired baseline, arithmetic mean decreases 9.117%, median 0.225% and geometric mean 3.726%. The total ratio increases 0.00185% and is retained: Go total is 9.264520550 → 9.264692240 ms (+0.171690 µs). The four directly changed targets save 0.704258 µs; the other 33 cases together add 0.875948 µs. No overall elapsed-time improvement is claimed for this paired series.

Against the official historical baseline, total is 0.763% lower, arithmetic mean 9.928% lower, median 0.887% lower and geometric mean 4.686% lower. Most of the historical elapsed-time decrease comes from Red-Black Tree (9165.4375 → 9095.6665 µs), whose emitted core code and runtime are unchanged here. That historical movement is not attributed to these optimizations. Its paired decrease is only 0.917 µs. The largest remaining Go/C ratios are large records 24.16×, medium records 17.01×, append 12.35×, map 11.39×, Effect.Ref write 11.37× and successful traverse 11.35×.

## Retained regression, protocol and publication

The official primary string-concat result increases 9.772013 → 10.416585 µs (+6.596%) despite unchanged action/runtime/harness source. A separate six-process AB/BA/AB diagnostic reports 10.172485 → 10.391398 µs (+2.152%). It does not reproduce a rise above 5%, but does not establish the full-suite cause or dismiss its observed increase. The official 10.416585 µs remains in the four indicators, README and archive; diagnostic values never replace primary samples.

Three independent processes per build in AB/BA/AB order for each suite; three global and three local warm-ups, batches calibrated to at least 10 ms and the minimum of ten batches per process. Each official time is the median of three process minima. Release Go, GOGC=800, default GOMAXPROCS, no PGO. All other compilation, tests, profiling and computational reviews stop before the replacement series and its diagnostics. The host is not isolated. C and JS are not remeasured. All 306 replacement outputs and source/binary guards pass; the six extra diagnostic outputs and 306 excluded-series outputs are separate. Independent recomputation reproduces all four indicators from the retained official samples.

The archive includes the full dirty-baseline provenance, scoped transfers, compiler/test changes, probes with their limits, bootstrap logs, cache/source fixtures, actual-action and alias proofs, allocations, package-movement review, the excluded first series and the complete replacement, plus the separate concat diagnostic. Earlier Tree/Sum/array executions are not recounted as current validation. Only existing Go Release README cells are updated, preserving tables, references and status labels. The removed ratio catalogue remains absent. See [the JSON archive](2026-11-27-go-traverse-records.json) and var/benchmark/go-traverse-records-20261127.

+module Subject where
+
+import Prelude
+
+type Snapshot = { total :: Int, borrowed :: Array Int, stamp :: String }
+
+step :: Int -> Snapshot -> Snapshot
+step 0 snapshot = snapshot
+step remaining snapshot = step (remaining - 1) (snapshot { total = snapshot.total + 1 })
+
+normalize :: Int -> Snapshot -> Snapshot
+normalize 0 snapshot = snapshot
+normalize remaining snapshot = normalize (remaining - 1) (snapshot { total = snapshot.total + 0 })
+
+down :: Int -> Snapshot -> Snapshot
+down 0 snapshot = snapshot
+down remaining snapshot = down (remaining - 1) (snapshot { total = snapshot.total + (-1) })

module Gopurs.ArrayTraverse
  ( emit
  ) where

import Prelude

import Control.Alternative (guard)
import Data.Array as Array
import Data.Array.NonEmpty as NonEmptyArray
import Data.Maybe (Maybe(..), fromMaybe)
import Data.Tuple (Tuple(..))
import Gopurs.AdtExprs as AdtExprs
import Gopurs.ArrayTraverseTotal as ArrayTraverseTotal
import Gopurs.CallAnalysis (collectCurriedAbs, collectGoSpine, getGoSpineArgs, qualifiedTarget)
import Gopurs.CallArguments (Arguments, applyBoxed)
import Gopurs.CallArguments as CallArguments
import Gopurs.ExprAnalysis (extractFuncType, unwrapTcoExpr)
import Gopurs.ExprContext (ExprContext, ExprResult, StmtTree(..), TranslateExpr, bindParameters, childContext, flattenStmts)
import Gopurs.GoAst (rawGo, GoExpr(..), GoType(..))
import Gopurs.GoConversions (boxGoExpr)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Codegen.Tco (TcoExpr)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.CoreFn (ExprType(..), ModuleName(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.FreeVars (localId)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Syntax (BackendAccessor(GetProp), BackendSyntax(Abs, Accessor))

-- The known Array/Either and Array/Maybe instances permit a strict loop instead of building
-- intermediate arrays through generic applicative composition. PBO may expose
-- either the class method, its static dictionary accessor, or the FFI worker.
-- Every form must prove the same dictionaries; arbitrary Applicatives stay on
-- their existing traversal path.
emit :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> TcoExpr -> Array TcoExpr -> Maybe ExprResult
emit translate context nextId fn args = do
  traversal <- recognize fn args
  pure case if traversal.plan.moduleName == "Data.Maybe" then
    ArrayTraverseTotal.emit translate context nextId traversal.indexed traversal.callbackOffset traversal.args
    else Nothing of
      Just result -> result
      Nothing -> emitLoop context traversal (captureArguments translate context nextId traversal)

type ApplicativePlan =
  { moduleName :: String
  , sourceType :: ExprType
  , success :: String
  , failure :: String
  , prefix :: String
  }

type Traversal = { indexed :: Boolean, callbackOffset :: Int, args :: Array TcoExpr, plan :: ApplicativePlan }

-- These are the canonical library constructors, never inferred from a custom
-- dictionary's shape. The regular ADT emitter handles nullable Maybe layouts.
applicativePlan :: TcoExpr -> Maybe ApplicativePlan
applicativePlan dictionary
  | isNamed "Data.Either" "applicativeEither" dictionary = Just eitherPlan
  | isNamed "Data.Maybe" "applicativeMaybe" dictionary = Just maybePlan
  | otherwise = Nothing

eitherPlan :: ApplicativePlan
eitherPlan =
  { moduleName: "Data.Either"
  , sourceType: ADT "Data.Either.Either" [ "Data", "Either", "Either" ] [ Any, Any ]
  , success: "Right", failure: "Left", prefix: "traverseEither"
  }

maybePlan :: ApplicativePlan
maybePlan =
  { moduleName: "Data.Maybe"
  , sourceType: ADT "Data.Maybe.Maybe" [ "Data", "Maybe", "Maybe" ] [ Any ]
  , success: "Just", failure: "Nothing", prefix: "traverseMaybe"
  }

ffiPlan :: TcoExpr -> TcoExpr -> TcoExpr -> Maybe ApplicativePlan
ffiPlan applyFn mapFn pureFn =
  let
    matches mod suffix = isMethod "Control.Apply" "apply" mod ("apply" <> suffix) applyFn
      && isMethod "Data.Functor" "map" mod ("functor" <> suffix) mapFn
      && isMethod "Control.Applicative" "pure" mod ("applicative" <> suffix) pureFn
  in
    if matches "Data.Either" "Either" then Just eitherPlan
    else if matches "Data.Maybe" "Maybe" then Just maybePlan
    else Nothing

recognize :: TcoExpr -> Array TcoExpr -> Maybe Traversal
recognize fn args = do
  traversal <- recognizeForm fn args
  guard (Array.length traversal.args >= traversal.callbackOffset)
  guard (Array.length traversal.args <= traversal.callbackOffset + 2)
  pure traversal

recognizeForm :: TcoExpr -> Array TcoExpr -> Maybe Traversal
recognizeForm fn args = case unwrapTcoExpr fn of
  Accessor dictionary (GetProp "traverse") -> do
    guard (isNamed "Data.Traversable" "traversableArray" dictionary)
    applicative <- Array.index args 0
    plan <- applicativePlan applicative
    -- Retain the dictionary getter before the supplied arguments, just as for
    -- an ordinary method call. Reading this known field has no extra effects.
    pure { indexed: false, callbackOffset: 2, args: Array.cons dictionary args, plan }
  _ -> do
    { mbMod, name } <- qualifiedTarget fn
    if mbMod == Just (ModuleName "Data.Traversable") && name == "traverseArrayImpl" then do
      applyFn <- Array.index args 0
      mapFn <- Array.index args 1
      pureFn <- Array.index args 2
      appendFn <- Array.index args 3
      plan <- ffiPlan applyFn mapFn pureFn
      guard (isMethod "Data.Semigroup" "append" "Data.Semigroup" "semigroupArray" appendFn)
      pure { indexed: false, callbackOffset: 4, args, plan }
    else do
      let indexed = mbMod == Just (ModuleName "Data.TraversableWithIndex")
      guard (if indexed then name == "traverseWithIndexDefault" || name == "traverseWithIndex"
        else mbMod == Just (ModuleName "Data.Traversable") && name == "traverse")
      dictionary <- Array.index args 0
      applicative <- Array.index args 1
      guard (if indexed then isNamed "Data.TraversableWithIndex" "traversableWithIndexArray" dictionary
        else isNamed "Data.Traversable" "traversableArray" dictionary)
      plan <- applicativePlan applicative
      pure { indexed, callbackOffset: 2, args, plan }

isNamed :: String -> String -> TcoExpr -> Boolean
isNamed mod name expr = case qualifiedTarget expr of
  Just target -> target.mbMod == Just (ModuleName mod) && target.name == name
  Nothing -> false

isMethod :: String -> String -> String -> String -> TcoExpr -> Boolean
isMethod mod name dictMod dictName expression =
  let
    Tuple fn spine = collectGoSpine expression
    args = getGoSpineArgs spine
  in isNamed mod name fn && case args of
    [ dictionary ] -> isNamed dictMod dictName dictionary
    _ -> false

-- Dictionary getters and callback construction run at the current application
-- stage, including when the input is absent and the result is a reusable closure.
-- Only the callback position may bypass the ordinary boxed function ABI.
captureArguments :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> Traversal -> Arguments
captureArguments translate context nextId traversal =
  CallArguments.capture { prefix: traversal.plan.prefix <> "_arg_", markUsed: true }
    translateArgument nextId traversal.args
  where
  translateArgument index currentId arg =
    case if index == traversal.callbackOffset then nativeCallback translate context currentId traversal.indexed arg else Nothing of
      Just native -> native
      Nothing -> translate (childContext context Nothing) currentId arg

emitLoop :: ExprContext -> Traversal -> Arguments -> ExprResult
emitLoop { metadata, codegenStateRef, modNameStr } { indexed, callbackOffset, args, plan } captured =
  let
    argument index = fromMaybe (rawGo "nil") (Array.index captured.exprs index)
    argumentType index = fromMaybe TypeValue (Array.index captured.exprTypes index)
    hasCallback = Array.length args > callbackOffset
    hasInput = Array.length args > callbackOffset + 1
    callbackType = if hasCallback then argumentType callbackOffset else TypeValue
    callback = if hasCallback then argument callbackOffset else GoVar callbackName
    callbackResultType = case callbackType of
      TypeFunc _ resultType -> resultType
      _ -> TypeValue
    suffix = show captured.nextId
    callbackName = plan.prefix <> "_callback_" <> suffix
    inputName = plan.prefix <> "_input_" <> suffix
    valuesName = plan.prefix <> "_values_" <> suffix
    outputName = plan.prefix <> "_output_" <> suffix
    indexName = plan.prefix <> "_index_" <> suffix
    valueName = plan.prefix <> "_value_" <> suffix
    resultName = plan.prefix <> "_result_" <> suffix
    errorName = plan.prefix <> "_firstError_" <> suffix
    failedName = plan.prefix <> "_failed_" <> suffix
    input = if hasInput then argument (callbackOffset + 1) else GoVar inputName
    inputType = if hasInput then argumentType (callbackOffset + 1) else TypeValue
    source = case inputType of
      TypeNativeArray elementType -> { expr: input, elementType }
      _ ->
        { expr: rawArray input
        , elementType: TypeValue
        }
    adtModule = Just (ModuleName plan.moduleName)
    result = { expr: GoVar resultName, exprType: callbackResultType, stmts: StmtEmpty, nextId: captured.nextId }
    tag name = (AdtExprs.isTag metadata codegenStateRef modNameStr adtModule name result).expr
    payload = AdtExprs.getField metadata codegenStateRef modNameStr
      { moduleName: adtModule, ctorName: plan.success, index: 0 }
      { expr: GoVar resultName, exprType: callbackResultType, sourceType: plan.sourceType }
    prepared = AdtExprs.prepareSaturated metadata modNameStr adtModule plan.success plan.sourceType
    arrayValue = boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr (GoVar outputName) (TypeNativeArray TypeValue)
    success = AdtExprs.saturated codegenStateRef prepared { exprs: [ arrayValue ], exprTypes: [ TypeValue ] }
    boxedSuccess = boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr success.expr success.exprType
    indexExpr = GoCall (GoVar "int64") [ GoVar indexName ]
    value = boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr (GoVar valueName) source.elementType
    callbackCall = case callbackType of
      TypeFunc _ _ -> GoCall callback (if indexed then [ indexExpr, value ] else [ value ])
      _ -> applyBoxed callback
        (if indexed then [ GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Int") [ indexExpr ], value ] else [ value ])
    loop =
      [ GoAssign resultName callbackCall
      , GoIfElse (tag plan.success)
          [ GoMutate (outputName <> "[" <> indexName <> "]") (boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr payload.expr payload.exprType) ]
          [ GoIfElse (tag plan.failure)
              [ GoIfElse (GoPrefixOp "!" (GoVar failedName))
                  [ GoMutate errorName (boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr (GoVar resultName) callbackResultType)
                  , GoMutate failedName (rawGo "true")
                  ] []
              ]
              [ GoCall (GoVar "panic") [ GoString "Failed pattern match" ] ]
          ]
      ]
    -- Keep invoking the callback after Left/Nothing. The original strict map evaluates
    -- every element before sequence selects the first error.
    body =
      [ GoAssign valuesName source.expr
      , GoAssign outputName (GoCall (GoVar "make") [ rawGo "[]gopurs_runtime.Value", GoCall (GoVar "len") [ GoVar valuesName ] ])
      , GoAssign errorName (rawGo "gopurs_runtime.Value{}")
      , GoAssign failedName (rawGo "false")
      , GoForRange (indexName <> ", " <> valueName <> " := range " <> valuesName) loop
      , GoIfElse (GoVar failedName) [ GoReturn (GoVar errorName) ] []
      ]
    expression = if not hasCallback then
      GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Func2")
        [ GoFuncLit [ Tuple callbackName TypeValue, Tuple inputName TypeValue ] body boxedSuccess TypeValue ]
      else if not hasInput then
      GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Func")
        [ GoFuncLit [ Tuple inputName TypeValue ] body boxedSuccess TypeValue ]
      else GoCall (GoFuncLit [] body boxedSuccess TypeValue) []
  in
    { stmts: captured.stmts
    , expr: expression
    , exprType: TypeValue
    , nextId: captured.nextId + 1
    }
  where
  rawArray input = GoPrefixOp "*" (GoCall (rawGo "(*[]gopurs_runtime.Value)") [ GoSelector input "UnsafePtr" ])

-- This callback is consumed only by the known traversal, so it needs no boxed
-- function ABI. Adjacent lambdas are values: capturing them here preserves the
-- original evaluation stage, including when the traversal is partially applied.
-- Do not cross a let/call between lambdas: its evaluation belongs to each first
-- application. The ordinary callback path retains that behavior.
nativeCallback :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> Boolean -> TcoExpr -> Maybe ExprResult
nativeCallback translate context nextId indexed callback = case unwrapTcoExpr callback of
  Abs args body -> do
    let
      grouped = collectCurriedAbs args body
      parameterTypes = if indexed then [ TypeInt64, TypeValue ] else [ TypeValue ]
    guard (NonEmptyArray.length grouped.args == Array.length parameterTypes)
    let
      names = map (\(Tuple ident level) -> localId ident level) (NonEmptyArray.toArray grouped.args)
      params = Array.zip names parameterTypes
      bound = bindParameters params context.bound
      expectedResult = map _.fRet (extractFuncType callback)
      result = translate
        (context
          { depth = context.depth + 1
          , bound = bound
          , tcoIdent = Nothing
          , loopCtx = []
          , options = { isTail: true, inEffectBlock: false }
          , mbExpectedExprType = expectedResult
          , mbExpectedGoType = Nothing
          }) nextId grouped.body
    pure
      { stmts: StmtEmpty
      , expr: GoFuncLit params (flattenStmts result.stmts) result.expr result.exprType
      , exprType: TypeFunc parameterTypes result.exprType
      , nextId: result.nextId
      }
  _ -> Nothing

module Gopurs.BindingExprs
  ( nonRecursive
  , recursive
  ) where

import Prelude
import Data.Array as Array
import Data.Array.NonEmpty (NonEmptyArray, toArray)
import Data.Foldable (foldMap, foldl)
import Data.Map as Map
import Data.Maybe (Maybe(..), fromMaybe)
import Data.Newtype (unwrap)
import Data.Traversable (traverse)
import Data.Tuple (Tuple(..), fst, snd)
import Effect.Ref as Ref
import Effect.Unsafe (unsafePerformEffect)
import Gopurs.CallAnalysis (extractUncurriedAbs)
import Gopurs.ExprAnalysis (extractExprFuncType, functionResultAfter, getExprType, printTcoExprShape, unwrapTcoExpr)
import Gopurs.ExprContext (ExprContext, ExprResult, LocalEnv, TranslateExpr, StmtTree(..), bindParameters, childContext)
import Gopurs.GoAst (rawGo, GoExpr(..), GoType(..), goTypeToStr, sanitizeName)
import Gopurs.GoConversions (coerceGoExpr)
import Gopurs.GoTypes (exprTypeToGoType, isCompositeGoType, printExprType)
import Gopurs.GoFunctions (loopParameters)
import Gopurs.LocalWorkers as LocalWorkers
import Gopurs.ImmediateFfiEffects as ImmediateFfiEffects
import Gopurs.Printer (printGoExpr)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Codegen.Tco (TcoExpr(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.CoreFn (Ident(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.FreeVars (localId)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Syntax (BackendSyntax(Local), Level)

nonRecursive :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> Maybe Ident -> Level -> TcoExpr -> TcoExpr -> ExprResult
nonRecursive translate context nextId mbIdent lvl binding body =
  case ImmediateFfiEffects.translate translate context nextId mbIdent lvl binding body of
    Just result -> result
    Nothing -> nonRecursiveBinding translate context nextId mbIdent lvl binding body

nonRecursiveBinding :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> Maybe Ident -> Level -> TcoExpr -> TcoExpr -> ExprResult
nonRecursiveBinding translate context@{ metadata, codegenStateRef, depth, modNameStr, moduleFunctions, bound } nextId mbIdent lvl binding body =
  let
    originalName = localId mbIdent lvl
    name = originalName <> "_" <> show nextId
    expectedGoTypeFromAst = exprTypeToGoType metadata.sharedRecords metadata.pointerAdtPaths metadata.enumAdts metadata.elidedCtors modNameStr (getExprType binding)

    mbFunc = extractUncurriedAbs binding
  in
    case mbFunc of
      Just abs | Array.length abs.args > 0 ->
        let
          params = LocalWorkers.parameters context abs.args binding
          loopBound = bindParameters params bound
          resBodyMut = translate (context { depth = (depth + 1), bound = loopBound, tcoIdent = (Just name), loopCtx = [], options = { isTail: true, inEffectBlock: false }, mbExpectedExprType = Nothing, mbExpectedGoType = Nothing }) (nextId + 1) abs.body
          -- The binding is non-recursive: infer its native result before
          -- publishing the signature to callers. Only its curried wrapper
          -- crosses the Value boundary, which can otherwise copy whole lists.
          trueFRet = resBodyMut.exprType
          localModuleFunctions = Map.insert name (LocalWorkers.signature context name params trueFRet) moduleFunctions
          keepWrapper = LocalWorkers.needsWrapper originalName (Array.length params) body
          worker = LocalWorkers.emit translate context name params keepWrapper Nothing resBodyMut

          newBound = Map.insert originalName { name, goType: TypeValue } bound
          resBodyOuter = translate (context { depth = (depth + 1), moduleFunctions = localModuleFunctions, bound = newBound, tcoIdent = Nothing, mbExpectedExprType = Nothing }) resBodyMut.nextId body
        in
          { stmts: foldMap StmtLeaf (worker.declarations <> worker.assignments) <> resBodyOuter.stmts, expr: resBodyOuter.expr, exprType: resBodyOuter.exprType, nextId: resBodyOuter.nextId }

      _ ->
        let
          -- An identity continuation consumes this binding as the enclosing
          -- result. Propagate only that concrete ABI, never an unrelated
          -- parent's expectation into arbitrary let-bound computations.
          bindingExpected = case unwrapTcoExpr body of
            Local bodyIdent bodyLevel | bodyIdent == mbIdent && bodyLevel == lvl -> context.mbExpectedGoType
            _ -> Nothing
          resBinding = translate (context { depth = (depth + 1), tcoIdent = Nothing, loopCtx = [], options = { isTail: false, inEffectBlock: false }, mbExpectedExprType = Nothing, mbExpectedGoType = bindingExpected }) (nextId + 1) binding
          -- Keep a composite producer's boxed representation across the let.
          -- Native consumers adapt their own arguments; generic consumers and
          -- captured callbacks can reuse the immutable value directly.
          actualGoType = fromMaybe
            ( if expectedGoTypeFromAst == TypeValue
                || (resBinding.exprType == TypeValue && isCompositeGoType expectedGoTypeFromAst)
              then resBinding.exprType
              else expectedGoTypeFromAst
            )
            bindingExpected
          newBound = Map.insert originalName { name, goType: actualGoType } bound
          resBody = translate (context { depth = (depth + 1), bound = newBound, tcoIdent = Nothing }) resBinding.nextId body
          letStmt =
            if actualGoType == resBinding.exprType then
              StmtLeaf (GoAssign name resBinding.expr)
            else
              StmtLeaf (rawGo ("var " <> name <> " " <> goTypeToStr actualGoType <> " = " <> printGoExpr (coerceGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr resBinding.expr resBinding.exprType actualGoType)))
        in
          { stmts: resBinding.stmts <> StmtLeaf (rawGo ("// TAST (Let): " <> name <> " shape=" <> printTcoExprShape binding <> " bindingType=" <> printExprType (getExprType binding))) <> letStmt <> resBody.stmts, expr: resBody.expr, exprType: resBody.exprType, nextId: resBody.nextId }

recursive :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> TcoExpr -> Level -> NonEmptyArray (Tuple Ident TcoExpr) -> TcoExpr -> ExprResult
recursive translate context@{ metadata, depth, modNameStr, recVars, moduleFunctions } nextId (TcoExpr tcoAnalysis _) lvl bindings body =
  let
    allocated = allocateRecursive context nextId lvl (toArray bindings)
    combinedRecVars = recVars <> map (\(Tuple (Ident i) _) -> sanitizeName i) (toArray bindings)

    isLoop = (unwrap tcoAnalysis).role.isLoop
    mutRecBinds =
      if isLoop then
        traverse (\(Tuple (Ident name) val) -> map (\abs -> { ident: sanitizeName name, args: abs.args, body: abs.body, val }) (extractUncurriedAbs val)) (toArray bindings)
      else Nothing
  in
    case mutRecBinds of
      Just fns ->
        let
          -- Resolve parameters once, then publish every provisional signature
          -- before translating any body. The annotated return is provisional:
          -- bodies refine the function table in source order.
          workers = map
            ( \fn ->
                let
                  oldName = localId (Just (Ident fn.ident)) lvl
                  boundInfo = fromMaybe { name: oldName, goType: TypeValue } (Map.lookup oldName allocated.newBound)
                  newName = boundInfo.name
                  params = LocalWorkers.parameters context fn.args fn.val
                  -- The annotation flattens function-valued results into its
                  -- argument list. Only consume the worker's actual binders:
                  -- a recursive lookup may return a function still to apply.
                  expectedReturn = map (functionResultAfter (Array.length fn.args)) (extractExprFuncType (getExprType fn.val))
                  resultType = case expectedReturn of
                    Just ty -> exprTypeToGoType metadata.sharedRecords metadata.pointerAdtPaths metadata.enumAdts metadata.elidedCtors modNameStr ty
                    Nothing -> TypeValue
                in
                  { oldName, newName, params, expectedReturn, resultType, body: fn.body }
            )
            fns
          published = foldl
            (\acc worker ->
              { functions: Map.insert worker.newName (LocalWorkers.signature context worker.newName worker.params worker.resultType) acc.functions
              -- The local value is the boxed curried wrapper. Saturated calls
              -- obtain the native ABI from the separate function table.
              , bound: Map.insert worker.oldName { name: worker.newName, goType: TypeValue } acc.bound
              })
            { functions: moduleFunctions, bound: allocated.newBound }
            workers

          translatedWorkers = foldl
            ( \acc worker ->
                let
                  { oldName, newName, params } = worker
                  currentLoopCtx = [ { ident: newName, loopParams: map fst (loopParameters params), goTypes: map snd params } ]
                  -- Peer bindings keep the provisional view; only the function
                  -- table sees results inferred for earlier bodies in the group.
                  loopBound = bindParameters params published.bound
                  resBodyMut = translate (context { depth = (depth + 1), recVars = combinedRecVars, moduleFunctions = acc.moduleFunctions, bound = loopBound, tcoIdent = (Just newName), loopCtx = currentLoopCtx, options = { isTail: true, inEffectBlock: false }, mbExpectedExprType = worker.expectedReturn, mbExpectedGoType = Just worker.resultType }) acc.nextId worker.body
                  trueFRet = resBodyMut.exprType
                  keepWrapper = LocalWorkers.needsWrapper oldName (Array.length params) body
                    || Array.any (\(Tuple _ binding) -> LocalWorkers.needsWrapper oldName (Array.length params) binding) (toArray bindings)
                  emitted = LocalWorkers.emit translate (context { bound = published.bound }) newName params keepWrapper (Just worker.body) resBodyMut
                  newFunctions = Map.insert newName (LocalWorkers.signature context newName params trueFRet) acc.moduleFunctions
                  newBound2 = Map.insert oldName { name: newName, goType: TypeValue } acc.newBound
                in
                  { declarations: acc.declarations <> emitted.declarations, stmts: acc.stmts <> emitted.assignments, nextId: resBodyMut.nextId, moduleFunctions: newFunctions, newBound: newBound2 }
            )
            { declarations: [], stmts: [], nextId: allocated.nextId, moduleFunctions: published.functions, newBound: published.bound }
            workers

          resBodyOuter = translate (context { depth = (depth + 1), recVars = combinedRecVars, moduleFunctions = translatedWorkers.moduleFunctions, bound = translatedWorkers.newBound, tcoIdent = Nothing, mbExpectedExprType = Nothing }) translatedWorkers.nextId body
        in
          -- Every function in the recursive group must be in scope
          -- before emitting bodies that can refer to its peers.
          { stmts: foldMap StmtLeaf (translatedWorkers.declarations <> translatedWorkers.stmts) <> resBodyOuter.stmts, expr: resBodyOuter.expr, exprType: resBodyOuter.exprType, nextId: resBodyOuter.nextId }

      Nothing ->
        initializeRecursiveValues translate (context { recVars = combinedRecVars }) isLoop allocated (toArray bindings) body

type RecursiveAllocation =
  { newBound :: LocalEnv
  , newNames :: Array { oldName :: String, newName :: String }
  , nextId :: Int
  }

-- Reserve both local and module-wide identifiers before inspecting the group.
-- Every initializer receives the same complete set of renamed bindings.
allocateRecursive :: ExprContext -> Int -> Level -> Array (Tuple Ident TcoExpr) -> RecursiveAllocation
allocateRecursive { metadata, codegenStateRef, modNameStr, bound } nextId lvl =
  foldl
    (\acc (Tuple ident value) ->
      let
        oldName = localId (Just ident) lvl
        globalId = unsafePerformEffect do
          state <- Ref.read codegenStateRef
          Ref.modify_ (\current -> current { globalId = current.globalId + 1 }) codegenStateRef
          pure state.globalId
        newName = oldName <> "_" <> show acc.nextId <> "_" <> show globalId
        goType = exprTypeToGoType metadata.sharedRecords metadata.pointerAdtPaths metadata.enumAdts metadata.elidedCtors modNameStr (getExprType value)
      in
        { newBound: Map.insert oldName { name: newName, goType } acc.newBound
        , newNames: Array.snoc acc.newNames { oldName, newName }
        , nextId: acc.nextId + 1
        })
    { newBound: bound, newNames: [], nextId }

-- An early read must not observe Go's zero value. Initializers and the closures
-- they create read through cells; publish each pointer only after its complete
-- initializer and coercion. The enclosing body uses the initialized values.
initializeRecursiveValues :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Boolean -> RecursiveAllocation -> Array (Tuple Ident TcoExpr) -> TcoExpr -> ExprResult
initializeRecursiveValues translate context@{ codegenStateRef, modNameStr, depth } isLoop allocated bindings body =
  let
    initializingBound = foldl
      (\acc name -> Map.update (\binding -> Just (binding { name = "(*" <> name.newName <> "_cell)" })) name.oldName acc)
      allocated.newBound allocated.newNames
    initialized = foldl
      (\acc (Tuple (Tuple _ value) name) ->
        let
          valueResult = translate ((childContext context Nothing) { bound = initializingBound }) acc.nextId value
          expected = (fromMaybe { name: name.newName, goType: TypeValue } (Map.lookup name.oldName allocated.newBound)).goType
          assigned = coerceGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr valueResult.expr valueResult.exprType expected
        in
          { stmts: acc.stmts <> valueResult.stmts
              <> StmtLeaf (GoMutate name.newName assigned)
              <> StmtLeaf (GoMutate (name.newName <> "_cell") (rawGo ("&" <> name.newName)))
          , values: Array.snoc acc.values { name: name.newName, goType: expected }
          , nextId: valueResult.nextId
          })
      { stmts: StmtEmpty, values: [], nextId: allocated.nextId }
      (Array.zip bindings allocated.newNames)
    declarations = map (\value -> rawGo ("var " <> value.name <> " " <> goTypeToStr value.goType <> "\n_ = " <> value.name
      <> "\nvar " <> value.name <> "_cell *" <> goTypeToStr value.goType <> "\n_ = " <> value.name <> "_cell"
      <> "\n// FALLBACK TCO: isLoop=" <> show isLoop <> " len=" <> show (Array.length bindings))) initialized.values
    result = translate (context { depth = depth + 1, bound = allocated.newBound, tcoIdent = Nothing }) initialized.nextId body
  in
    { stmts: foldMap StmtLeaf declarations <> initialized.stmts <> result.stmts, expr: result.expr, exprType: result.exprType, nextId: result.nextId }

module Gopurs.ModuleWorkers (declaration) where

import Prelude
import Data.Array as Array
import Data.Map as Map
import Data.Maybe (Maybe(..))
import Data.Tuple (Tuple(..), fst, snd)
import Effect.Ref as Ref
import Effect.Unsafe (unsafePerformEffect)
import Gopurs.ExprAnalysis (extractExprFuncType, functionResultAfter, getExprType)
import Gopurs.ExprContext (ExprContext, TranslateExpr, bindParameters, flattenStmts)
import Gopurs.ArrayIndexedFold as ArrayIndexedFold
import Gopurs.CallAnalysis (collectGoSpine, getGoSpineArgs)
import Gopurs.GoAst (GoDecl(..), GoExpr(..), GoType(..))
import Gopurs.GoSymbol (GoReference(..), generated)
import Gopurs.GoConversions (boxGoExpr, coerceGoExpr)
import Gopurs.GoFunctions (Parameters, curriedFunction, iterationBindings, loopParameters, namedParameters)
import Gopurs.Int32Loops as Int32Loops
import Gopurs.AffineLoops as AffineLoops
import Gopurs.ArraySnoc as ArraySnoc
import Gopurs.ListFilter as ListFilter
import Gopurs.TailAddLoops as TailAddLoops
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Codegen.Tco (TcoExpr)

type Worker =
  { ident :: String
  , args :: Array String
  , body :: TcoExpr
  , val :: TcoExpr
  }

-- Use precisely the ABI published by ModuleBindings, including native record
-- projections. A self-recursive singleton gets a loop; peers in larger groups
-- remain ordinary calls. Module bodies begin with no captured local bindings.
declaration :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Boolean -> Worker -> GoDecl
declaration translate context@{ codegenStateRef, modNameStr, moduleFunctions } isSelfRecursive fn =
  let
    info = Map.lookup fn.ident moduleFunctions
    params = namedParameters fn.args (case info of
      Just signature -> signature.fArgs
      Nothing -> [])
    expectedBodyType = map (functionResultAfter (Array.length fn.args)) (extractExprFuncType (getExprType fn.val))
    loop = if isSelfRecursive then
      [ { ident: fn.ident, loopParams: map fst (loopParameters params), goTypes: map snd params } ]
      else []
    workerContext = context
      { depth = 0
      , bound = bindParameters params Map.empty
      , tcoIdent = Just fn.ident
      , loopCtx = loop
      , options = { isTail: isSelfRecursive, inEffectBlock: false }
      , mbExpectedExprType = expectedBodyType
      , mbExpectedGoType = if Array.null fn.args || resultType == TypeValue then Nothing else Just resultType
      }
    resultType = case info of
      Just signature | Array.length fn.args < Array.length signature.fArgs -> TypeValue
      Just signature -> signature.fRet
      Nothing -> TypeValue
    tailAdd = if isSelfRecursive then
      TailAddLoops.worker translate workerContext fn.ident params resultType fn.body
      else Nothing
    body boxed = case tailAdd of
      Just loopBody -> loopBody
      Nothing ->
        let
          native = case ListFilter.worker context.metadata params resultType fn.val of
            Just filtered -> Just filtered
            Nothing -> ArraySnoc.worker modNameStr fn.ident params resultType fn.body
          result = case native of
            Just lowered -> lowered
            Nothing -> translate workerContext 0 fn.body
          returning = if boxed then boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr result.expr result.exprType
            else coerceGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr result.expr result.exprType resultType
          statements = flattenStmts result.stmts <> [ GoReturn returning ]
        in if isSelfRecursive then
          AffineLoops.wrap translate workerContext (AffineLoops.globalTarget modNameStr fn.ident) params resultType fn.body
            (Int32Loops.loop fn.ident params resultType statements)
          else GoBlock (iterationBindings params <> statements)
    value = if Array.null fn.args then
      -- A zero-argument abstraction still defers its whole body until called.
      curriedFunction [ Tuple "_" TypeValue ] TypeValue
        (body true)
      else
        let
          worker = GoFunctionDecl
            { name: generated modNameStr ("Call_" <> modNameStr <> "_" <> fn.ident)
            , params: loopParameters params
            , result: resultType
            , body: body false
            }
        in
          unsafePerformEffect do
            Ref.modify_ (\state -> state { declarations = Array.snoc state.declarations worker }) codegenStateRef
            pure (case indexedWrapper translate context params fn.body of
              Just wrapper -> wrapper
              Nothing -> boxedWrapper context fn.ident params resultType)
  in
    GoCachedValue { identifier: generated modNameStr (modNameStr <> "_" <> fn.ident), expression: value, goType: TypeValue }

-- A scalar indexed fold can read either representation directly. Keep the
-- public Value wrapper on its original Value buffer instead of first copying
-- it into the native worker's array. Admission is shared with the fold emitter.
indexedWrapper :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Parameters -> TcoExpr -> Maybe GoExpr
indexedWrapper translate context params body = case params of
  [ Tuple name (TypeNativeArray TypeInt64) ] -> do
    let
      boxedContext = context { bound = bindParameters [ Tuple name TypeValue ] Map.empty }
      Tuple function spine = collectGoSpine body
    result <- ArrayIndexedFold.emit translate boxedContext 0 function (getGoSpineArgs spine)
    pure (GoCall (GoVar "gopurs_runtime.Func")
      [ GoFuncLit [ Tuple name TypeValue ] (flattenStmts result.stmts)
          (boxGoExpr context.codegenStateRef context.modNameStr result.expr result.exprType) TypeValue ])
  _ -> Nothing

-- Module wrappers group up to ten arguments; larger arities keep unary layers.
-- LocalWorkers and anonymous closures retain their own grouping policies.
boxedWrapper :: ExprContext -> String -> Parameters -> GoType -> GoExpr
boxedWrapper { codegenStateRef, modNameStr } name params resultType =
  let
    wrapperParams = map (\(Tuple param _) -> param <> "_box") params
    call = GoCall (GoRef (SymbolReference (generated modNameStr ("Call_" <> modNameStr <> "_" <> name))))
      (map (\(Tuple param ty) -> coerceGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr (GoVar (param <> "_box")) TypeValue ty) params)
    boxed = boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr call resultType
    arity = Array.length params
    wrapperName = if arity == 1 then "gopurs_runtime.Func" else "gopurs_runtime.Func" <> show arity
  in
    if arity <= 10 then
      GoCall (GoVar wrapperName) [ GoFuncLit (map (\param -> Tuple param TypeValue) wrapperParams) [] boxed TypeValue ]
    else Array.foldr
      (\param inner -> GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Func")
        [ GoFuncLit [ Tuple param TypeValue ] [] inner TypeValue ])
      boxed wrapperParams

src/Gopurs/RecordAffineLoops.purs.text:
-- Collapse pure countdown recurrences over immutable native records. The
-- complete update tree is proved before changing the number of iterations.
module Gopurs.RecordAffineLoops (wrap) where

import Prelude

import Control.Alternative (guard)
import Data.Array as Array
import Data.Array.NonEmpty as NEA
import Data.Maybe (Maybe(..))
import Data.Traversable (traverse)
import Data.Tuple (Tuple(..), fst)
import Gopurs.GoAst (GoExpr(..), GoType(..))
import Gopurs.GoFunctions (Parameters)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Codegen.Tco (TcoExpr(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.CoreFn (Literal(..), Prop(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.FreeVars (localId)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Syntax (BackendSyntax, Pair(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Syntax as Syn

data Delta = Constant Int | Remainders Int
data Change = Keep | Fields GoType (Array (Tuple String Change)) | Add Delta

type Recurrence = { counter :: String, record :: String, changes :: Change }

wrap :: (TcoExpr -> Boolean) -> Parameters -> GoType -> TcoExpr -> GoExpr -> GoExpr
wrap self params result body original = case recognize self params result body of
  Just recurrence ->
    let counter = GoVar (recurrence.counter <> "_loop")
        record = GoVar (recurrence.record <> "_loop")
        admitted = GoBinOp "&&" (GoBinOp ">" counter (integer 0))
          (GoBinOp "<=" counter (integer top))
    in GoBlock [ GoIfElse admitted [ GoReturn (emit counter record recurrence.changes) ] [], original ]
  Nothing -> original

recognize :: (TcoExpr -> Boolean) -> Parameters -> GoType -> TcoExpr -> Maybe Recurrence
recognize self params result body = do
  parameters <- case params of
    [ Tuple counter TypeInt64, Tuple record ty@(TypeRecord _) ] ->
      Just { counter, record, ty, counterFirst: true }
    [ Tuple record ty@(TypeRecord _), Tuple counter TypeInt64 ] ->
      Just { counter, record, ty, counterFirst: false }
    _ -> Nothing
  guard (parameters.counter /= parameters.record && result == parameters.ty)
  branch <- case syntax body of
    Syn.Branch branches step -> case NEA.toArray branches of
      [ Pair condition seed ] -> Just { condition, seed, step }
      _ -> Nothing
    _ -> Nothing
  guard (case syntax branch.condition of
    Syn.PrimOp (Syn.Op2 (Syn.OpIntOrd Syn.OpEq) left right) ->
      (local parameters.counter left && literal 0 right)
        || (literal 0 left && local parameters.counter right)
    _ -> false)
  guard (local parameters.record branch.seed)
  arguments <- case syntax branch.step of
    Syn.App target args | self target -> Just (NEA.toArray args)
    Syn.UncurriedApp target args | self target -> Just args
    _ -> Nothing
  Tuple nextCounter nextRecord <- case arguments of
    [ first, second ] -> Just (if parameters.counterFirst then Tuple first second else Tuple second first)
    _ -> Nothing
  guard (case syntax nextCounter of
    Syn.PrimOp (Syn.Op2 (Syn.OpIntNum Syn.OpSubtract) left right) ->
      local parameters.counter left && literal 1 right
    _ -> false)
  changes <- recordChanges parameters.counter parameters.record [] parameters.ty nextRecord
  pure { counter: parameters.counter, record: parameters.record, changes }

-- Every updated leaf reads its own previous value. Cross-field dependencies,
-- calls, effects, duplicate updates and layout changes retain the original loop.
-- Unchanged fields are copied by value, including any borrowed references.
recordChanges :: String -> String -> Array String -> GoType -> TcoExpr -> Maybe Change
recordChanges counter record path ty expression
  | recordPath record expression == Just path = Just Keep
  | otherwise = case ty, syntax expression of
      recordType@(TypeRecord fields), Syn.Update source props -> do
        guard (recordPath record source == Just path)
        let keys = map (\(Prop key _) -> key) props
        guard (Array.length (Array.nub keys) == Array.length keys)
        guard (Array.length (Array.nub (map fst fields)) == Array.length fields)
        updates <- traverse (\(Prop key value) -> do
          Tuple _ fieldType <- Array.find (\(Tuple label _) -> label == key) fields
          change <- recordChanges counter record (Array.snoc path key) fieldType value
          pure (Tuple key change)) props
        pure (Fields recordType updates)
      TypeInt64, Syn.PrimOp (Syn.Op2 (Syn.OpIntNum Syn.OpAdd) left right)
        | recordPath record left == Just path -> Add <$> increment counter right
        | recordPath record right == Just path -> Add <$> increment counter left
      _, _ -> Nothing

increment :: String -> TcoExpr -> Maybe Delta
increment counter expression = case syntax expression of
  Syn.Lit (LitInt value) | value >= bottom && value <= top -> Just (Constant value)
  Syn.PrimOp (Syn.Op2 (Syn.OpIntNum Syn.OpMod) value divisor) | local counter value -> do
    modulus <- intLiteral divisor
    guard (modulus > 0 && modulus <= top)
    pure (Remainders modulus)
  _ -> Nothing

emit :: GoExpr -> GoExpr -> Change -> GoExpr
emit counter original = case _ of
  Keep -> original
  Fields ty fields -> GoRecordUpdateNative ty original
    (map (\(Tuple key change) -> Tuple key (emit counter (GoRecordFieldAccess original key) change)) fields)
  Add delta ->
    -- At least one IntAdd executes on the admitted path. Normalize its seed
    -- first, so even noncanonical Int64 FFI inputs need no overflow assumption.
    -- n and each literal fit Int32; products and their sum fit signed Int64.
    narrow (GoBinOp "+" (narrow original) (total counter delta))

total :: GoExpr -> Delta -> GoExpr
total count = case _ of
  Constant value -> GoBinOp "*" count (integer value)
  Remainders modulus ->
    let divisor = integer modulus
        quotient = GoBinOp "/" count divisor
        remainder = GoBinOp "%" count divisor
        cycles = GoBinOp "/" (GoBinOp "*" (GoBinOp "*" quotient divisor) (integer (modulus - 1))) (integer 2)
        suffix = GoBinOp "/" (GoBinOp "*" remainder (GoBinOp "+" remainder (integer 1))) (integer 2)
    -- Sum k mod d for k=1..n: complete periods plus the final 1..remainder.
    in GoBinOp "+" cycles suffix

syntax :: TcoExpr -> BackendSyntax TcoExpr
syntax (TcoExpr _ value) = case value of
  Syn.Typed _ inner -> syntax inner
  Syn.TypeApp inner _ -> syntax inner
  _ -> value

local :: String -> TcoExpr -> Boolean
local name expression = case syntax expression of
  Syn.Local ident level -> localId ident level == name
  _ -> false

recordPath :: String -> TcoExpr -> Maybe (Array String)
recordPath root expression = case syntax expression of
  Syn.Local ident level | localId ident level == root -> Just []
  Syn.Accessor source (Syn.GetProp key) -> map (flip Array.snoc key) (recordPath root source)
  _ -> Nothing

intLiteral :: TcoExpr -> Maybe Int
intLiteral expression = case syntax expression of
  Syn.Lit (LitInt value) -> Just value
  _ -> Nothing

literal :: Int -> TcoExpr -> Boolean
literal value expression = intLiteral expression == Just value

narrow :: GoExpr -> GoExpr
narrow value = GoCall (GoVar "int64") [ GoCall (GoVar "int32") [ value ] ]

integer :: Int -> GoExpr
integer value = GoCall (GoVar "int64") [ GoInt value ]

module Gopurs.ArrayTraverse
  ( emit
  , recognizeMaybe
  ) where

import Prelude

import Control.Alternative (guard)
import Data.Array as Array
import Data.Array.NonEmpty as NonEmptyArray
import Data.Maybe (Maybe(..), fromMaybe)
import Data.Tuple (Tuple(..))
import Gopurs.AdtExprs as AdtExprs
import Gopurs.ArrayTraverseTotal as ArrayTraverseTotal
import Gopurs.CallAnalysis (collectCurriedAbs, collectGoSpine, getGoSpineArgs, qualifiedTarget)
import Gopurs.CallArguments (Arguments, applyBoxed)
import Gopurs.CallArguments as CallArguments
import Gopurs.ExprAnalysis (extractFuncType, unwrapTcoExpr)
import Gopurs.ExprContext (ExprContext, ExprResult, StmtTree(..), TranslateExpr, bindParameters, childContext, flattenStmts)
import Gopurs.GoAst (rawGo, GoExpr(..), GoType(..))
import Gopurs.GoConversions (boxGoExpr)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Codegen.Tco (TcoExpr)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.CoreFn (ExprType(..), ModuleName(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.FreeVars (localId)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Syntax (BackendAccessor(GetProp), BackendSyntax(Abs, Accessor))

-- The known Array/Either and Array/Maybe instances permit a strict loop instead of building
-- intermediate arrays through generic applicative composition. PBO may expose
-- either the class method, its static dictionary accessor, or the FFI worker.
-- Every form must prove the same dictionaries; arbitrary Applicatives stay on
-- their existing traversal path.
emit :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> TcoExpr -> Array TcoExpr -> Maybe ExprResult
emit translate context nextId fn args = do
  traversal <- recognize fn args
  pure case if traversal.plan.moduleName == "Data.Maybe" then
    ArrayTraverseTotal.emit translate context nextId traversal.indexed traversal.callbackOffset traversal.args
    else Nothing of
      Just result -> result
      Nothing -> emitLoop context traversal (captureArguments translate context nextId traversal)

type ApplicativePlan =
  { moduleName :: String
  , sourceType :: ExprType
  , success :: String
  , failure :: String
  , prefix :: String
  }

type Traversal = { indexed :: Boolean, callbackOffset :: Int, args :: Array TcoExpr, plan :: ApplicativePlan }

-- Consumers reuse the exact canonical dictionary proof, not the spelling of a
-- traversal method alone. They impose their own saturation/phase restrictions.
recognizeMaybe :: TcoExpr -> Array TcoExpr -> Maybe { indexed :: Boolean, callbackOffset :: Int, args :: Array TcoExpr }
recognizeMaybe fn args = do
  traversal <- recognize fn args
  guard (traversal.plan.moduleName == "Data.Maybe")
  pure { indexed: traversal.indexed, callbackOffset: traversal.callbackOffset, args: traversal.args }

-- These are the canonical library constructors, never inferred from a custom
-- dictionary's shape. The regular ADT emitter handles nullable Maybe layouts.
applicativePlan :: TcoExpr -> Maybe ApplicativePlan
applicativePlan dictionary
  | isNamed "Data.Either" "applicativeEither" dictionary = Just eitherPlan
  | isNamed "Data.Maybe" "applicativeMaybe" dictionary = Just maybePlan
  | otherwise = Nothing

eitherPlan :: ApplicativePlan
eitherPlan =
  { moduleName: "Data.Either"
  , sourceType: ADT "Data.Either.Either" [ "Data", "Either", "Either" ] [ Any, Any ]
  , success: "Right", failure: "Left", prefix: "traverseEither"
  }

maybePlan :: ApplicativePlan
maybePlan =
  { moduleName: "Data.Maybe"
  , sourceType: ADT "Data.Maybe.Maybe" [ "Data", "Maybe", "Maybe" ] [ Any ]
  , success: "Just", failure: "Nothing", prefix: "traverseMaybe"
  }

ffiPlan :: TcoExpr -> TcoExpr -> TcoExpr -> Maybe ApplicativePlan
ffiPlan applyFn mapFn pureFn =
  let
    matches mod suffix = isMethod "Control.Apply" "apply" mod ("apply" <> suffix) applyFn
      && isMethod "Data.Functor" "map" mod ("functor" <> suffix) mapFn
      && isMethod "Control.Applicative" "pure" mod ("applicative" <> suffix) pureFn
  in
    if matches "Data.Either" "Either" then Just eitherPlan
    else if matches "Data.Maybe" "Maybe" then Just maybePlan
    else Nothing

recognize :: TcoExpr -> Array TcoExpr -> Maybe Traversal
recognize fn args = do
  traversal <- recognizeForm fn args
  guard (Array.length traversal.args >= traversal.callbackOffset)
  guard (Array.length traversal.args <= traversal.callbackOffset + 2)
  pure traversal

recognizeForm :: TcoExpr -> Array TcoExpr -> Maybe Traversal
recognizeForm fn args = case unwrapTcoExpr fn of
  Accessor dictionary (GetProp "traverse") -> do
    guard (isNamed "Data.Traversable" "traversableArray" dictionary)
    applicative <- Array.index args 0
    plan <- applicativePlan applicative
    -- Retain the dictionary getter before the supplied arguments, just as for
    -- an ordinary method call. Reading this known field has no extra effects.
    pure { indexed: false, callbackOffset: 2, args: Array.cons dictionary args, plan }
  _ -> do
    { mbMod, name } <- qualifiedTarget fn
    if mbMod == Just (ModuleName "Data.Traversable") && name == "traverseArrayImpl" then do
      applyFn <- Array.index args 0
      mapFn <- Array.index args 1
      pureFn <- Array.index args 2
      appendFn <- Array.index args 3
      plan <- ffiPlan applyFn mapFn pureFn
      guard (isMethod "Data.Semigroup" "append" "Data.Semigroup" "semigroupArray" appendFn)
      pure { indexed: false, callbackOffset: 4, args, plan }
    else do
      let indexed = mbMod == Just (ModuleName "Data.TraversableWithIndex")
      guard (if indexed then name == "traverseWithIndexDefault" || name == "traverseWithIndex"
        else mbMod == Just (ModuleName "Data.Traversable") && name == "traverse")
      dictionary <- Array.index args 0
      applicative <- Array.index args 1
      guard (if indexed then isNamed "Data.TraversableWithIndex" "traversableWithIndexArray" dictionary
        else isNamed "Data.Traversable" "traversableArray" dictionary)
      plan <- applicativePlan applicative
      pure { indexed, callbackOffset: 2, args, plan }

isNamed :: String -> String -> TcoExpr -> Boolean
isNamed mod name expr = case qualifiedTarget expr of
  Just target -> target.mbMod == Just (ModuleName mod) && target.name == name
  Nothing -> false

isMethod :: String -> String -> String -> String -> TcoExpr -> Boolean
isMethod mod name dictMod dictName expression =
  let
    Tuple fn spine = collectGoSpine expression
    args = getGoSpineArgs spine
  in isNamed mod name fn && case args of
    [ dictionary ] -> isNamed dictMod dictName dictionary
    _ -> false

-- Dictionary getters and callback construction run at the current application
-- stage, including when the input is absent and the result is a reusable closure.
-- Only the callback position may bypass the ordinary boxed function ABI.
captureArguments :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> Traversal -> Arguments
captureArguments translate context nextId traversal =
  CallArguments.capture { prefix: traversal.plan.prefix <> "_arg_", markUsed: true }
    translateArgument nextId traversal.args
  where
  translateArgument index currentId arg =
    case if index == traversal.callbackOffset then nativeCallback translate context currentId traversal.indexed arg else Nothing of
      Just native -> native
      Nothing -> translate (childContext context Nothing) currentId arg

emitLoop :: ExprContext -> Traversal -> Arguments -> ExprResult
emitLoop { metadata, codegenStateRef, modNameStr } { indexed, callbackOffset, args, plan } captured =
  let
    argument index = fromMaybe (rawGo "nil") (Array.index captured.exprs index)
    argumentType index = fromMaybe TypeValue (Array.index captured.exprTypes index)
    hasCallback = Array.length args > callbackOffset
    hasInput = Array.length args > callbackOffset + 1
    callbackType = if hasCallback then argumentType callbackOffset else TypeValue
    callback = if hasCallback then argument callbackOffset else GoVar callbackName
    callbackResultType = case callbackType of
      TypeFunc _ resultType -> resultType
      _ -> TypeValue
    suffix = show captured.nextId
    callbackName = plan.prefix <> "_callback_" <> suffix
    inputName = plan.prefix <> "_input_" <> suffix
    valuesName = plan.prefix <> "_values_" <> suffix
    outputName = plan.prefix <> "_output_" <> suffix
    indexName = plan.prefix <> "_index_" <> suffix
    valueName = plan.prefix <> "_value_" <> suffix
    resultName = plan.prefix <> "_result_" <> suffix
    errorName = plan.prefix <> "_firstError_" <> suffix
    failedName = plan.prefix <> "_failed_" <> suffix
    input = if hasInput then argument (callbackOffset + 1) else GoVar inputName
    inputType = if hasInput then argumentType (callbackOffset + 1) else TypeValue
    source = case inputType of
      TypeNativeArray elementType -> { expr: input, elementType }
      _ ->
        { expr: rawArray input
        , elementType: TypeValue
        }
    adtModule = Just (ModuleName plan.moduleName)
    result = { expr: GoVar resultName, exprType: callbackResultType, stmts: StmtEmpty, nextId: captured.nextId }
    tag name = (AdtExprs.isTag metadata codegenStateRef modNameStr adtModule name result).expr
    payload = AdtExprs.getField metadata codegenStateRef modNameStr
      { moduleName: adtModule, ctorName: plan.success, index: 0 }
      { expr: GoVar resultName, exprType: callbackResultType, sourceType: plan.sourceType }
    prepared = AdtExprs.prepareSaturated metadata modNameStr adtModule plan.success plan.sourceType
    arrayValue = boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr (GoVar outputName) (TypeNativeArray TypeValue)
    success = AdtExprs.saturated codegenStateRef prepared { exprs: [ arrayValue ], exprTypes: [ TypeValue ] }
    boxedSuccess = boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr success.expr success.exprType
    indexExpr = GoCall (GoVar "int64") [ GoVar indexName ]
    value = boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr (GoVar valueName) source.elementType
    callbackCall = case callbackType of
      TypeFunc _ _ -> GoCall callback (if indexed then [ indexExpr, value ] else [ value ])
      _ -> applyBoxed callback
        (if indexed then [ GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Int") [ indexExpr ], value ] else [ value ])
    loop =
      [ GoAssign resultName callbackCall
      , GoIfElse (tag plan.success)
          [ GoMutate (outputName <> "[" <> indexName <> "]") (boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr payload.expr payload.exprType) ]
          [ GoIfElse (tag plan.failure)
              [ GoIfElse (GoPrefixOp "!" (GoVar failedName))
                  [ GoMutate errorName (boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr (GoVar resultName) callbackResultType)
                  , GoMutate failedName (rawGo "true")
                  ] []
              ]
              [ GoCall (GoVar "panic") [ GoString "Failed pattern match" ] ]
          ]
      ]
    -- Keep invoking the callback after Left/Nothing. The original strict map evaluates
    -- every element before sequence selects the first error.
    body =
      [ GoAssign valuesName source.expr
      , GoAssign outputName (GoCall (GoVar "make") [ rawGo "[]gopurs_runtime.Value", GoCall (GoVar "len") [ GoVar valuesName ] ])
      , GoAssign errorName (rawGo "gopurs_runtime.Value{}")
      , GoAssign failedName (rawGo "false")
      , GoForRange (indexName <> ", " <> valueName <> " := range " <> valuesName) loop
      , GoIfElse (GoVar failedName) [ GoReturn (GoVar errorName) ] []
      ]
    expression = if not hasCallback then
      GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Func2")
        [ GoFuncLit [ Tuple callbackName TypeValue, Tuple inputName TypeValue ] body boxedSuccess TypeValue ]
      else if not hasInput then
      GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Func")
        [ GoFuncLit [ Tuple inputName TypeValue ] body boxedSuccess TypeValue ]
      else GoCall (GoFuncLit [] body boxedSuccess TypeValue) []
  in
    { stmts: captured.stmts
    , expr: expression
    , exprType: TypeValue
    , nextId: captured.nextId + 1
    }
  where
  rawArray input = GoPrefixOp "*" (GoCall (rawGo "(*[]gopurs_runtime.Value)") [ GoSelector input "UnsafePtr" ])

-- This callback is consumed only by the known traversal, so it needs no boxed
-- function ABI. Adjacent lambdas are values: capturing them here preserves the
-- original evaluation stage, including when the traversal is partially applied.
-- Do not cross a let/call between lambdas: its evaluation belongs to each first
-- application. The ordinary callback path retains that behavior.
nativeCallback :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> Boolean -> TcoExpr -> Maybe ExprResult
nativeCallback translate context nextId indexed callback = case unwrapTcoExpr callback of
  Abs args body -> do
    let
      grouped = collectCurriedAbs args body
      parameterTypes = if indexed then [ TypeInt64, TypeValue ] else [ TypeValue ]
    guard (NonEmptyArray.length grouped.args == Array.length parameterTypes)
    let
      names = map (\(Tuple ident level) -> localId ident level) (NonEmptyArray.toArray grouped.args)
      params = Array.zip names parameterTypes
      bound = bindParameters params context.bound
      expectedResult = map _.fRet (extractFuncType callback)
      result = translate
        (context
          { depth = context.depth + 1
          , bound = bound
          , tcoIdent = Nothing
          , loopCtx = []
          , options = { isTail: true, inEffectBlock: false }
          , mbExpectedExprType = expectedResult
          , mbExpectedGoType = Nothing
          }) nextId grouped.body
    pure
      { stmts: StmtEmpty
      , expr: GoFuncLit params (flattenStmts result.stmts) result.expr result.exprType
      , exprType: TypeFunc parameterTypes result.exprType
      , nextId: result.nextId
      }
  _ -> Nothing
