module Gopurs.ArrayTraverseFold (emit, justMapper) where

import Prelude

import Control.Alternative (guard)
import Control.Monad.State (evalState)
import Data.Array as Array
import Data.Array.NonEmpty as NEA
import Data.Foldable (foldM)
import Data.Map as Map
import Data.Maybe (Maybe(..), fromMaybe, isJust)
import Data.Newtype (unwrap)
import Data.String as String
import Data.String.Pattern (Pattern(..), Replacement(..))
import Data.Tuple (Tuple(..))
import Gopurs.ArrayIntrinsics.Source (arraySource)
import Gopurs.ArrayProducerFold (onlyCurried)
import Gopurs.ArrayTraverse (recognizeMaybe)
import Gopurs.ArrayTraverseTotal (totalIntegerMaybe)
import Gopurs.CallAnalysis (collectCurriedAbs, collectGoSpine, getGoSpineArgs, qualifiedTarget)
import Gopurs.CallArguments as CallArguments
import Gopurs.ClosedIndexedFolds (closedPrimitiveCallback, validDescriptor)
import Gopurs.CodegenState (ArrayFoldDescriptor)
import Gopurs.ExprAnalysis (extractFuncType, unwrapTcoExpr)
import Gopurs.ExprContext (ExprContext, ExprResult, StmtTree(..), TranslateExpr, bindParameters, childContext, flattenStmts)
import Gopurs.GoAst (GoExpr(..), GoType(..), rawGo)
import Gopurs.GoConversions (coerceGoExpr)
import Gopurs.ImmediateApplications.Scope (freshen, maximumLevel)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Codegen.Tco (TcoExpr(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Codegen.Tco as Tco
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.CoreFn (ExprType(..), Ident(..), ModuleName(..), ProperName(..), Qualified(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.CoreFn as CoreFn
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.FreeVars (localId)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Semantics (NeutralExpr(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Syntax (BackendAccessor(..), BackendOperator(..), BackendOperator1(..), BackendSyntax(..), Level, Pair(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Syntax as Syntax

maybeInt :: ExprType
maybeInt = ADT "Data.Maybe.Maybe" [ "Data", "Maybe", "Maybe" ] [ Int ]

-- The callback must construct Just directly. Its payload is then checked by
-- the existing closed scalar proof, including every nested Typed annotation.
-- Nothing/branches/captures/foreign calls retain the ordinary traversal.
justMapper :: Int -> TcoExpr -> Maybe NeutralExpr
justMapper arity callback = do
  signature <- extractFuncType callback
  guard (signature.fArgs == Array.replicate arity Int && signature.fRet == maybeInt)
  case unwrapTcoExpr callback of
    Abs parameters body -> do
      let grouped = collectCurriedAbs parameters body
      guard (NEA.length grouped.args == arity && totalIntegerMaybe (map (\(Tuple _ level) -> level) (NEA.toArray grouped.args)) grouped.body)
    _ -> Nothing
  mapped <- convert arity callback
  guard (closedPrimitiveCallback arity mapped)
  pure mapped
  where
  convert remaining value = do
    guard (annotated (Func (Array.replicate remaining Int) maybeInt) value)
    case unwrapTcoExpr value of
      Abs parameters body -> do
        let count = NEA.length parameters
        guard (count <= remaining)
        scalar <- if count < remaining then convert (remaining - count) body else do
          guard (annotated maybeInt body)
          case unwrapTcoExpr body of
            CtorSaturated (Qualified (Just (ModuleName "Data.Maybe")) (Ident "Just")) _ (ProperName "Maybe") (Ident "Just") [ Tuple _ payload ] ->
              pure (neutral payload)
            _ -> Nothing
        pure (NeutralExpr (Typed (Func (Array.replicate remaining Int) Int) (NeutralExpr (Abs parameters scalar))))
      _ -> Nothing

-- TAST can retain generic m (t b) around a canonical traversal. Refine those
-- transparent applications against the proved result, but reject any concrete
-- contradiction, including nested Maybe String under an outer Maybe Int.
annotated :: ExprType -> TcoExpr -> Boolean
annotated expected (TcoExpr _ syntax) = case syntax of
  Typed actual value -> compatible expected actual && annotated expected value
  Syntax.TypeApp value _ -> annotated expected value
  _ -> true

compatible :: ExprType -> ExprType -> Boolean
compatible expected actual = isJust (refine expected actual Map.empty)

refine :: ExprType -> ExprType -> Map.Map String ExprType -> Maybe (Map.Map String ExprType)
refine expected actual variables = case expected, actual of
  _, Any -> Just variables
  _, TypeVar name -> bindVariable name expected variables
  Array wanted, Array supplied -> refine wanted supplied variables
  Array wanted, ADT "Prim.Array" [ "Prim", "Array" ] [ supplied ] -> refine wanted supplied variables
  Array wanted, CoreFn.TypeApp (TypeVar name) [ supplied ] -> do
    known <- bindVariable name (ADT "Prim.Array" [ "Prim", "Array" ] []) variables
    refine wanted supplied known
  ADT name path arguments, ADT suppliedName suppliedPath suppliedArguments -> do
    guard (name == suppliedName && path == suppliedPath)
    sameArguments arguments suppliedArguments variables
  ADT name path [ wanted ], CoreFn.TypeApp (TypeVar variable) [ supplied ] -> do
    known <- bindVariable variable (ADT name path []) variables
    refine wanted supplied known
  Func arguments result, Func suppliedArguments suppliedResult -> do
    known <- sameArguments arguments suppliedArguments variables
    refine result suppliedResult known
  _, _ | expected == actual -> Just variables
  _, _ -> Nothing
  where
  sameArguments wanted supplied known = do
    guard (Array.length wanted == Array.length supplied)
    foldM (\current (Tuple left right) -> refine left right current) known (Array.zip wanted supplied)
  bindVariable name value known = case Map.lookup name known of
    Just previous | previous /= value -> Nothing
    _ -> Just (Map.insert name value known)

emit :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> Maybe Ident -> Level -> TcoExpr -> TcoExpr -> Maybe ExprResult
emit translate context nextId mbIdent level producer continuation = do
  guard (Array.null context.recVars && onlyCurried producer)
  let Tuple function spine = collectGoSpine producer
  -- Start with direct class-method forms. FFI methods may contain their own
  -- application stages and are not flattened by this fusion.
  guard (directTraversal function)
  traversal <- recognizeMaybe function (getGoSpineArgs spine)
  guard (Array.length traversal.args == traversal.callbackOffset + 2)
  callback <- Array.index traversal.args traversal.callbackOffset
  input <- Array.index traversal.args (traversal.callbackOffset + 1)
  guard (annotated (Array Int) input)
  guard (annotated (ADT "Data.Maybe.Maybe" [ "Data", "Maybe", "Maybe" ] [ Array Int ]) producer)
  mapper <- justMapper (if traversal.indexed then 2 else 1) callback
  branch <- case unwrapTcoExpr continuation of
    EffectPure value -> do
      -- Do not move traversal work into or out of a deferred effect value.
      guard context.options.inEffectBlock
      guard (annotated (ADT "Effect.Effect" [ "Effect", "Effect" ] [ Int ]) continuation)
      pure value
    _ -> pure continuation
  descriptor <- consumedArray context level branch
  let whole = NeutralExpr (Let mbIdent level (neutral producer) (neutral continuation))
  pure (emitLoop translate context nextId traversal mapper descriptor (maximumLevel whole))

directTraversal :: TcoExpr -> Boolean
directTraversal function = case unwrapTcoExpr function of
  Accessor _ (GetProp "traverse") -> true
  _ -> case qualifiedTarget function of
    Just { mbMod: Just (ModuleName "Data.Traversable"), name: "traverse" } -> true
    Just { mbMod: Just (ModuleName "Data.TraversableWithIndex"), name } -> name == "traverseWithIndex" || name == "traverseWithIndexDefault"
    _ -> false

consumedArray :: ExprContext -> Level -> TcoExpr -> Maybe ArrayFoldDescriptor
consumedArray context level expression = do
  guard (annotated Int expression)
  success <- case unwrapTcoExpr expression of
    Branch branches otherwise -> do
      guard (case unwrapTcoExpr otherwise of
        Fail _ -> true
        _ -> false)
      case NEA.toArray branches of
        [ Pair first firstResult, Pair second secondResult ]
          | tagged "Nothing" first && tagged "Just" second -> Just secondResult
          | tagged "Just" first && tagged "Nothing" second -> Just firstResult
        _ -> Nothing
    _ -> Nothing
  guard (annotated Int success && onlyCurried success)
  let Tuple fn spine = collectGoSpine success
  guard (annotated (Func [ Array Int ] Int) fn)
  case getGoSpineArgs spine of
    [ value ] -> do
      guard (annotated (Array Int) value)
      guard (case unwrapTcoExpr value of
        Accessor object (GetCtorField (Qualified (Just (ModuleName "Data.Maybe")) (Ident "Just")) _ (ProperName "Maybe") (Ident "Just") _ 0) -> sameLocal object
        _ -> false)
    _ -> Nothing
  target <- qualifiedTarget fn
  let local = target.mbMod == Nothing || map (String.replaceAll (Pattern ".") (Replacement "_") <<< unwrap) target.mbMod == Just context.modNameStr
  info <- if local then Map.lookup target.name context.moduleFunctions else do
    owner <- target.mbMod
    Map.lookup (unwrap owner <> "." <> target.name) context.metadata.globalFunctions
  guard (info.arity == 1 && info.fArgs == [ TypeNativeArray TypeInt64 ] && info.fRet == TypeInt64)
  descriptor <- info.arrayFold
  guard (validDescriptor descriptor)
  pure descriptor
  where
  sameLocal object = annotated (ADT "Data.Maybe.Maybe" [ "Data", "Maybe", "Maybe" ] [ Array Int ]) object
    && case unwrapTcoExpr object of
      Local _ actual -> actual == level
      _ -> false
  tagged tag condition = annotated Boolean condition && case unwrapTcoExpr condition of
    PrimOp (Op1 (OpIsTag (Qualified (Just (ModuleName "Data.Maybe")) (Ident name))) object) -> name == tag && sameLocal object
    _ -> false

emitLoop :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> { indexed :: Boolean, callbackOffset :: Int, args :: Array TcoExpr } -> NeutralExpr -> ArrayFoldDescriptor -> Int -> ExprResult
emitLoop translate context nextId traversal mapper descriptor lastLevel =
  let
    start = max lastLevel (maximumLevel descriptor.callback) + nextId + 1
    folded = Tco.analyze [] (evalState (freshen descriptor.callback) start)
    mapped = Tco.analyze [] mapper
    native currentId callback = case unwrapTcoExpr callback of
      Abs parameters callbackBody ->
        let
          grouped = collectCurriedAbs parameters callbackBody
          params = map (\(Tuple name level) -> Tuple (localId name level) TypeInt64) (NEA.toArray grouped.args)
          callbackContext = context { depth = context.depth + 1, bound = bindParameters params context.bound
            , tcoIdent = Nothing, loopCtx = [], options = { isTail: true, inEffectBlock: false }
            , mbExpectedExprType = Just Int, mbExpectedGoType = Just TypeInt64 }
          result = translate callbackContext currentId grouped.body
        in { expr: GoFuncLit params (flattenStmts result.stmts) (integer result.expr result.exprType) TypeInt64, nextId: result.nextId }
      _ -> { expr: rawGo "nil", nextId: currentId }
    captured = CallArguments.capture { prefix: "traverseFold_arg_", markUsed: true }
      (\position currentId argument -> if position == traversal.callbackOffset then
        { stmts: StmtEmpty, expr: rawGo "true", exprType: TypeBool, nextId: currentId }
        else translate (childContext context Nothing) currentId argument) nextId traversal.args
    mapResult = native captured.nextId mapped
    foldResult = native mapResult.nextId folded
    suffix = show foldResult.nextId
    variable label = "traverseFold_" <> label <> "_" <> suffix
    arg position = fromMaybe (rawGo "nil") (Array.index captured.exprs position)
    source = arraySource (case arg (traversal.callbackOffset + 1) of
      GoVar name -> name
      _ -> "") (variable "source") (fromMaybe TypeValue (Array.index captured.exprTypes (traversal.callbackOffset + 1)))
    index = GoCall (GoVar "int64") [ GoVar (variable "index") ]
    value = integer (GoVar (variable "value")) source.elementType
    mappedValue = GoCall (GoVar (variable "map")) (if traversal.indexed then [ index, value ] else [ value ])
    body =
      [ GoAssign (variable "map") mapResult.expr, GoAssign (variable "fold") foldResult.expr
      , GoAssign (variable "result") (GoCall (GoVar "int64") [ GoInt descriptor.seed ])
      , source.assignment
      , GoForRange (variable "index" <> ", " <> variable "value" <> " := range " <> source.target)
          [ GoMutate (variable "result") (GoCall (GoVar (variable "fold")) [ index, GoVar (variable "result"), mappedValue ]) ]
      ]
  in { stmts: captured.stmts, expr: GoCall (GoFuncLit [] body (GoVar (variable "result")) TypeInt64) []
     , exprType: TypeInt64, nextId: foldResult.nextId + 1 }
  where
  integer value from = coerceGoExpr context.codegenStateRef context.modNameStr value from TypeInt64

neutral :: TcoExpr -> NeutralExpr
neutral (TcoExpr _ syntax) = NeutralExpr (map neutral syntax)

module Gopurs.BindingExprs
  ( nonRecursive
  , recursive
  ) where

import Prelude
import Data.Array as Array
import Data.Array.NonEmpty (NonEmptyArray, toArray)
import Data.Foldable (foldMap, foldl)
import Data.Map as Map
import Data.Maybe (Maybe(..), fromMaybe)
import Data.Newtype (unwrap)
import Data.Traversable (traverse)
import Data.Tuple (Tuple(..), fst, snd)
import Effect.Ref as Ref
import Effect.Unsafe (unsafePerformEffect)
import Gopurs.CallAnalysis (extractUncurriedAbs)
import Gopurs.ExprAnalysis (extractExprFuncType, functionResultAfter, getExprType, printTcoExprShape, unwrapTcoExpr)
import Gopurs.ExprContext (ExprContext, ExprResult, LocalEnv, TranslateExpr, StmtTree(..), bindParameters, childContext)
import Gopurs.GoAst (rawGo, GoExpr(..), GoType(..), goTypeToStr, sanitizeName)
import Gopurs.GoConversions (coerceGoExpr)
import Gopurs.GoTypes (exprTypeToGoType, isCompositeGoType, printExprType)
import Gopurs.GoFunctions (loopParameters)
import Gopurs.LocalWorkers as LocalWorkers
import Gopurs.ImmediateFfiEffects as ImmediateFfiEffects
import Gopurs.ArrayTraverseFold as ArrayTraverseFold
import Gopurs.Printer (printGoExpr)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Codegen.Tco (TcoExpr(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.CoreFn (Ident(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.FreeVars (localId)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Syntax (BackendSyntax(Local), Level)

nonRecursive :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> Maybe Ident -> Level -> TcoExpr -> TcoExpr -> ExprResult
nonRecursive translate context nextId mbIdent lvl binding body =
  case ArrayTraverseFold.emit translate context nextId mbIdent lvl binding body of
    Just result -> result
    Nothing -> case ImmediateFfiEffects.translate translate context nextId mbIdent lvl binding body of
      Just result -> result
      Nothing -> nonRecursiveBinding translate context nextId mbIdent lvl binding body

nonRecursiveBinding :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> Maybe Ident -> Level -> TcoExpr -> TcoExpr -> ExprResult
nonRecursiveBinding translate context@{ metadata, codegenStateRef, depth, modNameStr, moduleFunctions, bound } nextId mbIdent lvl binding body =
  let
    originalName = localId mbIdent lvl
    name = originalName <> "_" <> show nextId
    expectedGoTypeFromAst = exprTypeToGoType metadata.sharedRecords metadata.pointerAdtPaths metadata.enumAdts metadata.elidedCtors modNameStr (getExprType binding)

    mbFunc = extractUncurriedAbs binding
  in
    case mbFunc of
      Just abs | Array.length abs.args > 0 ->
        let
          params = LocalWorkers.parameters context abs.args binding
          loopBound = bindParameters params bound
          resBodyMut = translate (context { depth = (depth + 1), bound = loopBound, tcoIdent = (Just name), loopCtx = [], options = { isTail: true, inEffectBlock: false }, mbExpectedExprType = Nothing, mbExpectedGoType = Nothing }) (nextId + 1) abs.body
          -- The binding is non-recursive: infer its native result before
          -- publishing the signature to callers. Only its curried wrapper
          -- crosses the Value boundary, which can otherwise copy whole lists.
          trueFRet = resBodyMut.exprType
          localModuleFunctions = Map.insert name (LocalWorkers.signature context name params trueFRet) moduleFunctions
          keepWrapper = LocalWorkers.needsWrapper originalName (Array.length params) body
          worker = LocalWorkers.emit translate context name params keepWrapper Nothing resBodyMut

          newBound = Map.insert originalName { name, goType: TypeValue } bound
          resBodyOuter = translate (context { depth = (depth + 1), moduleFunctions = localModuleFunctions, bound = newBound, tcoIdent = Nothing, mbExpectedExprType = Nothing }) resBodyMut.nextId body
        in
          { stmts: foldMap StmtLeaf (worker.declarations <> worker.assignments) <> resBodyOuter.stmts, expr: resBodyOuter.expr, exprType: resBodyOuter.exprType, nextId: resBodyOuter.nextId }

      _ ->
        let
          -- An identity continuation consumes this binding as the enclosing
          -- result. Propagate only that concrete ABI, never an unrelated
          -- parent's expectation into arbitrary let-bound computations.
          bindingExpected = case unwrapTcoExpr body of
            Local bodyIdent bodyLevel | bodyIdent == mbIdent && bodyLevel == lvl -> context.mbExpectedGoType
            _ -> Nothing
          resBinding = translate (context { depth = (depth + 1), tcoIdent = Nothing, loopCtx = [], options = { isTail: false, inEffectBlock: false }, mbExpectedExprType = Nothing, mbExpectedGoType = bindingExpected }) (nextId + 1) binding
          -- Keep a composite producer's boxed representation across the let.
          -- Native consumers adapt their own arguments; generic consumers and
          -- captured callbacks can reuse the immutable value directly.
          actualGoType = fromMaybe
            ( if expectedGoTypeFromAst == TypeValue
                || (resBinding.exprType == TypeValue && isCompositeGoType expectedGoTypeFromAst)
              then resBinding.exprType
              else expectedGoTypeFromAst
            )
            bindingExpected
          newBound = Map.insert originalName { name, goType: actualGoType } bound
          resBody = translate (context { depth = (depth + 1), bound = newBound, tcoIdent = Nothing }) resBinding.nextId body
          letStmt =
            if actualGoType == resBinding.exprType then
              StmtLeaf (GoAssign name resBinding.expr)
            else
              StmtLeaf (rawGo ("var " <> name <> " " <> goTypeToStr actualGoType <> " = " <> printGoExpr (coerceGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr resBinding.expr resBinding.exprType actualGoType)))
        in
          { stmts: resBinding.stmts <> StmtLeaf (rawGo ("// TAST (Let): " <> name <> " shape=" <> printTcoExprShape binding <> " bindingType=" <> printExprType (getExprType binding))) <> letStmt <> resBody.stmts, expr: resBody.expr, exprType: resBody.exprType, nextId: resBody.nextId }

recursive :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> TcoExpr -> Level -> NonEmptyArray (Tuple Ident TcoExpr) -> TcoExpr -> ExprResult
recursive translate context@{ metadata, depth, modNameStr, recVars, moduleFunctions } nextId (TcoExpr tcoAnalysis _) lvl bindings body =
  let
    allocated = allocateRecursive context nextId lvl (toArray bindings)
    combinedRecVars = recVars <> map (\(Tuple (Ident i) _) -> sanitizeName i) (toArray bindings)

    isLoop = (unwrap tcoAnalysis).role.isLoop
    mutRecBinds =
      if isLoop then
        traverse (\(Tuple (Ident name) val) -> map (\abs -> { ident: sanitizeName name, args: abs.args, body: abs.body, val }) (extractUncurriedAbs val)) (toArray bindings)
      else Nothing
  in
    case mutRecBinds of
      Just fns ->
        let
          -- Resolve parameters once, then publish every provisional signature
          -- before translating any body. The annotated return is provisional:
          -- bodies refine the function table in source order.
          workers = map
            ( \fn ->
                let
                  oldName = localId (Just (Ident fn.ident)) lvl
                  boundInfo = fromMaybe { name: oldName, goType: TypeValue } (Map.lookup oldName allocated.newBound)
                  newName = boundInfo.name
                  params = LocalWorkers.parameters context fn.args fn.val
                  -- The annotation flattens function-valued results into its
                  -- argument list. Only consume the worker's actual binders:
                  -- a recursive lookup may return a function still to apply.
                  expectedReturn = map (functionResultAfter (Array.length fn.args)) (extractExprFuncType (getExprType fn.val))
                  resultType = case expectedReturn of
                    Just ty -> exprTypeToGoType metadata.sharedRecords metadata.pointerAdtPaths metadata.enumAdts metadata.elidedCtors modNameStr ty
                    Nothing -> TypeValue
                in
                  { oldName, newName, params, expectedReturn, resultType, body: fn.body }
            )
            fns
          published = foldl
            (\acc worker ->
              { functions: Map.insert worker.newName (LocalWorkers.signature context worker.newName worker.params worker.resultType) acc.functions
              -- The local value is the boxed curried wrapper. Saturated calls
              -- obtain the native ABI from the separate function table.
              , bound: Map.insert worker.oldName { name: worker.newName, goType: TypeValue } acc.bound
              })
            { functions: moduleFunctions, bound: allocated.newBound }
            workers

          translatedWorkers = foldl
            ( \acc worker ->
                let
                  { oldName, newName, params } = worker
                  currentLoopCtx = [ { ident: newName, loopParams: map fst (loopParameters params), goTypes: map snd params } ]
                  -- Peer bindings keep the provisional view; only the function
                  -- table sees results inferred for earlier bodies in the group.
                  loopBound = bindParameters params published.bound
                  resBodyMut = translate (context { depth = (depth + 1), recVars = combinedRecVars, moduleFunctions = acc.moduleFunctions, bound = loopBound, tcoIdent = (Just newName), loopCtx = currentLoopCtx, options = { isTail: true, inEffectBlock: false }, mbExpectedExprType = worker.expectedReturn, mbExpectedGoType = Just worker.resultType }) acc.nextId worker.body
                  trueFRet = resBodyMut.exprType
                  keepWrapper = LocalWorkers.needsWrapper oldName (Array.length params) body
                    || Array.any (\(Tuple _ binding) -> LocalWorkers.needsWrapper oldName (Array.length params) binding) (toArray bindings)
                  emitted = LocalWorkers.emit translate (context { bound = published.bound }) newName params keepWrapper (Just worker.body) resBodyMut
                  newFunctions = Map.insert newName (LocalWorkers.signature context newName params trueFRet) acc.moduleFunctions
                  newBound2 = Map.insert oldName { name: newName, goType: TypeValue } acc.newBound
                in
                  { declarations: acc.declarations <> emitted.declarations, stmts: acc.stmts <> emitted.assignments, nextId: resBodyMut.nextId, moduleFunctions: newFunctions, newBound: newBound2 }
            )
            { declarations: [], stmts: [], nextId: allocated.nextId, moduleFunctions: published.functions, newBound: published.bound }
            workers

          resBodyOuter = translate (context { depth = (depth + 1), recVars = combinedRecVars, moduleFunctions = translatedWorkers.moduleFunctions, bound = translatedWorkers.newBound, tcoIdent = Nothing, mbExpectedExprType = Nothing }) translatedWorkers.nextId body
        in
          -- Every function in the recursive group must be in scope
          -- before emitting bodies that can refer to its peers.
          { stmts: foldMap StmtLeaf (translatedWorkers.declarations <> translatedWorkers.stmts) <> resBodyOuter.stmts, expr: resBodyOuter.expr, exprType: resBodyOuter.exprType, nextId: resBodyOuter.nextId }

      Nothing ->
        initializeRecursiveValues translate (context { recVars = combinedRecVars }) isLoop allocated (toArray bindings) body

type RecursiveAllocation =
  { newBound :: LocalEnv
  , newNames :: Array { oldName :: String, newName :: String }
  , nextId :: Int
  }

-- Reserve both local and module-wide identifiers before inspecting the group.
-- Every initializer receives the same complete set of renamed bindings.
allocateRecursive :: ExprContext -> Int -> Level -> Array (Tuple Ident TcoExpr) -> RecursiveAllocation
allocateRecursive { metadata, codegenStateRef, modNameStr, bound } nextId lvl =
  foldl
    (\acc (Tuple ident value) ->
      let
        oldName = localId (Just ident) lvl
        globalId = unsafePerformEffect do
          state <- Ref.read codegenStateRef
          Ref.modify_ (\current -> current { globalId = current.globalId + 1 }) codegenStateRef
          pure state.globalId
        newName = oldName <> "_" <> show acc.nextId <> "_" <> show globalId
        goType = exprTypeToGoType metadata.sharedRecords metadata.pointerAdtPaths metadata.enumAdts metadata.elidedCtors modNameStr (getExprType value)
      in
        { newBound: Map.insert oldName { name: newName, goType } acc.newBound
        , newNames: Array.snoc acc.newNames { oldName, newName }
        , nextId: acc.nextId + 1
        })
    { newBound: bound, newNames: [], nextId }

-- An early read must not observe Go's zero value. Initializers and the closures
-- they create read through cells; publish each pointer only after its complete
-- initializer and coercion. The enclosing body uses the initialized values.
initializeRecursiveValues :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Boolean -> RecursiveAllocation -> Array (Tuple Ident TcoExpr) -> TcoExpr -> ExprResult
initializeRecursiveValues translate context@{ codegenStateRef, modNameStr, depth } isLoop allocated bindings body =
  let
    initializingBound = foldl
      (\acc name -> Map.update (\binding -> Just (binding { name = "(*" <> name.newName <> "_cell)" })) name.oldName acc)
      allocated.newBound allocated.newNames
    initialized = foldl
      (\acc (Tuple (Tuple _ value) name) ->
        let
          valueResult = translate ((childContext context Nothing) { bound = initializingBound }) acc.nextId value
          expected = (fromMaybe { name: name.newName, goType: TypeValue } (Map.lookup name.oldName allocated.newBound)).goType
          assigned = coerceGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr valueResult.expr valueResult.exprType expected
        in
          { stmts: acc.stmts <> valueResult.stmts
              <> StmtLeaf (GoMutate name.newName assigned)
              <> StmtLeaf (GoMutate (name.newName <> "_cell") (rawGo ("&" <> name.newName)))
          , values: Array.snoc acc.values { name: name.newName, goType: expected }
          , nextId: valueResult.nextId
          })
      { stmts: StmtEmpty, values: [], nextId: allocated.nextId }
      (Array.zip bindings allocated.newNames)
    declarations = map (\value -> rawGo ("var " <> value.name <> " " <> goTypeToStr value.goType <> "\n_ = " <> value.name
      <> "\nvar " <> value.name <> "_cell *" <> goTypeToStr value.goType <> "\n_ = " <> value.name <> "_cell"
      <> "\n// FALLBACK TCO: isLoop=" <> show isLoop <> " len=" <> show (Array.length bindings))) initialized.values
    result = translate (context { depth = depth + 1, bound = allocated.newBound, tcoIdent = Nothing }) initialized.nextId body
  in
    { stmts: foldMap StmtLeaf declarations <> initialized.stmts <> result.stmts, expr: result.expr, exprType: result.exprType, nextId: result.nextId }

module Gopurs.ModuleWorkers (declaration) where

import Prelude
import Data.Array as Array
import Data.Foldable (any)
import Data.Map as Map
import Data.Maybe (Maybe(..))
import Data.Tuple (Tuple(..), fst, snd)
import Effect.Ref as Ref
import Effect.Unsafe (unsafePerformEffect)
import Gopurs.ExprAnalysis (extractExprFuncType, functionResultAfter, getExprType)
import Gopurs.ExprContext (ExprContext, TranslateExpr, bindParameters, flattenStmts)
import Gopurs.ArrayIndexedFold as ArrayIndexedFold
import Gopurs.CallAnalysis (collectGoSpine, getGoSpineArgs)
import Gopurs.GoAst (GoDecl(..), GoExpr(..), GoType(..))
import Gopurs.GoSymbol (GoReference(..), generated, referenceName)
import Gopurs.GoConversions (boxGoExpr, coerceGoExpr)
import Gopurs.GoFunctions (Parameters, curriedFunction, iterationBindings, loopParameters, namedParameters)
import Gopurs.Int32Loops as Int32Loops
import Gopurs.AffineLoops as AffineLoops
import Gopurs.RecordAffineLoops as RecordAffineLoops
import Gopurs.ArraySnoc as ArraySnoc
import Gopurs.ListFilter as ListFilter
import Gopurs.TailAddLoops as TailAddLoops
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Codegen.Tco (TcoExpr)

type Worker =
  { ident :: String
  , args :: Array String
  , body :: TcoExpr
  , val :: TcoExpr
  }

-- Use precisely the ABI published by ModuleBindings, including native record
-- projections. A self-recursive singleton gets a loop; peers in larger groups
-- remain ordinary calls. Module bodies begin with no captured local bindings.
declaration :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Boolean -> Worker -> GoDecl
declaration translate context@{ codegenStateRef, modNameStr, moduleFunctions } isSelfRecursive fn =
  let
    info = Map.lookup fn.ident moduleFunctions
    params = namedParameters fn.args (case info of
      Just signature -> signature.fArgs
      Nothing -> [])
    expectedBodyType = map (functionResultAfter (Array.length fn.args)) (extractExprFuncType (getExprType fn.val))
    loop = if isSelfRecursive then
      [ { ident: fn.ident, loopParams: map fst (loopParameters params), goTypes: map snd params } ]
      else []
    workerContext = context
      { depth = 0
      , bound = bindParameters params Map.empty
      , tcoIdent = Just fn.ident
      , loopCtx = loop
      , options = { isTail: isSelfRecursive, inEffectBlock: false }
      , mbExpectedExprType = expectedBodyType
      , mbExpectedGoType = if Array.null fn.args || resultType == TypeValue then Nothing else Just resultType
      }
    resultType = case info of
      Just signature | Array.length fn.args < Array.length signature.fArgs -> TypeValue
      Just signature -> signature.fRet
      Nothing -> TypeValue
    tailAdd = if isSelfRecursive then
      TailAddLoops.worker translate workerContext fn.ident params resultType fn.body
      else Nothing
    body boxed = case tailAdd of
      Just loopBody -> loopBody
      Nothing ->
        let
          native = case ListFilter.worker context.metadata params resultType fn.val of
            Just filtered -> Just filtered
            Nothing -> ArraySnoc.worker modNameStr fn.ident params resultType fn.body
          result = case native of
            Just lowered -> lowered
            Nothing -> translate workerContext 0 fn.body
          returning = if boxed then boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr result.expr result.exprType
            else coerceGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr result.expr result.exprType resultType
          statements = flattenStmts result.stmts <> [ GoReturn returning ]
        in if isSelfRecursive then
          AffineLoops.wrap translate workerContext (AffineLoops.globalTarget modNameStr fn.ident) params resultType fn.body
            (Int32Loops.loop fn.ident params resultType statements)
          else GoBlock (iterationBindings params <> statements)
    value = if Array.null fn.args then
      -- A zero-argument abstraction still defers its whole body until called.
      curriedFunction [ Tuple "_" TypeValue ] TypeValue
        (body true)
      else
        let
          workerName = "Call_" <> modNameStr <> "_" <> fn.ident
          coldIdent = "__gopurs_affine_cold_" <> fn.ident
          coldName = "Call_" <> modNameStr <> "_" <> coldIdent
          reserved = Map.member coldIdent moduleFunctions
            || any (\signature -> referenceName signature.reference == coldName) context.metadata.ffiFunctions
          coldCall = GoCall (GoRef (SymbolReference (generated modNameStr coldName)))
            (map (GoVar <<< fst) (loopParameters params))
          hot = if isSelfRecursive && not reserved then
            RecordAffineLoops.hot (AffineLoops.globalTarget modNameStr fn.ident) params resultType fn.body coldCall
            else Nothing
          original = body false
          declare name workerBody = GoFunctionDecl
            { name: generated modNameStr name, params: loopParameters params, result: resultType, body: workerBody }
          workers = case hot of
            Just fast -> [ declare coldName original, declare workerName fast ]
            Nothing -> [ declare workerName original ]
        in
          unsafePerformEffect do
            Ref.modify_ (\state -> state { declarations = state.declarations <> workers }) codegenStateRef
            pure (case indexedWrapper translate context params fn.body of
              Just wrapper -> wrapper
              Nothing -> boxedWrapper context fn.ident params resultType)
  in
    GoCachedValue { identifier: generated modNameStr (modNameStr <> "_" <> fn.ident), expression: value, goType: TypeValue }

-- A scalar indexed fold can read either representation directly. Keep the
-- public Value wrapper on its original Value buffer instead of first copying
-- it into the native worker's array. Admission is shared with the fold emitter.
indexedWrapper :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Parameters -> TcoExpr -> Maybe GoExpr
indexedWrapper translate context params body = case params of
  [ Tuple name (TypeNativeArray TypeInt64) ] -> do
    let
      boxedContext = context { bound = bindParameters [ Tuple name TypeValue ] Map.empty }
      Tuple function spine = collectGoSpine body
    result <- ArrayIndexedFold.emit translate boxedContext 0 function (getGoSpineArgs spine)
    pure (GoCall (GoVar "gopurs_runtime.Func")
      [ GoFuncLit [ Tuple name TypeValue ] (flattenStmts result.stmts)
          (boxGoExpr context.codegenStateRef context.modNameStr result.expr result.exprType) TypeValue ])
  _ -> Nothing

-- Module wrappers group up to ten arguments; larger arities keep unary layers.
-- LocalWorkers and anonymous closures retain their own grouping policies.
boxedWrapper :: ExprContext -> String -> Parameters -> GoType -> GoExpr
boxedWrapper { codegenStateRef, modNameStr } name params resultType =
  let
    wrapperParams = map (\(Tuple param _) -> param <> "_box") params
    call = GoCall (GoRef (SymbolReference (generated modNameStr ("Call_" <> modNameStr <> "_" <> name))))
      (map (\(Tuple param ty) -> coerceGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr (GoVar (param <> "_box")) TypeValue ty) params)
    boxed = boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr call resultType
    arity = Array.length params
    wrapperName = if arity == 1 then "gopurs_runtime.Func" else "gopurs_runtime.Func" <> show arity
  in
    if arity <= 10 then
      GoCall (GoVar wrapperName) [ GoFuncLit (map (\param -> Tuple param TypeValue) wrapperParams) [] boxed TypeValue ]
    else Array.foldr
      (\param inner -> GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Func")
        [ GoFuncLit [ Tuple param TypeValue ] [] inner TypeValue ])
      boxed wrapperParams

src/Gopurs/RecordAffineLoops.purs.text:
-- Collapse pure countdown recurrences over immutable native records. The
-- complete update tree is proved before changing the number of iterations.
module Gopurs.RecordAffineLoops (wrap, hot) where

import Prelude

import Control.Alternative (guard)
import Data.Array as Array
import Data.Array.NonEmpty as NEA
import Data.Maybe (Maybe(..))
import Data.Traversable (traverse)
import Data.Tuple (Tuple(..), fst)
import Gopurs.GoAst (GoExpr(..), GoType(..), recordFieldName)
import Gopurs.GoFunctions (Parameters)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Codegen.Tco (TcoExpr(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.CoreFn (Literal(..), Prop(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.FreeVars (localId)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Syntax (BackendSyntax, Pair(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Syntax as Syn

data Delta = Constant Int | Remainders Int
data Change = Keep | Fields GoType (Array (Tuple String Change)) | Add Delta

type Recurrence = { counter :: String, record :: String, changes :: Change }

wrap :: (TcoExpr -> Boolean) -> Parameters -> GoType -> TcoExpr -> GoExpr -> GoExpr
wrap self params result body original = case recognize self params result body of
  Just recurrence ->
    let counter = GoVar (recurrence.counter <> "_loop")
        record = GoVar (recurrence.record <> "_loop")
        admitted = GoBinOp "&&" (GoBinOp ">" counter (integer 0))
          (GoBinOp "<=" counter (integer top))
    in GoBlock [ GoIfElse admitted [ GoReturn (emit counter record recurrence.changes) ] [], original ]
  Nothing -> original

-- A small native wrapper can inline at its callers while the complete old
-- worker remains the cold fallback. Only one flat field and a cheap constant
-- delta are admitted; nested updates and larger expressions keep their layout.
-- The proof of the recurrence is shared with wrap, not reconstructed from Go.
hot :: (TcoExpr -> Boolean) -> Parameters -> GoType -> TcoExpr -> GoExpr -> Maybe GoExpr
hot self params result body fallback = do
  recurrence <- recognize self params result body
  Tuple field delta <- case recurrence.changes of
    Fields _ [ Tuple field (Add (Constant delta)) ] | delta >= (-1) && delta <= 1 -> Just (Tuple field delta)
    _ -> Nothing
  let counter = GoVar (recurrence.counter <> "_loop")
      recordName = recurrence.record <> "_loop"
      record = GoVar recordName
      previous = GoRecordFieldAccess record field
      value = if delta == 0 then previous else GoBinOp (if delta == 1 then "+" else "-") previous counter
      -- For all signed Int64 inputs this unsigned interval is exactly 1..top.
      -- Addition/subtraction modulo 2^64 followed by Int32 narrowing preserves
      -- the original low 32 bits, including noncanonical FFI field values.
      -- Even delta zero must narrow on n>0; n=0 takes the unchanged fallback.
      admitted = GoBinOp "<" (GoBinOp "-" (GoCall (GoVar "uint64") [ counter ]) (GoInt 1)) (GoInt top)
  pure (GoBlock
    [ GoIfElse admitted [ GoMutate (recordName <> "." <> recordFieldName field) (narrow value), GoReturn record ] []
    , GoReturn fallback
    ])

recognize :: (TcoExpr -> Boolean) -> Parameters -> GoType -> TcoExpr -> Maybe Recurrence
recognize self params result body = do
  parameters <- case params of
    [ Tuple counter TypeInt64, Tuple record ty@(TypeRecord _) ] ->
      Just { counter, record, ty, counterFirst: true }
    [ Tuple record ty@(TypeRecord _), Tuple counter TypeInt64 ] ->
      Just { counter, record, ty, counterFirst: false }
    _ -> Nothing
  guard (parameters.counter /= parameters.record && result == parameters.ty)
  branch <- case syntax body of
    Syn.Branch branches step -> case NEA.toArray branches of
      [ Pair condition seed ] -> Just { condition, seed, step }
      _ -> Nothing
    _ -> Nothing
  guard (case syntax branch.condition of
    Syn.PrimOp (Syn.Op2 (Syn.OpIntOrd Syn.OpEq) left right) ->
      (local parameters.counter left && literal 0 right)
        || (literal 0 left && local parameters.counter right)
    _ -> false)
  guard (local parameters.record branch.seed)
  arguments <- case syntax branch.step of
    Syn.App target args | self target -> Just (NEA.toArray args)
    Syn.UncurriedApp target args | self target -> Just args
    _ -> Nothing
  Tuple nextCounter nextRecord <- case arguments of
    [ first, second ] -> Just (if parameters.counterFirst then Tuple first second else Tuple second first)
    _ -> Nothing
  guard (case syntax nextCounter of
    Syn.PrimOp (Syn.Op2 (Syn.OpIntNum Syn.OpSubtract) left right) ->
      local parameters.counter left && literal 1 right
    _ -> false)
  changes <- recordChanges parameters.counter parameters.record [] parameters.ty nextRecord
  pure { counter: parameters.counter, record: parameters.record, changes }

-- Every updated leaf reads its own previous value. Cross-field dependencies,
-- calls, effects, duplicate updates and layout changes retain the original loop.
-- Unchanged fields are copied by value, including any borrowed references.
recordChanges :: String -> String -> Array String -> GoType -> TcoExpr -> Maybe Change
recordChanges counter record path ty expression
  | recordPath record expression == Just path = Just Keep
  | otherwise = case ty, syntax expression of
      recordType@(TypeRecord fields), Syn.Update source props -> do
        guard (recordPath record source == Just path)
        let keys = map (\(Prop key _) -> key) props
        guard (Array.length (Array.nub keys) == Array.length keys)
        guard (Array.length (Array.nub (map fst fields)) == Array.length fields)
        updates <- traverse (\(Prop key value) -> do
          Tuple _ fieldType <- Array.find (\(Tuple label _) -> label == key) fields
          change <- recordChanges counter record (Array.snoc path key) fieldType value
          pure (Tuple key change)) props
        pure (Fields recordType updates)
      TypeInt64, Syn.PrimOp (Syn.Op2 (Syn.OpIntNum Syn.OpAdd) left right)
        | recordPath record left == Just path -> Add <$> increment counter right
        | recordPath record right == Just path -> Add <$> increment counter left
      _, _ -> Nothing

increment :: String -> TcoExpr -> Maybe Delta
increment counter expression = case syntax expression of
  Syn.Lit (LitInt value) | value >= bottom && value <= top -> Just (Constant value)
  Syn.PrimOp (Syn.Op2 (Syn.OpIntNum Syn.OpMod) value divisor) | local counter value -> do
    modulus <- intLiteral divisor
    guard (modulus > 0 && modulus <= top)
    pure (Remainders modulus)
  _ -> Nothing

emit :: GoExpr -> GoExpr -> Change -> GoExpr
emit counter original = case _ of
  Keep -> original
  Fields ty fields -> GoRecordUpdateNative ty original
    (map (\(Tuple key change) -> Tuple key (emit counter (GoRecordFieldAccess original key) change)) fields)
  Add delta ->
    -- At least one IntAdd executes on the admitted path. Normalize its seed
    -- first, so even noncanonical Int64 FFI inputs need no overflow assumption.
    -- n and each literal fit Int32; products and their sum fit signed Int64.
    narrow (GoBinOp "+" (narrow original) (total counter delta))

total :: GoExpr -> Delta -> GoExpr
total count = case _ of
  Constant value -> GoBinOp "*" count (integer value)
  Remainders modulus ->
    let divisor = integer modulus
        quotient = GoBinOp "/" count divisor
        remainder = GoBinOp "%" count divisor
        cycles = GoBinOp "/" (GoBinOp "*" (GoBinOp "*" quotient divisor) (integer (modulus - 1))) (integer 2)
        suffix = GoBinOp "/" (GoBinOp "*" remainder (GoBinOp "+" remainder (integer 1))) (integer 2)
    -- Sum k mod d for k=1..n: complete periods plus the final 1..remainder.
    in GoBinOp "+" cycles suffix

syntax :: TcoExpr -> BackendSyntax TcoExpr
syntax (TcoExpr _ value) = case value of
  Syn.Typed _ inner -> syntax inner
  Syn.TypeApp inner _ -> syntax inner
  _ -> value

local :: String -> TcoExpr -> Boolean
local name expression = case syntax expression of
  Syn.Local ident level -> localId ident level == name
  _ -> false

recordPath :: String -> TcoExpr -> Maybe (Array String)
recordPath root expression = case syntax expression of
  Syn.Local ident level | localId ident level == root -> Just []
  Syn.Accessor source (Syn.GetProp key) -> map (flip Array.snoc key) (recordPath root source)
  _ -> Nothing

intLiteral :: TcoExpr -> Maybe Int
intLiteral expression = case syntax expression of
  Syn.Lit (LitInt value) -> Just value
  _ -> Nothing

literal :: Int -> TcoExpr -> Boolean
literal value expression = intLiteral expression == Just value

narrow :: GoExpr -> GoExpr
narrow value = GoCall (GoVar "int64") [ GoCall (GoVar "int32") [ value ] ]

integer :: Int -> GoExpr
integer value = GoCall (GoVar "int64") [ GoInt value ]

-- @dependencies: prelude effect console refs arrays foldable-traversable either exceptions maybe
-- @inline Main.direct never
-- @inline Main.indexed never
-- @inline Main.mapper never
-- @inline Main.factory never
-- @inline Main.withUnknown never

-- @inline Main.captured never

-- @inline Main.mayFail never
module Main where

import Prelude
import Data.Array as Array
import Data.Either (Either(..))
import Data.Foldable (for_)
import Data.Maybe (Maybe(..))
import Data.Traversable (traverse)
import Data.TraversableWithIndex (traverseWithIndex)
import Effect (Effect)
import Effect.Console (logShow)
import Effect.Exception (message, throw, try)
import Effect.Ref as Ref
import Effect.Unsafe (unsafePerformEffect)
import Subject as Subject

type Trace = Ref.Ref (Array Int)

direct :: Ref.Ref (Array Int) -> Effect Int
direct reference = do
  values <- Ref.read reference
  pure (case traverse (\value -> Just (value + 1)) values of
    Nothing -> -1
    Just produced -> Subject.consume produced)

indexed :: Ref.Ref (Array Int) -> Effect Int
indexed reference = do
  values <- Ref.read reference
  pure (case traverseWithIndex (\index value -> Just (value + index)) values of
    Nothing -> -1
    Just produced -> Subject.consume produced)

captured :: Int -> Array Int -> Int
captured delta values = case traverse (\value -> Just (value + delta)) values of
  Nothing -> -1
  Just produced -> Subject.consume produced

shared :: Array Int -> Int
shared values = case traverse (\value -> Just (value + 1)) values of
  Nothing -> -1
  Just produced -> Subject.consume produced + Array.length produced

mayFail :: Array Int -> Int
mayFail values = case traverse (\value -> if value == 2 then Nothing else Just (value + 1)) values of
  Nothing -> -1
  Just produced -> Subject.consume produced

mapper :: Trace -> Boolean -> Int -> Maybe Int
mapper trace failing value = unsafePerformEffect do
  Ref.modify_ (\events -> Array.snoc events value) trace
  if failing && value == 2 then throw "mapper failure" else pure (Just (value + 1))

withUnknown :: Trace -> Boolean -> Array Int -> Int
withUnknown trace failing values = case traverse (mapper trace failing) values of
  Nothing -> -1
  Just produced -> Subject.consume produced

factory :: Trace -> Int -> Array Int -> Array Int
factory trace tag values = unsafePerformEffect do
  Ref.modify_ (\events -> Array.snoc events tag) trace
  pure values

withFactory :: Trace -> Array Int -> Int
withFactory trace values = case traverse (\value -> Just (value + 1)) (factory trace 1 values) of
  Nothing -> -1
  Just produced -> Subject.consume produced

withBarrier :: Trace -> Array Int -> Effect Int
withBarrier trace values = do
  let result = traverse (\value -> Just (value + 1)) values
  Ref.modify_ (\events -> Array.snoc events 9) trace
  pure (case result of
    Nothing -> -1
    Just produced -> Subject.consume produced)

main :: Effect Unit
main = do
  for_ [ [], [ 1, 2, 3 ], [ 2147483647, -2147483648, -1, 0 ] ] \input -> do
    reference <- Ref.new input
    a <- direct reference
    b <- indexed reference
    values <- Ref.read reference
    logShow [ a, b, captured 3 values, shared values, mayFail values ]
    Ref.read reference >>= logShow
    logShow (Array.reverse input)
  trace <- Ref.new []
  input <- Ref.new [ 1, 2, 3 ]
  values <- Ref.read input
  logShow (withUnknown trace false values)
  Ref.read trace >>= logShow
  Ref.write [] trace
  failure <- try do
    current <- Ref.read input
    pure (withUnknown trace true current)
  logShow (case failure of
    Left error -> message error
    Right value -> show value)
  Ref.read trace >>= logShow
  Ref.write [] trace
  logShow (withFactory trace values)
  Ref.read trace >>= logShow
  Ref.write [] trace
  empty <- Ref.new []
  current <- Ref.read empty
  logShow (withUnknown trace true current)
  Ref.read trace >>= logShow
  withBarrier trace values >>= logShow
  Ref.read trace >>= logShow

module Subject where

import Prelude

type Snapshot = { total :: Int, borrowed :: Array Int, stamp :: String }

step :: Int -> Snapshot -> Snapshot
step 0 snapshot = snapshot
step remaining snapshot = step (remaining - 1) (snapshot { total = snapshot.total + 1 })

normalize :: Int -> Snapshot -> Snapshot
normalize 0 snapshot = snapshot
normalize remaining snapshot = normalize (remaining - 1) (snapshot { total = snapshot.total + 0 })

down :: Int -> Snapshot -> Snapshot
down 0 snapshot = snapshot
down remaining snapshot = down (remaining - 1) (snapshot { total = snapshot.total + (-1) })

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Archive a successful source/cache E2E run, without running the compiler."""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse, hashlib, json, re, shutil

def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

def save(path, value):
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2) + '\n')

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('compiler', type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('log', type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('destination', type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--compare-js', type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    text = args.log.read_text()
    assert 'ℹ pass 2' in text and 'ℹ fail 0' in text
    workspace = Path(re.search(r'Array traverse fold fixture workspace: (.+)', text).group(1))
    fixture = workspace / '0-array-traverse-fold'
    destination = args.destination
    destination.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    for path in (fixture / 'logs').iterdir():
        if path.is_file():
            shutil.copy2(path, destination / path.name)
    shutil.copy2(args.log, destination / 'test.log')
    names = ['Get_Main_direct', 'Call_Main_direct', 'Get_Main_indexed', 'Call_Main_indexed', 'Get_Main_captured', 'Call_Main_captured',
             'Get_Main_withUnknown', 'Call_Main_withUnknown', 'Get_Main_withFactory', 'Call_Main_withFactory',
             'Get_Main_withBarrier', 'Call_Main_withBarrier', 'Get_Main_mayFail', 'Call_Main_mayFail', 'Call_Subject_consume']
    transitions = {}
    for profile_index, profile in enumerate(['release', 'dev']):
        baseline = json.loads((destination / (profile + '-workers.json')).read_text())
        if profile == 'release':
            for name in ['direct', 'indexed']:
                assert 'traverseFold_fold_' in baseline['Get_Main_' + name] + baseline['Call_Main_' + name]
        for name in ['captured', 'withUnknown', 'mayFail', 'withBarrier']:
            assert 'traverseFold_fold_' not in baseline['Get_Main_' + name] + baseline['Call_Main_' + name]
        for variant_index, variant in enumerate(['callback', 'seed', 'unknown']):
            cache = json.loads((destination / (profile + '-' + variant + '-cache.json')).read_text())
            assert cache['warm_equals_clean_outputs'] and cache['warm_equals_clean_workers']
            transitions[profile + '/' + variant] = cache
            directory = workspace / (str(100 + profile_index * 3 + variant_index) + '-array-traverse-fold') / 'output/purescript'
            source = '\n'.join(path.read_text() for path in directory.rglob('*.go') if '.gopurs-cache' not in path.parts)
            workers = {}
            for name in names:
                start = source.find('func ' + name + '(')
                end = source.find('\nfunc ', start + 1)
                workers[name] = '' if start < 0 else source[start:end if end >= 0 else None]
            save(destination / (profile + '-' + variant + '-validated-clean-workers.json'), workers)
    compared = []
    for path in destination.glob('*.log'):
        if path.name.endswith('-go.log') or path.name.endswith('-javascript.log'):
            assert path.read_bytes() == (args.compare_js / path.name).read_bytes(), path.name
            compared.append(path.name)
    manifest = {'validated': True, 'compiler_host': 'native-parallel', 'compiler_root': str(args.compiler.resolve()),
                'runtime_in_tested_output': 'final principal compiler combining all completed waves',
                'profiles': ['release', 'dev'], 'source_observations_per_baseline_profile': 19,
                'source_observations_unknown_callback_profile': transitions['release/unknown']['observations'],
                'cache_transitions': transitions, 'worktree_js_outputs_equal': True,
                'compared_observation_logs': sorted(compared),
                'source_sha256': {name: sha(args.compiler / name) for name in ['bin/gopurs.js', 'bin/gopurs-native', 'runtime/runtime.go',
                    'tools/array-traverse-fold-e2e.test.mjs', 'tools/fixtures/array-traverse-fold.purs', 'tools/fixtures/array-traverse-fold/Subject.purs']},
                'test_result': {'tests': 2, 'pass': 2, 'fail': 0},
                'artifact_sha256': {path.name: sha(path) for path in sorted(destination.iterdir()) if path.is_file()}}
    save(destination / 'manifest.json', manifest)
    print('Native traverse source/cache proof archived; ' + str(len(compared)) + ' observable logs equal isolated JS.')

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build immutable App/AppAll artifacts with the already rebuilt native compiler."""
import argparse, json, os, runpy, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
SCRIPTS = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
WORK = SCRIPTS.parents[1]
ROOT = WORK.parents[2]
pair = runpy.run_path(str(SCRIPTS / 'measure-pair.py'))
parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
parser.add_argument('--only', choices=['core', 'all'])
parser.add_argument('--execute', action='store_true')
args = parser.parse_args()
frozen = json.loads((SCRIPTS / 'freeze.json').read_text())
pair['verify_freeze'](frozen)
environment = dict(os.environ, GOGC='800', GOWORK='off')
for key in ('GOMAXPROCS', 'PPROF', 'GOPURS_JS', 'GOPURS_RUST', 'GOFLAGS', 'GOEXPERIMENT'):
    environment.pop(key, None)
commands = []
for kind in ([args.only] if args.only else ['core', 'all']):
    destination = WORK / ('after-' + kind)
    if destination.exists():
        raise ValueError('Refusing to overwrite an after build: ' + str(destination))
    commands.append([sys.executable, '-B', str(ROOT / 'bin/native/driver.py'), 'go', '--build-only',
                     '--build-dir', str(destination), *(['--wip-included'] if kind == 'all' else [])])
if not args.execute:
    print(json.dumps({'commands': commands, 'environment': {'GOGC': '800', 'GOWORK': 'off', 'compiler_host': 'native'},
                      'benchmarks_executed': False}, indent=2))
else:
    compiler = pair['compiler_snapshot']()
    for command in commands:
        pair['verify_freeze'](frozen)
        pair['C']['verify_hashes'](compiler['files_sha256'])
        subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, env=environment, check=True)
        pair['C']['verify_hashes'](compiler['files_sha256'])
        pair['verify_freeze'](frozen)
    pair['write'](WORK / 'after-build-compiler.json', compiler)
    print('After build(s) completed; no benchmark was executed.', flush=True)

ROOT = Path('/Users/0x1/Documents/htdocs/altbak.pub')
WORK = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
PROOF = WORK / 'proofs/isolated-regressions'
HELPERS = runpy.run_path(str(Path(__file__).with_name('compare-generated.py')))
def function_body(source,name):
    text=source.decode() if isinstance(source,bytes) else source
    start=text.index('func '+name+'(')
    opening=text.index('{',start)
    depth=0
    pattern=r'"(?:\\.|[^"\\])*"|`[^`]*`|\'(?:\\.|[^\'\\])*\'|//[^\n]*|/\*[\s\S]*?\*/|[{}]'
    for token in re.finditer(pattern,text[opening:]):
        if token[0]=='{':depth+=1
        elif token[0]=='}':
            depth-=1
            if depth==0:return text[opening:opening+token.end()]
    raise ValueError('Unterminated generated function '+name)


sha = lambda path: hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
primary = WORK / 'campaign/results.json'
primary_sha = sha(primary)
report = json.loads(primary.read_text())
labels = [row['case'] for row in report['rows_by_go_c_descending'] if row['change_percent'] > 5]
assert labels, 'No primary increases need diagnostics'
rows = {row['case']: row for row in report['rows_by_go_c_descending']}
assert all(rows[label]['change_percent'] > 5 for label in labels)
cases = []
for label in labels:
    row = report['all_campaign']['all_tests'][label]
    core = label in report['primary_times_us']['after']
    cases.append({'key': re.sub(r'[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]+', '-', label), 'label': label,
                  'module': row['module'].replace('.', '_'),
                  'getter': 'Get_' + row['module'].replace('.', '_') + ('_act' if core else '_prepare'),
                  'expected': row['expected'], 'prepare': not core, 'source_suite': 'core' if core else 'all',
                  'primary_change_percent': rows[label]['change_percent']})
parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
parser.add_argument('--execute', action='store_true')
args = parser.parse_args()
if not args.execute:
    print(json.dumps({'cases': cases, 'primary_sha256': primary_sha, 'processes': 6 * len(cases), 'executed': False}, indent=2))
    raise SystemExit(0)
builds = {scope: {side: WORK / (side + '-' + scope) for side in ('before', 'after')} for scope in ('core', 'all')}
env = dict(os.environ, GOGC='800', GOWORK='off')
for key in ['GOMAXPROCS', 'PPROF', 'GOFLAGS', 'GOEXPERIMENT']:
    env.pop(key, None)
PROOF.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
(PROOF / 'inputs.json').write_text(json.dumps(cases, indent=2) + '\n')
inventories = {scope: {side: HELPERS['inventory'](path) for side, path in pair.items()} for scope, pair in builds.items()}
originals = {scope: {side: inventory['provenance'] for side, inventory in pair.items()} for scope, pair in inventories.items()}
commands, sources, comparisons = {}, {}, {}


def normalize(body):
    # Canonicalize only generated package aliases/runtime spelling and trailing
    # whitespace; preserve calls, literals, arithmetic, local names and order.
    body = re.sub(r'\b(?:g[0-9a-f]{6})\.', 'package.', body.decode())
    body = re.sub(r'\br_\.', 'r.', body)
    return '\n'.join(line.rstrip() for line in body.splitlines()).strip() + '\n'


# First compare target module and original harness sections, before building probes.
for case in cases:
    key = case['key']
    selected = {'Bench.go', 'Bench_ffi.go', 'Effect_Console.go', 'Effect_Console_ffi.go', case['module'] + '.go'}
    extracted = {side: {name: body for name, body in inventory['sections'].items() if Path(name).name in selected}
                 for side, inventory in inventories[case['source_suite']].items()}
    assert set(extracted['before']) == set(extracted['after'])
    comparisons[key] = {'source_suite': case['source_suite'], 'sections': {}}
    for name in extracted['before']:
        old, new = extracted['before'][name], extracted['after'][name]
        a, b = normalize(old), normalize(new)
        comparisons[key]['sections'][name] = {'before_sha256': hashlib.sha256(old).hexdigest(),
                                              'after_sha256': hashlib.sha256(new).hexdigest(),
                                              'byte_identical': old == new, 'normalized_identical': a == b,
                                              'before': old.decode(), 'after': new.decode(),
                                              'normalized_diff': ''.join(difflib.unified_diff(a.splitlines(True), b.splitlines(True)))}
    for name,item in comparisons[key]['sections'].items():
        if item['byte_identical']:
            continue
        assert Path(name).name=='Bench.go', ('Changed target/harness code',key,name)
        old,new=item['before'],item['after']
        old_body=function_body(old,'Call_Bench_runBench')
        new_body=function_body(new,'Call_Bench_runBench')
        assert old.replace(old_body,'<runBench-body>')==new.replace(new_body,'<runBench-body>')
        proof=json.loads((WORK/'proofs/generated-workload-review.json').read_text())[case['source_suite']]
        assert proof['runBench_only_ten_measureBatch_call_lowerings_and_local_renaming']
        assert hashlib.sha256(old_body.encode()).hexdigest()==proof['old_runBench_sha256']
        assert hashlib.sha256(new_body.encode()).hexdigest()==proof['new_runBench_sha256']
        assert proof['timed_loop_and_callback_adapter_unchanged']
        item['measureBatch_call_lowering_outside_timer_verified']=True
        item['lowering_note']='Generic direct worker for the same ten calls, same arguments and order; conversions occur before the unchanged timed thunk.'
    run_before=next(body for body in inventories[case['source_suite']]['before']['sections'].values() if b'func Call_Bench_runBench(' in body)
    run_after=next(body for body in inventories[case['source_suite']]['after']['sections'].values() if b'func Call_Bench_runBench(' in body)
    unchanged_runbench = function_body(run_before,'Call_Bench_runBench') == function_body(run_after,'Call_Bench_runBench')
    comparisons[key]['runBench_byte_identical']=unchanged_runbench
    comparisons[key]['runBench_only_outside_timer_call_lowering']=not unchanged_runbench
    comparisons[key]['timed_measureBatch_identical']=True
    assert all(item['byte_identical'] for name,item in comparisons[key]['sections'].items() if Path(name).name=='Bench_ffi.go')
    comparisons[key]['measureBatch_ffi_identical']=True
(PROOF / 'generated-comparison.json').write_text(json.dumps(comparisons, indent=2) + '\n')
print('Target and timed harness verified; see exact generated-comparison.json.', flush=True)

for case in cases:
    key = case['key']
    commands[key], sources[key] = {}, {}
    for side, inventory in inventories[case['source_suite']].items():
        owner = lambda name: [str(Path(path).parent) for path, body in inventory['sections'].items()
                              if re.search(rb'func ' + name.encode() + rb'\(', body)]
        action, bench, console = owner(case['getter']), owner('Call_Bench_runBench'), owner('Get_Effect_Console_log')
        assert len(action) == len(bench) == len(console) == 1
        packages = sorted(set(action + bench + console))
        aliases = {name: 'p' + str(i) for i, name in enumerate(packages)}
        imports = '; '.join(aliases[name] + ' "gopurs/output/' + name + '"' for name in packages)
        act = aliases[action[0]] + '.' + case['getter'] + '()'
        if case['prepare']:
            act = 'r.Apply(' + act + ',r.Value{})'
        main = f'''package main
import(r "gopurs/output/gopurs_runtime"; {imports})
func main(){{
 act:={act}
 for i:=0;i<3;i++{{if value:=r.Apply(act,r.Value{{}});value.Type!=r.TypeInt||value.IntVal!={case['expected']}{{panic("invalid global warmup result")}}}}
 describe:=r.Apply({aliases[console[0]]}.Get_Effect_Console_log(),r.Str("{case['label']}"))
 r.Apply({aliases[bench[0]]}.Call_Bench_runBench(describe,act),r.Value{{}})
}}
'''
        source = PROOF / (key + '-' + side + '-main.go')
        source.write_text(main)
        sources[key][side] = sha(source)
        command = ['go', 'build', '-pgo=off', '-o', str(PROOF / (key + '-' + side + '-probe')), str(source)]
        process = subprocess.run(command, cwd=builds[case['source_suite']][side] / 'output', env=env, text=True, capture_output=True)
        (PROOF / (key + '-' + side + '-build.stdout')).write_text(process.stdout)
        (PROOF / (key + '-' + side + '-build.stderr')).write_text(process.stderr)
        process.check_returncode()
        assert not process.stderr
        commands[key][side] = command
        print('Built', key, side, flush=True)

# All probe builds complete before the first timed process.
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / 'bin/benchmark'))
from validate import ROW
order = ['before', 'after', 'after', 'before', 'before', 'after']
results = {}
for case in cases:
    key = case['key']
    samples, runs = {'before': [], 'after': []}, []
    for index, side in enumerate(order, 1):
        process = subprocess.run([str(PROOF / (key + '-' + side + '-probe'))],
                                 cwd=builds[case['source_suite']][side] / 'output', env=env,
                                 text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=60)
        stem = f'{key}-{index}-{side}'
        (PROOF / (stem + '.stdout')).write_text(process.stdout)
        (PROOF / (stem + '.stderr')).write_text(process.stderr)
        process.check_returncode()
        assert not process.stderr
        values = ROW.findall(process.stdout)
        assert len(values) == 1 and process.stdout.count('(Test)') == 1
        label, value, elapsed = values[0]
        assert label.strip() == case['label'] and value.strip() == str(case['expected'])
        elapsed = float(elapsed)
        assert math.isfinite(elapsed) and elapsed > 0
        batches = [int(n) for n in re.findall(r'^Batch iterations: (\d+)$', process.stdout, re.M)]
        assert len(batches) == 1 and 0 < batches[0] <= 16777216 and not batches[0] & (batches[0] - 1)
        samples[side].append(elapsed)
        runs.append({'variant': side, 'time_us': elapsed, 'batch_iterations': batches[0],
                     'stdout': process.stdout, 'stderr': process.stderr})
        print(stem, elapsed, 'us', flush=True)
    medians = {side: statistics.median(values) for side, values in samples.items()}
    change = 100 * (medians['after'] / medians['before'] - 1)
    results[key] = {'case': case['label'], 'source_suite': case['source_suite'], 'expected': case['expected'],
                    'original_builds': originals[case['source_suite']], 'commands': commands[key],
                    'main_sha256': sources[key], 'probe_binary_sha256': {side: sha(PROOF / (key + '-' + side + '-probe')) for side in samples},
                    'order': order, 'samples_us': samples, 'medians_us': medians, 'change_percent': change,
                    'primary_change_percent': case['primary_change_percent'], 'increase_over_5_percent_reproduced': change > 5,
                    'runs': runs}
for scope, pair in builds.items():
    for side, path in pair.items():
        assert originals[scope][side] == HELPERS['inventory'](path)['provenance']
assert sha(primary) == primary_sha
result = {'measured_at_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
          'scope': 'Separate diagnostics only; original primary samples and aggregates remain unchanged',
          'protocol': 'AB/BA/AB for each case; actual getters and unchanged timed measureBatch; runBench is byte-identical or has only separately verified call lowering outside the timer; 3 global warmups then calibration and minimum of ten batches; all builds finished before timing',
          'GOGC': '800', 'GOMAXPROCS': 'default', 'host_isolated': False,
          'source_comparison': 'generated-comparison.json', 'script_sha256': sha(__file__),
          'primary_campaign_sha256': primary_sha, 'cases': results, 'oracles_verified': 6 * len(cases),
          'original_generated_sources_and_binaries_unchanged': True}
(PROOF / 'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({key: {name: row[name] for name in ['case', 'source_suite', 'samples_us', 'medians_us', 'change_percent', 'increase_over_5_percent_reproduced']}
                  for key, row in results.items()}, indent=2))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Freeze the official 37-case Go/C baseline before changing hot-path codegen."""
import hashlib, json, math, re, runpy, shutil, statistics, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
ROOT = Path('/Users/0x1/Documents/htdocs/altbak.pub')
COMPILER = ROOT.parent / 'gopurs/gopurs'
OLD = ROOT / 'var/benchmark/go-tree-sum-20261127'
WORK = ROOT / 'var/benchmark/go-traverse-records-20261127'
SCRIPTS = WORK / 'proofs/campaign-scripts'
sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
write = lambda p, x: Path(p).write_text(json.dumps(x, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + '\n')
if (WORK / 'compiler-before/manifest.json').exists():
    raise ValueError('Refusing to overwrite the frozen compiler baseline')
history_path = ROOT / 'docs/benchmark-results/2026-11-27-go-tree-sum.json'
reference_path = ROOT / 'docs/benchmark-results/2026-11-26-c-library.json'
history = json.loads(history_path.read_text())
reference = json.loads(reference_path.read_text())
assert len(history['compiler']['measured_snapshot']['files_sha256']) == 207
for name, digest in history['compiler']['measured_snapshot']['files_sha256'].items():
    assert sha(name) == digest, ('Compiler differs from measured previous executable', name)
manifest = {
    'head': subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(COMPILER), 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip(),
    'status': subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(COMPILER), 'status', '--porcelain'], text=True),
    'sources': {}, 'files': {},
    'previous_measured_compiler_matches': True,
    'previous_measured_head': history['compiler']['measured_snapshot']['head'],
    'note': 'Measured baseline preserving the current tracked and untracked source state; all 207 measured compiler source and executable hashes match the previous Tree+Sum campaign. The recorded status determines whether this snapshot is clean or dirty.',
}
manifest['baseline_kind'] = 'dirty measured snapshot' if manifest['status'] else 'clean measured snapshot'
tracked = subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(COMPILER), 'ls-files', '--cached', '--others', '--exclude-standard'], text=True).splitlines()
manifest['source_inventory'] = sorted(set(tracked))
manifest['missing_source_files'] = [name for name in sorted(set(tracked)) if not (COMPILER / name).is_file()]
extra = ['bin/gopurs', 'bin/gopurs-native', 'bin/gopurs.js',
         'src/Gopurs/Runtime/Source.go', 'src/Gopurs/Runtime/Source.js', 'src/Gopurs/Runtime/Source.rs']
for group, names in [('sources', tracked), ('files', extra)]:
    for name in names:
        source = COMPILER / name
        if not source.is_file():
            continue
        target = WORK / 'compiler-before' / group / name
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copy2(source, target)
        manifest[group][name] = {'path': str(target), 'sha256': sha(target)}
        assert sha(source) == sha(target)
mp = WORK / 'compiler-before/manifest.json'
write(mp, manifest)
shutil.copy2(ROOT / 'README.md', WORK / 'README.before.md')
frozen = json.loads((OLD / 'proofs/campaign-scripts/freeze.json').read_text())
for name, digest in frozen['source_sha256'].items():
    assert sha(ROOT / name) == digest, ('Previously protected source changed', name)
protected = [path for folder in ('src', 'srx', 'bin/benchmark', 'bin/native')
             for path in (ROOT / folder).rglob('*') if path.is_file() and '__pycache__' not in path.parts]
protected += [ROOT / 'tmp/bench_native.c', ROOT / 'tmp/imperative_reference_contract.md', history_path, reference_path]
protected += [path for path in (ROOT / 'tmp/c-library').iterdir() if path.is_file()]
frozen['source_sha256'].update({str(path.relative_to(ROOT)): sha(path) for path in protected})
ports = [(ROOT / json.loads(match[1])).resolve() for match in
         re.finditer(r'(?m)^\s*path:\s*("(?:[^"\\]|\\.)*")\s*$', (ROOT / 'run/bak/go/spago.go.yaml').read_text())]
frozen['library_sources_sha256'] = {
    str(path): sha(path) for port in ports for path in (port / 'src').rglob('*') if path.is_file()}
frozen['library_git_heads'] = {str(port): subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(port), 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip()
                               for port in ports}
frozen['compiler_head'] = manifest['head']
frozen['compiler_baseline_manifest'] = str(mp)
frozen['compiler_baseline_manifest_sha256'] = sha(mp)
frozen['historical_archive'] = {'path': str(history_path.relative_to(ROOT)), 'sha256': sha(history_path)}
frozen['reference37_archive'] = {'path': str(reference_path.relative_to(ROOT)), 'sha256': sha(reference_path)}
campaign = history['campaign']
frozen['historical_go_core_times_us'] = campaign['primary_times_us']['after']
frozen['historical_go_all_times_us'] = {name: row['medians_us']['after'] for name, row in campaign['all_campaign']['all_tests'].items()}
frozen['historical_go37_times_us'] = campaign['matched37_times_us']['after']
frozen['c37_times_us'] = {name: entry['time_us'] for name, entry in reference['publication']['references']['columns']['c'].items() if name in frozen['historical_go37_times_us']}
frozen['c37_times_us'].update(reference['medians_us'])
assert set(frozen['c37_times_us']) == set(frozen['historical_go37_times_us']) and len(frozen['c37_times_us']) == 37
frozen['historical_aggregates'] = campaign['core14_aggregates']['after']
frozen['historical37_aggregates'] = {key: campaign['aggregates']['after'][source] for key, source in [('/', 'total'), ('μ', 'arithmetic'), ('Q₂', 'median'), ('G', 'geometric')]}
frozen['compiler_baseline_kind'] = manifest['baseline_kind']
frozen['documentary_baseline_sha256'] = {'README.md': sha(ROOT / 'README.md')}
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / 'bin/benchmark'))
C = runpy.run_path(str(ROOT / 'bin/benchmark/compare-core.py'))
J = runpy.run_path(str(ROOT / 'bin/benchmark/js-ratios.py'))
for kind in ('core', 'all'):
    source = OLD / ('after-' + kind)
    destination = WORK / ('before-' + kind)
    shutil.copytree(source, destination)
    assert sha(source / 'benchmark') == sha(destination / 'benchmark')
    frozen['go_before_' + kind + '_directory'] = str(destination)
    frozen['go_before_' + kind + '_directory_binary_sha256'] = sha(destination / 'benchmark')
    frozen['go_before_' + kind + '_directory_manifest_sha256'] = sha(destination / 'manifest.json')
frozen['go_before_core'] = C['inspect_go'](WORK / 'before-core')
frozen['go_before_all'] = {'directory': str(WORK / 'before-all'), 'manifest': J['inspect'](WORK / 'before-all'),
                         'manifest_sha256': sha(WORK / 'before-all/manifest.json')}
for name in ('references.json', 'collect-all.py', 'inputs.json'):
    shutil.copy2(OLD / 'proofs/campaign-scripts' / name, SCRIPTS / name)
frozen['reference_files_sha256'] = {str(SCRIPTS / name): sha(SCRIPTS / name) for name in ('references.json', 'collect-all.py')}
write(SCRIPTS / 'freeze.json', frozen)
for group in ('sources', 'files'):
    for name, entry in manifest[group].items():
        assert sha(COMPILER / name) == entry['sha256'], ('Compiler changed while freezing', name)
assert manifest['status'] == subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(COMPILER), 'status', '--porcelain'], text=True)
print(json.dumps({'head': manifest['head'], 'compiler_sources': len(manifest['sources']), 'protected_sources': len(frozen['source_sha256']),
                  'before_core_sha256': frozen['go_before_core_directory_binary_sha256'],
                  'before_all_sha256': frozen['go_before_all_directory_binary_sha256'],
                  'cases': 37, 'historical_aggregates': frozen['historical37_aggregates']}, indent=2))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Pair frozen Go App/AppAll builds against all 37 unchanged archived C medians."""
import argparse
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
import math
import os
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import runpy
import statistics
import subprocess
import sys

sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
ROOT = Path('/Users/0x1/Documents/htdocs/altbak.pub')
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / 'bin/benchmark'))
C = runpy.run_path(str(ROOT / 'bin/benchmark/compare-core.py'))
J = runpy.run_path(str(ROOT / 'bin/benchmark/js-ratios.py'))


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def write(path, value):
    Path(path).write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + '\n')


def metrics(times, reference):
    if set(times) != set(reference) or len(times) not in (14, 37):
        raise ValueError('Identical Go/C case populations of 14 or 37 required')
    ratios = [times[name] / reference[name] for name in times]
    if any(not math.isfinite(x) or x <= 0 for x in ratios):
        raise ValueError('Invalid ratio')
    return {'total': sum(times.values()) / sum(reference.values()),
            'arithmetic': statistics.mean(ratios), 'median': statistics.median(ratios),
            'geometric': math.exp(statistics.mean(math.log(x) for x in ratios))}


def verify_freeze(frozen):
    if 'benchmark_baseline_manifest' in frozen:
        benchmark_manifest=Path(frozen['benchmark_baseline_manifest'])
        assert sha(benchmark_manifest)==frozen['benchmark_baseline_manifest_sha256']
        baseline_benchmark=json.loads(benchmark_manifest.read_text())
        for name,entry in baseline_benchmark['preserved_existing_files'].items():
            assert sha(entry['snapshot'])==entry['sha256'], ('Changed benchmark snapshot',name)
            if name!='README.md':
                assert sha(ROOT/name)==entry['sha256'], ('Changed prior publication',name)
    baseline_path = Path(frozen['compiler_baseline_manifest'])
    if sha(baseline_path) != frozen['compiler_baseline_manifest_sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Compiler baseline manifest changed')
    baseline = json.loads(baseline_path.read_text())
    for group in ['files', 'sources']:
        C['verify_hashes']({entry['path']: entry['sha256'] for entry in baseline[group].values()})
    C['verify_hashes'](frozen['source_sha256'], ROOT)
    C['verify_hashes'](frozen['library_sources_sha256'])
    C['verify_hashes'](frozen['reference_files_sha256'])
    for build in [frozen['go_before_core'], frozen['c_build']]:
        C['verify_hashes']({build['manifest_path']: build['manifest_sha256']})
        C['verify_hashes'](build['payload_sha256'])
    old_all = frozen['go_before_all']
    path = Path(old_all['directory'])
    C['verify_hashes']({str(path / 'manifest.json'): old_all['manifest_sha256'],
                       str(path / 'benchmark'): old_all['manifest']['binary_sha256']})


def compiler_snapshot():
    root = ROOT.parent / 'gopurs/gopurs'
    paths = [root / 'bin/gopurs-native', root / 'bin/gopurs.js', root / 'bin/gopurs']
    paths += [path for folder in ['src', 'runtime'] for path in sorted((root / folder).rglob('*'))
              if path.is_file() and path.suffix in {'.purs', '.go', '.js', '.rs'}]
    return {'root': str(root),
            'head': subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(root), 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip(),
            'files_sha256': {str(path): sha(path) for path in paths}}


def plan_entry(key, build):
    return {'key': key, 'mode': 'pure', 'command': build['command'],
            'artifact': build['cwd'], 'cwd': build['cwd'],
            'manifest': build['manifest_path'], 'manifest_sha256': build['manifest_sha256'],
            'payload_sha256': build['payload_sha256'],
            'executable_sha256': build['manifest']['binary_sha256']}


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--freeze', type=Path, default=Path(__file__).with_name('freeze.json'))
    parser.add_argument('--after-core', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--after-all', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--execute', action='store_true', help='run only after all builds and tests have finished')
    args = parser.parse_args()

    after_core = C['inspect_go'](args.after_core.resolve())

    after_all = J['inspect'](args.after_all.resolve())

                                 ('all', before_all, after_all)]:
        for field in ['profile', 'toolchain']:
            if before[field] != after[field]:
                raise ValueError(f'{label} build {field} differs')
        for name in before['inputs']:
            if name.startswith(('src/', 'srx/')) and before['inputs'][name] != after['inputs'].get(name):
                raise ValueError(f'{label} benchmark input differs: {name}')
