module Gopurs.ArrayTraverse
  ( emit
  ) where

import Prelude

import Control.Alternative (guard)
import Data.Array as Array
import Data.Array.NonEmpty as NonEmptyArray
import Data.Maybe (Maybe(..), fromMaybe)
import Data.Tuple (Tuple(..))
import Gopurs.AdtExprs as AdtExprs
import Gopurs.ArrayTraverseTotal as ArrayTraverseTotal
import Gopurs.CallAnalysis (collectCurriedAbs, collectGoSpine, getGoSpineArgs, qualifiedTarget)
import Gopurs.CallArguments (Arguments, applyBoxed)
import Gopurs.CallArguments as CallArguments
import Gopurs.ExprAnalysis (extractFuncType, unwrapTcoExpr)
import Gopurs.ExprContext (ExprContext, ExprResult, StmtTree(..), TranslateExpr, bindParameters, childContext, flattenStmts)
import Gopurs.GoAst (rawGo, GoExpr(..), GoType(..))
import Gopurs.GoConversions (boxGoExpr)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Codegen.Tco (TcoExpr)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.CoreFn (ExprType(..), ModuleName(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.FreeVars (localId)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Syntax (BackendAccessor(GetProp), BackendSyntax(Abs, Accessor))

-- The known Array/Either and Array/Maybe instances permit a strict loop instead of building
-- intermediate arrays through generic applicative composition. PBO may expose
-- either the class method, its static dictionary accessor, or the FFI worker.
-- Every form must prove the same dictionaries; arbitrary Applicatives stay on
-- their existing traversal path.
emit :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> TcoExpr -> Array TcoExpr -> Maybe ExprResult
emit translate context nextId fn args = do
  traversal <- recognize fn args
  pure case if traversal.plan.moduleName == "Data.Maybe" then
    ArrayTraverseTotal.emit translate context nextId traversal.indexed traversal.callbackOffset traversal.args
    else Nothing of
      Just result -> result
      Nothing -> emitLoop context traversal (captureArguments translate context nextId traversal)

type ApplicativePlan =
  { moduleName :: String
  , sourceType :: ExprType
  , success :: String
  , failure :: String
  , prefix :: String
  }

type Traversal = { indexed :: Boolean, callbackOffset :: Int, args :: Array TcoExpr, plan :: ApplicativePlan }

-- These are the canonical library constructors, never inferred from a custom
-- dictionary's shape. The regular ADT emitter handles nullable Maybe layouts.
applicativePlan :: TcoExpr -> Maybe ApplicativePlan
applicativePlan dictionary
  | isNamed "Data.Either" "applicativeEither" dictionary = Just eitherPlan
  | isNamed "Data.Maybe" "applicativeMaybe" dictionary = Just maybePlan
  | otherwise = Nothing

eitherPlan :: ApplicativePlan
eitherPlan =
  { moduleName: "Data.Either"
  , sourceType: ADT "Data.Either.Either" [ "Data", "Either", "Either" ] [ Any, Any ]
  , success: "Right", failure: "Left", prefix: "traverseEither"
  }

maybePlan :: ApplicativePlan
maybePlan =
  { moduleName: "Data.Maybe"
  , sourceType: ADT "Data.Maybe.Maybe" [ "Data", "Maybe", "Maybe" ] [ Any ]
  , success: "Just", failure: "Nothing", prefix: "traverseMaybe"
  }

ffiPlan :: TcoExpr -> TcoExpr -> TcoExpr -> Maybe ApplicativePlan
ffiPlan applyFn mapFn pureFn =
  let
    matches mod suffix = isMethod "Control.Apply" "apply" mod ("apply" <> suffix) applyFn
      && isMethod "Data.Functor" "map" mod ("functor" <> suffix) mapFn
      && isMethod "Control.Applicative" "pure" mod ("applicative" <> suffix) pureFn
  in
    if matches "Data.Either" "Either" then Just eitherPlan
    else if matches "Data.Maybe" "Maybe" then Just maybePlan
    else Nothing

recognize :: TcoExpr -> Array TcoExpr -> Maybe Traversal
recognize fn args = do
  traversal <- recognizeForm fn args
  guard (Array.length traversal.args >= traversal.callbackOffset)
  guard (Array.length traversal.args <= traversal.callbackOffset + 2)
  pure traversal

recognizeForm :: TcoExpr -> Array TcoExpr -> Maybe Traversal
recognizeForm fn args = case unwrapTcoExpr fn of
  Accessor dictionary (GetProp "traverse") -> do
    guard (isNamed "Data.Traversable" "traversableArray" dictionary)
    applicative <- Array.index args 0
    plan <- applicativePlan applicative
    -- Retain the dictionary getter before the supplied arguments, just as for
    -- an ordinary method call. Reading this known field has no extra effects.
    pure { indexed: false, callbackOffset: 2, args: Array.cons dictionary args, plan }
  _ -> do
    { mbMod, name } <- qualifiedTarget fn
    if mbMod == Just (ModuleName "Data.Traversable") && name == "traverseArrayImpl" then do
      applyFn <- Array.index args 0
      mapFn <- Array.index args 1
      pureFn <- Array.index args 2
      appendFn <- Array.index args 3
      plan <- ffiPlan applyFn mapFn pureFn
      guard (isMethod "Data.Semigroup" "append" "Data.Semigroup" "semigroupArray" appendFn)
      pure { indexed: false, callbackOffset: 4, args, plan }
    else do
      let indexed = mbMod == Just (ModuleName "Data.TraversableWithIndex")
      guard (if indexed then name == "traverseWithIndexDefault" || name == "traverseWithIndex"
        else mbMod == Just (ModuleName "Data.Traversable") && name == "traverse")
      dictionary <- Array.index args 0
      applicative <- Array.index args 1
      guard (if indexed then isNamed "Data.TraversableWithIndex" "traversableWithIndexArray" dictionary
        else isNamed "Data.Traversable" "traversableArray" dictionary)
      plan <- applicativePlan applicative
      pure { indexed, callbackOffset: 2, args, plan }

isNamed :: String -> String -> TcoExpr -> Boolean
isNamed mod name expr = case qualifiedTarget expr of
  Just target -> target.mbMod == Just (ModuleName mod) && target.name == name
  Nothing -> false

isMethod :: String -> String -> String -> String -> TcoExpr -> Boolean
isMethod mod name dictMod dictName expression =
  let
    Tuple fn spine = collectGoSpine expression
    args = getGoSpineArgs spine
  in isNamed mod name fn && case args of
    [ dictionary ] -> isNamed dictMod dictName dictionary
    _ -> false

-- Dictionary getters and callback construction run at the current application
-- stage, including when the input is absent and the result is a reusable closure.
-- Only the callback position may bypass the ordinary boxed function ABI.
captureArguments :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> Traversal -> Arguments
captureArguments translate context nextId traversal =
  CallArguments.capture { prefix: traversal.plan.prefix <> "_arg_", markUsed: true }
    translateArgument nextId traversal.args
  where
  translateArgument index currentId arg =
    case if index == traversal.callbackOffset then nativeCallback translate context currentId traversal.indexed arg else Nothing of
      Just native -> native
      Nothing -> translate (childContext context Nothing) currentId arg

emitLoop :: ExprContext -> Traversal -> Arguments -> ExprResult
emitLoop { metadata, codegenStateRef, modNameStr } { indexed, callbackOffset, args, plan } captured =
  let
    argument index = fromMaybe (rawGo "nil") (Array.index captured.exprs index)
    argumentType index = fromMaybe TypeValue (Array.index captured.exprTypes index)
    hasCallback = Array.length args > callbackOffset
    hasInput = Array.length args > callbackOffset + 1
    callbackType = if hasCallback then argumentType callbackOffset else TypeValue
    callback = if hasCallback then argument callbackOffset else GoVar callbackName
    callbackResultType = case callbackType of
      TypeFunc _ resultType -> resultType
      _ -> TypeValue
    suffix = show captured.nextId
    callbackName = plan.prefix <> "_callback_" <> suffix
    inputName = plan.prefix <> "_input_" <> suffix
    valuesName = plan.prefix <> "_values_" <> suffix
    outputName = plan.prefix <> "_output_" <> suffix
    indexName = plan.prefix <> "_index_" <> suffix
    valueName = plan.prefix <> "_value_" <> suffix
    resultName = plan.prefix <> "_result_" <> suffix
    errorName = plan.prefix <> "_firstError_" <> suffix
    failedName = plan.prefix <> "_failed_" <> suffix
    input = if hasInput then argument (callbackOffset + 1) else GoVar inputName
    inputType = if hasInput then argumentType (callbackOffset + 1) else TypeValue
    source = case inputType of
      TypeNativeArray elementType -> { expr: input, elementType }
      _ ->
        { expr: rawArray input
        , elementType: TypeValue
        }
    adtModule = Just (ModuleName plan.moduleName)
    result = { expr: GoVar resultName, exprType: callbackResultType, stmts: StmtEmpty, nextId: captured.nextId }
    tag name = (AdtExprs.isTag metadata codegenStateRef modNameStr adtModule name result).expr
    payload = AdtExprs.getField metadata codegenStateRef modNameStr
      { moduleName: adtModule, ctorName: plan.success, index: 0 }
      { expr: GoVar resultName, exprType: callbackResultType, sourceType: plan.sourceType }
    prepared = AdtExprs.prepareSaturated metadata modNameStr adtModule plan.success plan.sourceType
    arrayValue = boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr (GoVar outputName) (TypeNativeArray TypeValue)
    success = AdtExprs.saturated codegenStateRef prepared { exprs: [ arrayValue ], exprTypes: [ TypeValue ] }
    boxedSuccess = boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr success.expr success.exprType
    indexExpr = GoCall (GoVar "int64") [ GoVar indexName ]
    value = boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr (GoVar valueName) source.elementType
    callbackCall = case callbackType of
      TypeFunc _ _ -> GoCall callback (if indexed then [ indexExpr, value ] else [ value ])
      _ -> applyBoxed callback
        (if indexed then [ GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Int") [ indexExpr ], value ] else [ value ])
    loop =
      [ GoAssign resultName callbackCall
      , GoIfElse (tag plan.success)
          [ GoMutate (outputName <> "[" <> indexName <> "]") (boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr payload.expr payload.exprType) ]
          [ GoIfElse (tag plan.failure)
              [ GoIfElse (GoPrefixOp "!" (GoVar failedName))
                  [ GoMutate errorName (boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr (GoVar resultName) callbackResultType)
                  , GoMutate failedName (rawGo "true")
                  ] []
              ]
              [ GoCall (GoVar "panic") [ GoString "Failed pattern match" ] ]
          ]
      ]
    -- Keep invoking the callback after Left/Nothing. The original strict map evaluates
    -- every element before sequence selects the first error.
    body =
      [ GoAssign valuesName source.expr
      , GoAssign outputName (GoCall (GoVar "make") [ rawGo "[]gopurs_runtime.Value", GoCall (GoVar "len") [ GoVar valuesName ] ])
      , GoAssign errorName (rawGo "gopurs_runtime.Value{}")
      , GoAssign failedName (rawGo "false")
      , GoForRange (indexName <> ", " <> valueName <> " := range " <> valuesName) loop
      , GoIfElse (GoVar failedName) [ GoReturn (GoVar errorName) ] []
      ]
    expression = if not hasCallback then
      GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Func2")
        [ GoFuncLit [ Tuple callbackName TypeValue, Tuple inputName TypeValue ] body boxedSuccess TypeValue ]
      else if not hasInput then
      GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Func")
        [ GoFuncLit [ Tuple inputName TypeValue ] body boxedSuccess TypeValue ]
      else GoCall (GoFuncLit [] body boxedSuccess TypeValue) []
  in
    { stmts: captured.stmts
    , expr: expression
    , exprType: TypeValue
    , nextId: captured.nextId + 1
    }
  where
  rawArray input = GoPrefixOp "*" (GoCall (rawGo "(*[]gopurs_runtime.Value)") [ GoSelector input "UnsafePtr" ])

-- This callback is consumed only by the known traversal, so it needs no boxed
-- function ABI. Adjacent lambdas are values: capturing them here preserves the
-- original evaluation stage, including when the traversal is partially applied.
-- Do not cross a let/call between lambdas: its evaluation belongs to each first
-- application. The ordinary callback path retains that behavior.
nativeCallback :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> Boolean -> TcoExpr -> Maybe ExprResult
nativeCallback translate context nextId indexed callback = case unwrapTcoExpr callback of
  Abs args body -> do
    let
      grouped = collectCurriedAbs args body
      parameterTypes = if indexed then [ TypeInt64, TypeValue ] else [ TypeValue ]
    guard (NonEmptyArray.length grouped.args == Array.length parameterTypes)
    let
      names = map (\(Tuple ident level) -> localId ident level) (NonEmptyArray.toArray grouped.args)
      params = Array.zip names parameterTypes
      bound = bindParameters params context.bound
      expectedResult = map _.fRet (extractFuncType callback)
      result = translate
        (context
          { depth = context.depth + 1
          , bound = bound
          , tcoIdent = Nothing
          , loopCtx = []
          , options = { isTail: true, inEffectBlock: false }
          , mbExpectedExprType = expectedResult
          , mbExpectedGoType = Nothing
          }) nextId grouped.body
    pure
      { stmts: StmtEmpty
      , expr: GoFuncLit params (flattenStmts result.stmts) result.expr result.exprType
      , exprType: TypeFunc parameterTypes result.exprType
      , nextId: result.nextId
      }
  _ -> Nothing

module Gopurs.BindingExprs
  ( nonRecursive
  , recursive
  ) where

import Prelude
import Data.Array as Array
import Data.Array.NonEmpty (NonEmptyArray, toArray)
import Data.Foldable (foldMap, foldl)
import Data.Map as Map
import Data.Maybe (Maybe(..), fromMaybe)
import Data.Newtype (unwrap)
import Data.Traversable (traverse)
import Data.Tuple (Tuple(..), fst, snd)
import Effect.Ref as Ref
import Effect.Unsafe (unsafePerformEffect)
import Gopurs.CallAnalysis (extractUncurriedAbs)
import Gopurs.ExprAnalysis (extractExprFuncType, functionResultAfter, getExprType, printTcoExprShape, unwrapTcoExpr)
import Gopurs.ExprContext (ExprContext, ExprResult, LocalEnv, TranslateExpr, StmtTree(..), bindParameters, childContext)
import Gopurs.GoAst (rawGo, GoExpr(..), GoType(..), goTypeToStr, sanitizeName)
import Gopurs.GoConversions (coerceGoExpr)
import Gopurs.GoTypes (exprTypeToGoType, isCompositeGoType, printExprType)
import Gopurs.GoFunctions (loopParameters)
import Gopurs.LocalWorkers as LocalWorkers
import Gopurs.ImmediateFfiEffects as ImmediateFfiEffects
import Gopurs.Printer (printGoExpr)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Codegen.Tco (TcoExpr(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.CoreFn (Ident(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.FreeVars (localId)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Syntax (BackendSyntax(Local), Level)

nonRecursive :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> Maybe Ident -> Level -> TcoExpr -> TcoExpr -> ExprResult
nonRecursive translate context nextId mbIdent lvl binding body =
  case ImmediateFfiEffects.translate translate context nextId mbIdent lvl binding body of
    Just result -> result
    Nothing -> nonRecursiveBinding translate context nextId mbIdent lvl binding body

nonRecursiveBinding :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> Maybe Ident -> Level -> TcoExpr -> TcoExpr -> ExprResult
nonRecursiveBinding translate context@{ metadata, codegenStateRef, depth, modNameStr, moduleFunctions, bound } nextId mbIdent lvl binding body =
  let
    originalName = localId mbIdent lvl
    name = originalName <> "_" <> show nextId
    expectedGoTypeFromAst = exprTypeToGoType metadata.sharedRecords metadata.pointerAdtPaths metadata.enumAdts metadata.elidedCtors modNameStr (getExprType binding)

    mbFunc = extractUncurriedAbs binding
  in
    case mbFunc of
      Just abs | Array.length abs.args > 0 ->
        let
          params = LocalWorkers.parameters context abs.args binding
          loopBound = bindParameters params bound
          resBodyMut = translate (context { depth = (depth + 1), bound = loopBound, tcoIdent = (Just name), loopCtx = [], options = { isTail: true, inEffectBlock: false }, mbExpectedExprType = Nothing, mbExpectedGoType = Nothing }) (nextId + 1) abs.body
          -- The binding is non-recursive: infer its native result before
          -- publishing the signature to callers. Only its curried wrapper
          -- crosses the Value boundary, which can otherwise copy whole lists.
          trueFRet = resBodyMut.exprType
          localModuleFunctions = Map.insert name (LocalWorkers.signature context name params trueFRet) moduleFunctions
          keepWrapper = LocalWorkers.needsWrapper originalName (Array.length params) body
          worker = LocalWorkers.emit translate context name params keepWrapper Nothing resBodyMut

          newBound = Map.insert originalName { name, goType: TypeValue } bound
          resBodyOuter = translate (context { depth = (depth + 1), moduleFunctions = localModuleFunctions, bound = newBound, tcoIdent = Nothing, mbExpectedExprType = Nothing }) resBodyMut.nextId body
        in
          { stmts: foldMap StmtLeaf (worker.declarations <> worker.assignments) <> resBodyOuter.stmts, expr: resBodyOuter.expr, exprType: resBodyOuter.exprType, nextId: resBodyOuter.nextId }

      _ ->
        let
          -- An identity continuation consumes this binding as the enclosing
          -- result. Propagate only that concrete ABI, never an unrelated
          -- parent's expectation into arbitrary let-bound computations.
          bindingExpected = case unwrapTcoExpr body of
            Local bodyIdent bodyLevel | bodyIdent == mbIdent && bodyLevel == lvl -> context.mbExpectedGoType
            _ -> Nothing
          resBinding = translate (context { depth = (depth + 1), tcoIdent = Nothing, loopCtx = [], options = { isTail: false, inEffectBlock: false }, mbExpectedExprType = Nothing, mbExpectedGoType = bindingExpected }) (nextId + 1) binding
          -- Keep a composite producer's boxed representation across the let.
          -- Native consumers adapt their own arguments; generic consumers and
          -- captured callbacks can reuse the immutable value directly.
          actualGoType = fromMaybe
            ( if expectedGoTypeFromAst == TypeValue
                || (resBinding.exprType == TypeValue && isCompositeGoType expectedGoTypeFromAst)
              then resBinding.exprType
              else expectedGoTypeFromAst
            )
            bindingExpected
          newBound = Map.insert originalName { name, goType: actualGoType } bound
          resBody = translate (context { depth = (depth + 1), bound = newBound, tcoIdent = Nothing }) resBinding.nextId body
          letStmt =
            if actualGoType == resBinding.exprType then
              StmtLeaf (GoAssign name resBinding.expr)
            else
              StmtLeaf (rawGo ("var " <> name <> " " <> goTypeToStr actualGoType <> " = " <> printGoExpr (coerceGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr resBinding.expr resBinding.exprType actualGoType)))
        in
          { stmts: resBinding.stmts <> StmtLeaf (rawGo ("// TAST (Let): " <> name <> " shape=" <> printTcoExprShape binding <> " bindingType=" <> printExprType (getExprType binding))) <> letStmt <> resBody.stmts, expr: resBody.expr, exprType: resBody.exprType, nextId: resBody.nextId }

recursive :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> TcoExpr -> Level -> NonEmptyArray (Tuple Ident TcoExpr) -> TcoExpr -> ExprResult
recursive translate context@{ metadata, depth, modNameStr, recVars, moduleFunctions } nextId (TcoExpr tcoAnalysis _) lvl bindings body =
  let
    allocated = allocateRecursive context nextId lvl (toArray bindings)
    combinedRecVars = recVars <> map (\(Tuple (Ident i) _) -> sanitizeName i) (toArray bindings)

    isLoop = (unwrap tcoAnalysis).role.isLoop
    mutRecBinds =
      if isLoop then
        traverse (\(Tuple (Ident name) val) -> map (\abs -> { ident: sanitizeName name, args: abs.args, body: abs.body, val }) (extractUncurriedAbs val)) (toArray bindings)
      else Nothing
  in
    case mutRecBinds of
      Just fns ->
        let
          -- Resolve parameters once, then publish every provisional signature
          -- before translating any body. The annotated return is provisional:
          -- bodies refine the function table in source order.
          workers = map
            ( \fn ->
                let
                  oldName = localId (Just (Ident fn.ident)) lvl
                  boundInfo = fromMaybe { name: oldName, goType: TypeValue } (Map.lookup oldName allocated.newBound)
                  newName = boundInfo.name
                  params = LocalWorkers.parameters context fn.args fn.val
                  -- The annotation flattens function-valued results into its
                  -- argument list. Only consume the worker's actual binders:
                  -- a recursive lookup may return a function still to apply.
                  expectedReturn = map (functionResultAfter (Array.length fn.args)) (extractExprFuncType (getExprType fn.val))
                  resultType = case expectedReturn of
                    Just ty -> exprTypeToGoType metadata.sharedRecords metadata.pointerAdtPaths metadata.enumAdts metadata.elidedCtors modNameStr ty
                    Nothing -> TypeValue
                in
                  { oldName, newName, params, expectedReturn, resultType, body: fn.body }
            )
            fns
          published = foldl
            (\acc worker ->
              { functions: Map.insert worker.newName (LocalWorkers.signature context worker.newName worker.params worker.resultType) acc.functions
              -- The local value is the boxed curried wrapper. Saturated calls
              -- obtain the native ABI from the separate function table.
              , bound: Map.insert worker.oldName { name: worker.newName, goType: TypeValue } acc.bound
              })
            { functions: moduleFunctions, bound: allocated.newBound }
            workers

          translatedWorkers = foldl
            ( \acc worker ->
                let
                  { oldName, newName, params } = worker
                  currentLoopCtx = [ { ident: newName, loopParams: map fst (loopParameters params), goTypes: map snd params } ]
                  -- Peer bindings keep the provisional view; only the function
                  -- table sees results inferred for earlier bodies in the group.
                  loopBound = bindParameters params published.bound
                  resBodyMut = translate (context { depth = (depth + 1), recVars = combinedRecVars, moduleFunctions = acc.moduleFunctions, bound = loopBound, tcoIdent = (Just newName), loopCtx = currentLoopCtx, options = { isTail: true, inEffectBlock: false }, mbExpectedExprType = worker.expectedReturn, mbExpectedGoType = Just worker.resultType }) acc.nextId worker.body
                  trueFRet = resBodyMut.exprType
                  keepWrapper = LocalWorkers.needsWrapper oldName (Array.length params) body
                    || Array.any (\(Tuple _ binding) -> LocalWorkers.needsWrapper oldName (Array.length params) binding) (toArray bindings)
                  emitted = LocalWorkers.emit translate (context { bound = published.bound }) newName params keepWrapper (Just worker.body) resBodyMut
                  newFunctions = Map.insert newName (LocalWorkers.signature context newName params trueFRet) acc.moduleFunctions
                  newBound2 = Map.insert oldName { name: newName, goType: TypeValue } acc.newBound
                in
                  { declarations: acc.declarations <> emitted.declarations, stmts: acc.stmts <> emitted.assignments, nextId: resBodyMut.nextId, moduleFunctions: newFunctions, newBound: newBound2 }
            )
            { declarations: [], stmts: [], nextId: allocated.nextId, moduleFunctions: published.functions, newBound: published.bound }
            workers

          resBodyOuter = translate (context { depth = (depth + 1), recVars = combinedRecVars, moduleFunctions = translatedWorkers.moduleFunctions, bound = translatedWorkers.newBound, tcoIdent = Nothing, mbExpectedExprType = Nothing }) translatedWorkers.nextId body
        in
          -- Every function in the recursive group must be in scope
          -- before emitting bodies that can refer to its peers.
          { stmts: foldMap StmtLeaf (translatedWorkers.declarations <> translatedWorkers.stmts) <> resBodyOuter.stmts, expr: resBodyOuter.expr, exprType: resBodyOuter.exprType, nextId: resBodyOuter.nextId }

      Nothing ->
        initializeRecursiveValues translate (context { recVars = combinedRecVars }) isLoop allocated (toArray bindings) body

type RecursiveAllocation =
  { newBound :: LocalEnv
  , newNames :: Array { oldName :: String, newName :: String }
  , nextId :: Int
  }

-- Reserve both local and module-wide identifiers before inspecting the group.
-- Every initializer receives the same complete set of renamed bindings.
allocateRecursive :: ExprContext -> Int -> Level -> Array (Tuple Ident TcoExpr) -> RecursiveAllocation
allocateRecursive { metadata, codegenStateRef, modNameStr, bound } nextId lvl =
  foldl
    (\acc (Tuple ident value) ->
      let
        oldName = localId (Just ident) lvl
        globalId = unsafePerformEffect do
          state <- Ref.read codegenStateRef
          Ref.modify_ (\current -> current { globalId = current.globalId + 1 }) codegenStateRef
          pure state.globalId
        newName = oldName <> "_" <> show acc.nextId <> "_" <> show globalId
        goType = exprTypeToGoType metadata.sharedRecords metadata.pointerAdtPaths metadata.enumAdts metadata.elidedCtors modNameStr (getExprType value)
      in
        { newBound: Map.insert oldName { name: newName, goType } acc.newBound
        , newNames: Array.snoc acc.newNames { oldName, newName }
        , nextId: acc.nextId + 1
        })
    { newBound: bound, newNames: [], nextId }

-- An early read must not observe Go's zero value. Initializers and the closures
-- they create read through cells; publish each pointer only after its complete
-- initializer and coercion. The enclosing body uses the initialized values.
initializeRecursiveValues :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Boolean -> RecursiveAllocation -> Array (Tuple Ident TcoExpr) -> TcoExpr -> ExprResult
initializeRecursiveValues translate context@{ codegenStateRef, modNameStr, depth } isLoop allocated bindings body =
  let
    initializingBound = foldl
      (\acc name -> Map.update (\binding -> Just (binding { name = "(*" <> name.newName <> "_cell)" })) name.oldName acc)
      allocated.newBound allocated.newNames
    initialized = foldl
      (\acc (Tuple (Tuple _ value) name) ->
        let
          valueResult = translate ((childContext context Nothing) { bound = initializingBound }) acc.nextId value
          expected = (fromMaybe { name: name.newName, goType: TypeValue } (Map.lookup name.oldName allocated.newBound)).goType
          assigned = coerceGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr valueResult.expr valueResult.exprType expected
        in
          { stmts: acc.stmts <> valueResult.stmts
              <> StmtLeaf (GoMutate name.newName assigned)
              <> StmtLeaf (GoMutate (name.newName <> "_cell") (rawGo ("&" <> name.newName)))
          , values: Array.snoc acc.values { name: name.newName, goType: expected }
          , nextId: valueResult.nextId
          })
      { stmts: StmtEmpty, values: [], nextId: allocated.nextId }
      (Array.zip bindings allocated.newNames)
    declarations = map (\value -> rawGo ("var " <> value.name <> " " <> goTypeToStr value.goType <> "\n_ = " <> value.name
      <> "\nvar " <> value.name <> "_cell *" <> goTypeToStr value.goType <> "\n_ = " <> value.name <> "_cell"
      <> "\n// FALLBACK TCO: isLoop=" <> show isLoop <> " len=" <> show (Array.length bindings))) initialized.values
    result = translate (context { depth = depth + 1, bound = allocated.newBound, tcoIdent = Nothing }) initialized.nextId body
  in
    { stmts: foldMap StmtLeaf declarations <> initialized.stmts <> result.stmts, expr: result.expr, exprType: result.exprType, nextId: result.nextId }

module Gopurs.ArrayTraverse
  ( emit
  , recognizeMaybe
  ) where

import Prelude

import Control.Alternative (guard)
import Data.Array as Array
import Data.Array.NonEmpty as NonEmptyArray
import Data.Maybe (Maybe(..), fromMaybe)
import Data.Tuple (Tuple(..))
import Gopurs.AdtExprs as AdtExprs
import Gopurs.ArrayTraverseTotal as ArrayTraverseTotal
import Gopurs.CallAnalysis (collectCurriedAbs, collectGoSpine, getGoSpineArgs, qualifiedTarget)
import Gopurs.CallArguments (Arguments, applyBoxed)
import Gopurs.CallArguments as CallArguments
import Gopurs.ExprAnalysis (extractFuncType, unwrapTcoExpr)
import Gopurs.ExprContext (ExprContext, ExprResult, StmtTree(..), TranslateExpr, bindParameters, childContext, flattenStmts)
import Gopurs.GoAst (rawGo, GoExpr(..), GoType(..))
import Gopurs.GoConversions (boxGoExpr)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Codegen.Tco (TcoExpr)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.CoreFn (ExprType(..), ModuleName(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.FreeVars (localId)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Syntax (BackendAccessor(GetProp), BackendSyntax(Abs, Accessor))

-- The known Array/Either and Array/Maybe instances permit a strict loop instead of building
-- intermediate arrays through generic applicative composition. PBO may expose
-- either the class method, its static dictionary accessor, or the FFI worker.
-- Every form must prove the same dictionaries; arbitrary Applicatives stay on
-- their existing traversal path.
emit :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> TcoExpr -> Array TcoExpr -> Maybe ExprResult
emit translate context nextId fn args = do
  traversal <- recognize fn args
  pure case if traversal.plan.moduleName == "Data.Maybe" then
    ArrayTraverseTotal.emit translate context nextId traversal.indexed traversal.callbackOffset traversal.args
    else Nothing of
      Just result -> result
      Nothing -> emitLoop context traversal (captureArguments translate context nextId traversal)

type ApplicativePlan =
  { moduleName :: String
  , sourceType :: ExprType
  , success :: String
  , failure :: String
  , prefix :: String
  }

type Traversal = { indexed :: Boolean, callbackOffset :: Int, args :: Array TcoExpr, plan :: ApplicativePlan }

-- Consumers reuse the exact canonical dictionary proof, not the spelling of a
-- traversal method alone. They impose their own saturation/phase restrictions.
recognizeMaybe :: TcoExpr -> Array TcoExpr -> Maybe { indexed :: Boolean, callbackOffset :: Int, args :: Array TcoExpr }
recognizeMaybe fn args = do
  traversal <- recognize fn args
  guard (traversal.plan.moduleName == "Data.Maybe")
  pure { indexed: traversal.indexed, callbackOffset: traversal.callbackOffset, args: traversal.args }

-- These are the canonical library constructors, never inferred from a custom
-- dictionary's shape. The regular ADT emitter handles nullable Maybe layouts.
applicativePlan :: TcoExpr -> Maybe ApplicativePlan
applicativePlan dictionary
  | isNamed "Data.Either" "applicativeEither" dictionary = Just eitherPlan
  | isNamed "Data.Maybe" "applicativeMaybe" dictionary = Just maybePlan
  | otherwise = Nothing

eitherPlan :: ApplicativePlan
eitherPlan =
  { moduleName: "Data.Either"
  , sourceType: ADT "Data.Either.Either" [ "Data", "Either", "Either" ] [ Any, Any ]
  , success: "Right", failure: "Left", prefix: "traverseEither"
  }

maybePlan :: ApplicativePlan
maybePlan =
  { moduleName: "Data.Maybe"
  , sourceType: ADT "Data.Maybe.Maybe" [ "Data", "Maybe", "Maybe" ] [ Any ]
  , success: "Just", failure: "Nothing", prefix: "traverseMaybe"
  }

ffiPlan :: TcoExpr -> TcoExpr -> TcoExpr -> Maybe ApplicativePlan
ffiPlan applyFn mapFn pureFn =
  let
    matches mod suffix = isMethod "Control.Apply" "apply" mod ("apply" <> suffix) applyFn
      && isMethod "Data.Functor" "map" mod ("functor" <> suffix) mapFn
      && isMethod "Control.Applicative" "pure" mod ("applicative" <> suffix) pureFn
  in
    if matches "Data.Either" "Either" then Just eitherPlan
    else if matches "Data.Maybe" "Maybe" then Just maybePlan
    else Nothing

recognize :: TcoExpr -> Array TcoExpr -> Maybe Traversal
recognize fn args = do
  traversal <- recognizeForm fn args
  guard (Array.length traversal.args >= traversal.callbackOffset)
  guard (Array.length traversal.args <= traversal.callbackOffset + 2)
  pure traversal

recognizeForm :: TcoExpr -> Array TcoExpr -> Maybe Traversal
recognizeForm fn args = case unwrapTcoExpr fn of
  Accessor dictionary (GetProp "traverse") -> do
    guard (isNamed "Data.Traversable" "traversableArray" dictionary)
    applicative <- Array.index args 0
    plan <- applicativePlan applicative
    -- Retain the dictionary getter before the supplied arguments, just as for
    -- an ordinary method call. Reading this known field has no extra effects.
    pure { indexed: false, callbackOffset: 2, args: Array.cons dictionary args, plan }
  _ -> do
    { mbMod, name } <- qualifiedTarget fn
    if mbMod == Just (ModuleName "Data.Traversable") && name == "traverseArrayImpl" then do
      applyFn <- Array.index args 0
      mapFn <- Array.index args 1
      pureFn <- Array.index args 2
      appendFn <- Array.index args 3
      plan <- ffiPlan applyFn mapFn pureFn
      guard (isMethod "Data.Semigroup" "append" "Data.Semigroup" "semigroupArray" appendFn)
      pure { indexed: false, callbackOffset: 4, args, plan }
    else do
      let indexed = mbMod == Just (ModuleName "Data.TraversableWithIndex")
      guard (if indexed then name == "traverseWithIndexDefault" || name == "traverseWithIndex"
        else mbMod == Just (ModuleName "Data.Traversable") && name == "traverse")
      dictionary <- Array.index args 0
      applicative <- Array.index args 1
      guard (if indexed then isNamed "Data.TraversableWithIndex" "traversableWithIndexArray" dictionary
        else isNamed "Data.Traversable" "traversableArray" dictionary)
      plan <- applicativePlan applicative
      pure { indexed, callbackOffset: 2, args, plan }

isNamed :: String -> String -> TcoExpr -> Boolean
isNamed mod name expr = case qualifiedTarget expr of
  Just target -> target.mbMod == Just (ModuleName mod) && target.name == name
  Nothing -> false

isMethod :: String -> String -> String -> String -> TcoExpr -> Boolean
isMethod mod name dictMod dictName expression =
  let
    Tuple fn spine = collectGoSpine expression
    args = getGoSpineArgs spine
  in isNamed mod name fn && case args of
    [ dictionary ] -> isNamed dictMod dictName dictionary
    _ -> false

-- Dictionary getters and callback construction run at the current application
-- stage, including when the input is absent and the result is a reusable closure.
-- Only the callback position may bypass the ordinary boxed function ABI.
captureArguments :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> Traversal -> Arguments
captureArguments translate context nextId traversal =
  CallArguments.capture { prefix: traversal.plan.prefix <> "_arg_", markUsed: true }
    translateArgument nextId traversal.args
  where
  translateArgument index currentId arg =
    case if index == traversal.callbackOffset then nativeCallback translate context currentId traversal.indexed arg else Nothing of
      Just native -> native
      Nothing -> translate (childContext context Nothing) currentId arg

emitLoop :: ExprContext -> Traversal -> Arguments -> ExprResult
emitLoop { metadata, codegenStateRef, modNameStr } { indexed, callbackOffset, args, plan } captured =
  let
    argument index = fromMaybe (rawGo "nil") (Array.index captured.exprs index)
    argumentType index = fromMaybe TypeValue (Array.index captured.exprTypes index)
    hasCallback = Array.length args > callbackOffset
    hasInput = Array.length args > callbackOffset + 1
    callbackType = if hasCallback then argumentType callbackOffset else TypeValue
    callback = if hasCallback then argument callbackOffset else GoVar callbackName
    callbackResultType = case callbackType of
      TypeFunc _ resultType -> resultType
      _ -> TypeValue
    suffix = show captured.nextId
    callbackName = plan.prefix <> "_callback_" <> suffix
    inputName = plan.prefix <> "_input_" <> suffix
    valuesName = plan.prefix <> "_values_" <> suffix
    outputName = plan.prefix <> "_output_" <> suffix
    indexName = plan.prefix <> "_index_" <> suffix
    valueName = plan.prefix <> "_value_" <> suffix
    resultName = plan.prefix <> "_result_" <> suffix
    errorName = plan.prefix <> "_firstError_" <> suffix
    failedName = plan.prefix <> "_failed_" <> suffix
    input = if hasInput then argument (callbackOffset + 1) else GoVar inputName
    inputType = if hasInput then argumentType (callbackOffset + 1) else TypeValue
    source = case inputType of
      TypeNativeArray elementType -> { expr: input, elementType }
      _ ->
        { expr: rawArray input
        , elementType: TypeValue
        }
    adtModule = Just (ModuleName plan.moduleName)
    result = { expr: GoVar resultName, exprType: callbackResultType, stmts: StmtEmpty, nextId: captured.nextId }
    tag name = (AdtExprs.isTag metadata codegenStateRef modNameStr adtModule name result).expr
    payload = AdtExprs.getField metadata codegenStateRef modNameStr
      { moduleName: adtModule, ctorName: plan.success, index: 0 }
      { expr: GoVar resultName, exprType: callbackResultType, sourceType: plan.sourceType }
    prepared = AdtExprs.prepareSaturated metadata modNameStr adtModule plan.success plan.sourceType
    arrayValue = boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr (GoVar outputName) (TypeNativeArray TypeValue)
    success = AdtExprs.saturated codegenStateRef prepared { exprs: [ arrayValue ], exprTypes: [ TypeValue ] }
    boxedSuccess = boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr success.expr success.exprType
    indexExpr = GoCall (GoVar "int64") [ GoVar indexName ]
    value = boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr (GoVar valueName) source.elementType
    callbackCall = case callbackType of
      TypeFunc _ _ -> GoCall callback (if indexed then [ indexExpr, value ] else [ value ])
      _ -> applyBoxed callback
        (if indexed then [ GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Int") [ indexExpr ], value ] else [ value ])
    loop =
      [ GoAssign resultName callbackCall
      , GoIfElse (tag plan.success)
          [ GoMutate (outputName <> "[" <> indexName <> "]") (boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr payload.expr payload.exprType) ]
          [ GoIfElse (tag plan.failure)
              [ GoIfElse (GoPrefixOp "!" (GoVar failedName))
                  [ GoMutate errorName (boxGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr (GoVar resultName) callbackResultType)
                  , GoMutate failedName (rawGo "true")
                  ] []
              ]
              [ GoCall (GoVar "panic") [ GoString "Failed pattern match" ] ]
          ]
      ]
    -- Keep invoking the callback after Left/Nothing. The original strict map evaluates
    -- every element before sequence selects the first error.
    body =
      [ GoAssign valuesName source.expr
      , GoAssign outputName (GoCall (GoVar "make") [ rawGo "[]gopurs_runtime.Value", GoCall (GoVar "len") [ GoVar valuesName ] ])
      , GoAssign errorName (rawGo "gopurs_runtime.Value{}")
      , GoAssign failedName (rawGo "false")
      , GoForRange (indexName <> ", " <> valueName <> " := range " <> valuesName) loop
      , GoIfElse (GoVar failedName) [ GoReturn (GoVar errorName) ] []
      ]
    expression = if not hasCallback then
      GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Func2")
        [ GoFuncLit [ Tuple callbackName TypeValue, Tuple inputName TypeValue ] body boxedSuccess TypeValue ]
      else if not hasInput then
      GoCall (GoSelector (GoVar "gopurs_runtime") "Func")
        [ GoFuncLit [ Tuple inputName TypeValue ] body boxedSuccess TypeValue ]
      else GoCall (GoFuncLit [] body boxedSuccess TypeValue) []
  in
    { stmts: captured.stmts
    , expr: expression
    , exprType: TypeValue
    , nextId: captured.nextId + 1
    }
  where
  rawArray input = GoPrefixOp "*" (GoCall (rawGo "(*[]gopurs_runtime.Value)") [ GoSelector input "UnsafePtr" ])

-- This callback is consumed only by the known traversal, so it needs no boxed
-- function ABI. Adjacent lambdas are values: capturing them here preserves the
-- original evaluation stage, including when the traversal is partially applied.
-- Do not cross a let/call between lambdas: its evaluation belongs to each first
-- application. The ordinary callback path retains that behavior.
nativeCallback :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> Boolean -> TcoExpr -> Maybe ExprResult
nativeCallback translate context nextId indexed callback = case unwrapTcoExpr callback of
  Abs args body -> do
    let
      grouped = collectCurriedAbs args body
      parameterTypes = if indexed then [ TypeInt64, TypeValue ] else [ TypeValue ]
    guard (NonEmptyArray.length grouped.args == Array.length parameterTypes)
    let
      names = map (\(Tuple ident level) -> localId ident level) (NonEmptyArray.toArray grouped.args)
      params = Array.zip names parameterTypes
      bound = bindParameters params context.bound
      expectedResult = map _.fRet (extractFuncType callback)
      result = translate
        (context
          { depth = context.depth + 1
          , bound = bound
          , tcoIdent = Nothing
          , loopCtx = []
          , options = { isTail: true, inEffectBlock: false }
          , mbExpectedExprType = expectedResult
          , mbExpectedGoType = Nothing
          }) nextId grouped.body
    pure
      { stmts: StmtEmpty
      , expr: GoFuncLit params (flattenStmts result.stmts) result.expr result.exprType
      , exprType: TypeFunc parameterTypes result.exprType
      , nextId: result.nextId
      }
  _ -> Nothing

module Gopurs.ArrayTraverseFold (emit, justMapper) where

import Prelude

import Control.Alternative (guard)
import Control.Monad.State (evalState)
import Data.Array as Array
import Data.Array.NonEmpty as NEA
import Data.Foldable (foldM)
import Data.Map as Map
import Data.Maybe (Maybe(..), fromMaybe, isJust)
import Data.Newtype (unwrap)
import Data.String as String
import Data.String.Pattern (Pattern(..), Replacement(..))
import Data.Tuple (Tuple(..))
import Gopurs.ArrayIntrinsics.Source (arraySource)
import Gopurs.ArrayProducerFold (onlyCurried)
import Gopurs.ArrayTraverse (recognizeMaybe)
import Gopurs.ArrayTraverseTotal (totalIntegerMaybe)
import Gopurs.CallAnalysis (collectCurriedAbs, collectGoSpine, getGoSpineArgs, qualifiedTarget)
import Gopurs.CallArguments as CallArguments
import Gopurs.ClosedIndexedFolds (closedPrimitiveCallback, validDescriptor)
import Gopurs.CodegenState (ArrayFoldDescriptor)
import Gopurs.ExprAnalysis (extractFuncType, unwrapTcoExpr)
import Gopurs.ExprContext (ExprContext, ExprResult, StmtTree(..), TranslateExpr, bindParameters, childContext, flattenStmts)
import Gopurs.GoAst (GoExpr(..), GoType(..), rawGo)
import Gopurs.GoConversions (coerceGoExpr)
import Gopurs.ImmediateApplications.Scope (freshen, maximumLevel)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Codegen.Tco (TcoExpr(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Codegen.Tco as Tco
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.CoreFn (ExprType(..), Ident(..), ModuleName(..), ProperName(..), Qualified(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.CoreFn as CoreFn
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.FreeVars (localId)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Semantics (NeutralExpr(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Syntax (BackendAccessor(..), BackendOperator(..), BackendOperator1(..), BackendSyntax(..), Level, Pair(..))
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Syntax as Syntax

maybeInt :: ExprType
maybeInt = ADT "Data.Maybe.Maybe" [ "Data", "Maybe", "Maybe" ] [ Int ]

-- The callback must construct Just directly. Its payload is then checked by
-- the existing closed scalar proof, including every nested Typed annotation.
-- Nothing/branches/captures/foreign calls retain the ordinary traversal.
justMapper :: Int -> TcoExpr -> Maybe NeutralExpr
justMapper arity callback = do
  signature <- extractFuncType callback
  guard (signature.fArgs == Array.replicate arity Int && signature.fRet == maybeInt)
  case unwrapTcoExpr callback of
    Abs parameters body -> do
      let grouped = collectCurriedAbs parameters body
      guard (NEA.length grouped.args == arity && totalIntegerMaybe (map (\(Tuple _ level) -> level) (NEA.toArray grouped.args)) grouped.body)
    _ -> Nothing
  mapped <- convert arity callback
  guard (closedPrimitiveCallback arity mapped)
  pure mapped
  where
  convert remaining value = do
    guard (annotated (Func (Array.replicate remaining Int) maybeInt) value)
    case unwrapTcoExpr value of
      Abs parameters body -> do
        let count = NEA.length parameters
        guard (count <= remaining)
        scalar <- if count < remaining then convert (remaining - count) body else do
          guard (annotated maybeInt body)
          case unwrapTcoExpr body of
            CtorSaturated (Qualified (Just (ModuleName "Data.Maybe")) (Ident "Just")) _ (ProperName "Maybe") (Ident "Just") [ Tuple _ payload ] ->
              pure (neutral payload)
            _ -> Nothing
        pure (NeutralExpr (Typed (Func (Array.replicate remaining Int) Int) (NeutralExpr (Abs parameters scalar))))
      _ -> Nothing

-- TAST can retain generic m (t b) around a canonical traversal. Refine those
-- transparent applications against the proved result, but reject any concrete
-- contradiction, including nested Maybe String under an outer Maybe Int.
annotated :: ExprType -> TcoExpr -> Boolean
annotated expected (TcoExpr _ syntax) = case syntax of
  Typed actual value -> compatible expected actual && annotated expected value
  Syntax.TypeApp value _ -> annotated expected value
  _ -> true

compatible :: ExprType -> ExprType -> Boolean
compatible expected actual = isJust (refine expected actual Map.empty)

refine :: ExprType -> ExprType -> Map.Map String ExprType -> Maybe (Map.Map String ExprType)
refine expected actual variables = case expected, actual of
  _, Any -> Just variables
  _, TypeVar name -> bindVariable name expected variables
  Array wanted, Array supplied -> refine wanted supplied variables
  Array wanted, ADT "Prim.Array" [ "Prim", "Array" ] [ supplied ] -> refine wanted supplied variables
  Array wanted, CoreFn.TypeApp (TypeVar name) [ supplied ] -> do
    known <- bindVariable name (ADT "Prim.Array" [ "Prim", "Array" ] []) variables
    refine wanted supplied known
  ADT name path arguments, ADT suppliedName suppliedPath suppliedArguments -> do
    guard (name == suppliedName && path == suppliedPath)
    sameArguments arguments suppliedArguments variables
  ADT name path [ wanted ], CoreFn.TypeApp (TypeVar variable) [ supplied ] -> do
    known <- bindVariable variable (ADT name path []) variables
    refine wanted supplied known
  Func arguments result, Func suppliedArguments suppliedResult -> do
    known <- sameArguments arguments suppliedArguments variables
    refine result suppliedResult known
  _, _ | expected == actual -> Just variables
  _, _ -> Nothing
  where
  sameArguments wanted supplied known = do
    guard (Array.length wanted == Array.length supplied)
    foldM (\current (Tuple left right) -> refine left right current) known (Array.zip wanted supplied)
  bindVariable name value known = case Map.lookup name known of
    Just previous | previous /= value -> Nothing
    _ -> Just (Map.insert name value known)

emit :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> Maybe Ident -> Level -> TcoExpr -> TcoExpr -> Maybe ExprResult
emit translate context nextId mbIdent level producer continuation = do
  guard (Array.null context.recVars && onlyCurried producer)
  let Tuple function spine = collectGoSpine producer
  -- Start with direct class-method forms. FFI methods may contain their own
  -- application stages and are not flattened by this fusion.
  guard (directTraversal function)
  traversal <- recognizeMaybe function (getGoSpineArgs spine)
  guard (Array.length traversal.args == traversal.callbackOffset + 2)
  callback <- Array.index traversal.args traversal.callbackOffset
  input <- Array.index traversal.args (traversal.callbackOffset + 1)
  guard (annotated (Array Int) input)
  guard (annotated (ADT "Data.Maybe.Maybe" [ "Data", "Maybe", "Maybe" ] [ Array Int ]) producer)
  mapper <- justMapper (if traversal.indexed then 2 else 1) callback
  branch <- case unwrapTcoExpr continuation of
    EffectPure value -> do
      -- Do not move traversal work into or out of a deferred effect value.
      guard context.options.inEffectBlock
      guard (annotated (ADT "Effect.Effect" [ "Effect", "Effect" ] [ Int ]) continuation)
      pure value
    _ -> pure continuation
  descriptor <- consumedArray context level branch
  let whole = NeutralExpr (Let mbIdent level (neutral producer) (neutral continuation))
  pure (emitLoop translate context nextId traversal mapper descriptor (maximumLevel whole))

directTraversal :: TcoExpr -> Boolean
directTraversal function = case unwrapTcoExpr function of
  Accessor _ (GetProp "traverse") -> true
  _ -> case qualifiedTarget function of
    Just { mbMod: Just (ModuleName "Data.Traversable"), name: "traverse" } -> true
    Just { mbMod: Just (ModuleName "Data.TraversableWithIndex"), name } -> name == "traverseWithIndex" || name == "traverseWithIndexDefault"
    _ -> false

consumedArray :: ExprContext -> Level -> TcoExpr -> Maybe ArrayFoldDescriptor
consumedArray context level expression = do
  guard (annotated Int expression)
  success <- case unwrapTcoExpr expression of
    Branch branches otherwise -> do
      guard (case unwrapTcoExpr otherwise of
        Fail _ -> true
        _ -> false)
      case NEA.toArray branches of
        [ Pair first firstResult, Pair second secondResult ]
          | tagged "Nothing" first && tagged "Just" second -> Just secondResult
          | tagged "Just" first && tagged "Nothing" second -> Just firstResult
        _ -> Nothing
    _ -> Nothing
  guard (annotated Int success && onlyCurried success)
  let Tuple fn spine = collectGoSpine success
  guard (annotated (Func [ Array Int ] Int) fn)
  case getGoSpineArgs spine of
    [ value ] -> do
      guard (annotated (Array Int) value)
      guard (case unwrapTcoExpr value of
        Accessor object (GetCtorField (Qualified (Just (ModuleName "Data.Maybe")) (Ident "Just")) _ (ProperName "Maybe") (Ident "Just") _ 0) -> sameLocal object
        _ -> false)
    _ -> Nothing
  target <- qualifiedTarget fn
  let local = target.mbMod == Nothing || map (String.replaceAll (Pattern ".") (Replacement "_") <<< unwrap) target.mbMod == Just context.modNameStr
  info <- if local then Map.lookup target.name context.moduleFunctions else do
    owner <- target.mbMod
    Map.lookup (unwrap owner <> "." <> target.name) context.metadata.globalFunctions
  guard (info.arity == 1 && info.fArgs == [ TypeNativeArray TypeInt64 ] && info.fRet == TypeInt64)
  descriptor <- info.arrayFold
  guard (validDescriptor descriptor)
  pure descriptor
  where
  sameLocal object = annotated (ADT "Data.Maybe.Maybe" [ "Data", "Maybe", "Maybe" ] [ Array Int ]) object
    && case unwrapTcoExpr object of
      Local _ actual -> actual == level
      _ -> false
  tagged tag condition = annotated Boolean condition && case unwrapTcoExpr condition of
    PrimOp (Op1 (OpIsTag (Qualified (Just (ModuleName "Data.Maybe")) (Ident name))) object) -> name == tag && sameLocal object
    _ -> false

emitLoop :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> { indexed :: Boolean, callbackOffset :: Int, args :: Array TcoExpr } -> NeutralExpr -> ArrayFoldDescriptor -> Int -> ExprResult
emitLoop translate context nextId traversal mapper descriptor lastLevel =
  let
    start = max lastLevel (maximumLevel descriptor.callback) + nextId + 1
    folded = Tco.analyze [] (evalState (freshen descriptor.callback) start)
    mapped = Tco.analyze [] mapper
    native currentId callback = case unwrapTcoExpr callback of
      Abs parameters callbackBody ->
        let
          grouped = collectCurriedAbs parameters callbackBody
          params = map (\(Tuple name level) -> Tuple (localId name level) TypeInt64) (NEA.toArray grouped.args)
          callbackContext = context { depth = context.depth + 1, bound = bindParameters params context.bound
            , tcoIdent = Nothing, loopCtx = [], options = { isTail: true, inEffectBlock: false }
            , mbExpectedExprType = Just Int, mbExpectedGoType = Just TypeInt64 }
          result = translate callbackContext currentId grouped.body
        in { expr: GoFuncLit params (flattenStmts result.stmts) (integer result.expr result.exprType) TypeInt64, nextId: result.nextId }
      _ -> { expr: rawGo "nil", nextId: currentId }
    captured = CallArguments.capture { prefix: "traverseFold_arg_", markUsed: true }
      (\position currentId argument -> if position == traversal.callbackOffset then
        { stmts: StmtEmpty, expr: rawGo "true", exprType: TypeBool, nextId: currentId }
        else translate (childContext context Nothing) currentId argument) nextId traversal.args
    mapResult = native captured.nextId mapped
    foldResult = native mapResult.nextId folded
    suffix = show foldResult.nextId
    variable label = "traverseFold_" <> label <> "_" <> suffix
    arg position = fromMaybe (rawGo "nil") (Array.index captured.exprs position)
    source = arraySource (case arg (traversal.callbackOffset + 1) of
      GoVar name -> name
      _ -> "") (variable "source") (fromMaybe TypeValue (Array.index captured.exprTypes (traversal.callbackOffset + 1)))
    index = GoCall (GoVar "int64") [ GoVar (variable "index") ]
    value = integer (GoVar (variable "value")) source.elementType
    mappedValue = GoCall (GoVar (variable "map")) (if traversal.indexed then [ index, value ] else [ value ])
    body =
      [ GoAssign (variable "map") mapResult.expr, GoAssign (variable "fold") foldResult.expr
      , GoAssign (variable "result") (GoCall (GoVar "int64") [ GoInt descriptor.seed ])
      , source.assignment
      , GoForRange (variable "index" <> ", " <> variable "value" <> " := range " <> source.target)
          [ GoMutate (variable "result") (GoCall (GoVar (variable "fold")) [ index, GoVar (variable "result"), mappedValue ]) ]
      ]
  in { stmts: captured.stmts, expr: GoCall (GoFuncLit [] body (GoVar (variable "result")) TypeInt64) []
     , exprType: TypeInt64, nextId: foldResult.nextId + 1 }
  where
  integer value from = coerceGoExpr context.codegenStateRef context.modNameStr value from TypeInt64

neutral :: TcoExpr -> NeutralExpr
neutral (TcoExpr _ syntax) = NeutralExpr (map neutral syntax)

import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.FreeVars (localId)
import PureScript.Backend.Optimizer.Syntax (BackendSyntax(Local), Level)

nonRecursive :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> Maybe Ident -> Level -> TcoExpr -> TcoExpr -> ExprResult
nonRecursive translate context nextId mbIdent lvl binding body =
  case ArrayTraverseFold.emit translate context nextId mbIdent lvl binding body of
    Just result -> result
    Nothing -> case ImmediateFfiEffects.translate translate context nextId mbIdent lvl binding body of
      Just result -> result
      Nothing -> nonRecursiveBinding translate context nextId mbIdent lvl binding body

nonRecursiveBinding :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> Maybe Ident -> Level -> TcoExpr -> TcoExpr -> ExprResult
nonRecursiveBinding translate context@{ metadata, codegenStateRef, depth, modNameStr, moduleFunctions, bound } nextId mbIdent lvl binding body =
  let
    originalName = localId mbIdent lvl
    name = originalName <> "_" <> show nextId
    expectedGoTypeFromAst = exprTypeToGoType metadata.sharedRecords metadata.pointerAdtPaths metadata.enumAdts metadata.elidedCtors modNameStr (getExprType binding)

    mbFunc = extractUncurriedAbs binding
  in
    case mbFunc of
      Just abs | Array.length abs.args > 0 ->
        let
          params = LocalWorkers.parameters context abs.args binding
          loopBound = bindParameters params bound
          resBodyMut = translate (context { depth = (depth + 1), bound = loopBound, tcoIdent = (Just name), loopCtx = [], options = { isTail: true, inEffectBlock: false }, mbExpectedExprType = Nothing, mbExpectedGoType = Nothing }) (nextId + 1) abs.body
          -- The binding is non-recursive: infer its native result before
          -- publishing the signature to callers. Only its curried wrapper
          -- crosses the Value boundary, which can otherwise copy whole lists.
          trueFRet = resBodyMut.exprType
          localModuleFunctions = Map.insert name (LocalWorkers.signature context name params trueFRet) moduleFunctions
          keepWrapper = LocalWorkers.needsWrapper originalName (Array.length params) body
          worker = LocalWorkers.emit translate context name params keepWrapper Nothing resBodyMut

          newBound = Map.insert originalName { name, goType: TypeValue } bound
          resBodyOuter = translate (context { depth = (depth + 1), moduleFunctions = localModuleFunctions, bound = newBound, tcoIdent = Nothing, mbExpectedExprType = Nothing }) resBodyMut.nextId body
        in
          { stmts: foldMap StmtLeaf (worker.declarations <> worker.assignments) <> resBodyOuter.stmts, expr: resBodyOuter.expr, exprType: resBodyOuter.exprType, nextId: resBodyOuter.nextId }

      _ ->
        let
          -- An identity continuation consumes this binding as the enclosing
          -- result. Propagate only that concrete ABI, never an unrelated
          -- parent's expectation into arbitrary let-bound computations.
          bindingExpected = case unwrapTcoExpr body of
            Local bodyIdent bodyLevel | bodyIdent == mbIdent && bodyLevel == lvl -> context.mbExpectedGoType
            _ -> Nothing
          resBinding = translate (context { depth = (depth + 1), tcoIdent = Nothing, loopCtx = [], options = { isTail: false, inEffectBlock: false }, mbExpectedExprType = Nothing, mbExpectedGoType = bindingExpected }) (nextId + 1) binding
          -- Keep a composite producer's boxed representation across the let.
          -- Native consumers adapt their own arguments; generic consumers and
          -- captured callbacks can reuse the immutable value directly.
          actualGoType = fromMaybe
            ( if expectedGoTypeFromAst == TypeValue
                || (resBinding.exprType == TypeValue && isCompositeGoType expectedGoTypeFromAst)
              then resBinding.exprType
              else expectedGoTypeFromAst
            )
            bindingExpected
          newBound = Map.insert originalName { name, goType: actualGoType } bound
          resBody = translate (context { depth = (depth + 1), bound = newBound, tcoIdent = Nothing }) resBinding.nextId body
          letStmt =
            if actualGoType == resBinding.exprType then
              StmtLeaf (GoAssign name resBinding.expr)
            else
              StmtLeaf (rawGo ("var " <> name <> " " <> goTypeToStr actualGoType <> " = " <> printGoExpr (coerceGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr resBinding.expr resBinding.exprType actualGoType)))
        in
          { stmts: resBinding.stmts <> StmtLeaf (rawGo ("// TAST (Let): " <> name <> " shape=" <> printTcoExprShape binding <> " bindingType=" <> printExprType (getExprType binding))) <> letStmt <> resBody.stmts, expr: resBody.expr, exprType: resBody.exprType, nextId: resBody.nextId }

recursive :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Int -> TcoExpr -> Level -> NonEmptyArray (Tuple Ident TcoExpr) -> TcoExpr -> ExprResult
recursive translate context@{ metadata, depth, modNameStr, recVars, moduleFunctions } nextId (TcoExpr tcoAnalysis _) lvl bindings body =
  let
    allocated = allocateRecursive context nextId lvl (toArray bindings)
    combinedRecVars = recVars <> map (\(Tuple (Ident i) _) -> sanitizeName i) (toArray bindings)

    isLoop = (unwrap tcoAnalysis).role.isLoop
    mutRecBinds =
      if isLoop then
        traverse (\(Tuple (Ident name) val) -> map (\abs -> { ident: sanitizeName name, args: abs.args, body: abs.body, val }) (extractUncurriedAbs val)) (toArray bindings)
      else Nothing
  in
    case mutRecBinds of
      Just fns ->
        let
          -- Resolve parameters once, then publish every provisional signature
          -- before translating any body. The annotated return is provisional:
          -- bodies refine the function table in source order.
          workers = map
            ( \fn ->
                let
                  oldName = localId (Just (Ident fn.ident)) lvl
                  boundInfo = fromMaybe { name: oldName, goType: TypeValue } (Map.lookup oldName allocated.newBound)
                  newName = boundInfo.name
                  params = LocalWorkers.parameters context fn.args fn.val
                  -- The annotation flattens function-valued results into its
                  -- argument list. Only consume the worker's actual binders:
                  -- a recursive lookup may return a function still to apply.
                  expectedReturn = map (functionResultAfter (Array.length fn.args)) (extractExprFuncType (getExprType fn.val))
                  resultType = case expectedReturn of
                    Just ty -> exprTypeToGoType metadata.sharedRecords metadata.pointerAdtPaths metadata.enumAdts metadata.elidedCtors modNameStr ty
                    Nothing -> TypeValue
                in
                  { oldName, newName, params, expectedReturn, resultType, body: fn.body }
            )
            fns
          published = foldl
            (\acc worker ->
              { functions: Map.insert worker.newName (LocalWorkers.signature context worker.newName worker.params worker.resultType) acc.functions
              -- The local value is the boxed curried wrapper. Saturated calls
              -- obtain the native ABI from the separate function table.
              , bound: Map.insert worker.oldName { name: worker.newName, goType: TypeValue } acc.bound
              })
            { functions: moduleFunctions, bound: allocated.newBound }
            workers

          translatedWorkers = foldl
            ( \acc worker ->
                let
                  { oldName, newName, params } = worker
                  currentLoopCtx = [ { ident: newName, loopParams: map fst (loopParameters params), goTypes: map snd params } ]
                  -- Peer bindings keep the provisional view; only the function
                  -- table sees results inferred for earlier bodies in the group.
                  loopBound = bindParameters params published.bound
                  resBodyMut = translate (context { depth = (depth + 1), recVars = combinedRecVars, moduleFunctions = acc.moduleFunctions, bound = loopBound, tcoIdent = (Just newName), loopCtx = currentLoopCtx, options = { isTail: true, inEffectBlock: false }, mbExpectedExprType = worker.expectedReturn, mbExpectedGoType = Just worker.resultType }) acc.nextId worker.body
                  trueFRet = resBodyMut.exprType
                  keepWrapper = LocalWorkers.needsWrapper oldName (Array.length params) body
                    || Array.any (\(Tuple _ binding) -> LocalWorkers.needsWrapper oldName (Array.length params) binding) (toArray bindings)
                  emitted = LocalWorkers.emit translate (context { bound = published.bound }) newName params keepWrapper (Just worker.body) resBodyMut
                  newFunctions = Map.insert newName (LocalWorkers.signature context newName params trueFRet) acc.moduleFunctions
                  newBound2 = Map.insert oldName { name: newName, goType: TypeValue } acc.newBound
                in
                  { declarations: acc.declarations <> emitted.declarations, stmts: acc.stmts <> emitted.assignments, nextId: resBodyMut.nextId, moduleFunctions: newFunctions, newBound: newBound2 }
            )
            { declarations: [], stmts: [], nextId: allocated.nextId, moduleFunctions: published.functions, newBound: published.bound }
            workers

          resBodyOuter = translate (context { depth = (depth + 1), recVars = combinedRecVars, moduleFunctions = translatedWorkers.moduleFunctions, bound = translatedWorkers.newBound, tcoIdent = Nothing, mbExpectedExprType = Nothing }) translatedWorkers.nextId body
        in
          -- Every function in the recursive group must be in scope
          -- before emitting bodies that can refer to its peers.
          { stmts: foldMap StmtLeaf (translatedWorkers.declarations <> translatedWorkers.stmts) <> resBodyOuter.stmts, expr: resBodyOuter.expr, exprType: resBodyOuter.exprType, nextId: resBodyOuter.nextId }

      Nothing ->
        initializeRecursiveValues translate (context { recVars = combinedRecVars }) isLoop allocated (toArray bindings) body

type RecursiveAllocation =
  { newBound :: LocalEnv
  , newNames :: Array { oldName :: String, newName :: String }
  , nextId :: Int
  }

-- Reserve both local and module-wide identifiers before inspecting the group.
-- Every initializer receives the same complete set of renamed bindings.
allocateRecursive :: ExprContext -> Int -> Level -> Array (Tuple Ident TcoExpr) -> RecursiveAllocation
allocateRecursive { metadata, codegenStateRef, modNameStr, bound } nextId lvl =
  foldl
    (\acc (Tuple ident value) ->
      let
        oldName = localId (Just ident) lvl
        globalId = unsafePerformEffect do
          state <- Ref.read codegenStateRef
          Ref.modify_ (\current -> current { globalId = current.globalId + 1 }) codegenStateRef
          pure state.globalId
        newName = oldName <> "_" <> show acc.nextId <> "_" <> show globalId
        goType = exprTypeToGoType metadata.sharedRecords metadata.pointerAdtPaths metadata.enumAdts metadata.elidedCtors modNameStr (getExprType value)
      in
        { newBound: Map.insert oldName { name: newName, goType } acc.newBound
        , newNames: Array.snoc acc.newNames { oldName, newName }
        , nextId: acc.nextId + 1
        })
    { newBound: bound, newNames: [], nextId }

-- An early read must not observe Go's zero value. Initializers and the closures
-- they create read through cells; publish each pointer only after its complete
-- initializer and coercion. The enclosing body uses the initialized values.
initializeRecursiveValues :: TranslateExpr -> ExprContext -> Boolean -> RecursiveAllocation -> Array (Tuple Ident TcoExpr) -> TcoExpr -> ExprResult
initializeRecursiveValues translate context@{ codegenStateRef, modNameStr, depth } isLoop allocated bindings body =
  let
    initializingBound = foldl
      (\acc name -> Map.update (\binding -> Just (binding { name = "(*" <> name.newName <> "_cell)" })) name.oldName acc)
      allocated.newBound allocated.newNames
    initialized = foldl
      (\acc (Tuple (Tuple _ value) name) ->
        let
          valueResult = translate ((childContext context Nothing) { bound = initializingBound }) acc.nextId value
          expected = (fromMaybe { name: name.newName, goType: TypeValue } (Map.lookup name.oldName allocated.newBound)).goType
          assigned = coerceGoExpr codegenStateRef modNameStr valueResult.expr valueResult.exprType expected
        in
          { stmts: acc.stmts <> valueResult.stmts
              <> StmtLeaf (GoMutate name.newName assigned)
              <> StmtLeaf (GoMutate (name.newName <> "_cell") (rawGo ("&" <> name.newName)))
          , values: Array.snoc acc.values { name: name.newName, goType: expected }
          , nextId: valueResult.nextId
          })
      { stmts: StmtEmpty, values: [], nextId: allocated.nextId }
      (Array.zip bindings allocated.newNames)
    declarations = map (\value -> rawGo ("var " <> value.name <> " " <> goTypeToStr value.goType <> "\n_ = " <> value.name
      <> "\nvar " <> value.name <> "_cell *" <> goTypeToStr value.goType <> "\n_ = " <> value.name <> "_cell"
      <> "\n// FALLBACK TCO: isLoop=" <> show isLoop <> " len=" <> show (Array.length bindings))) initialized.values
    result = translate (context { depth = depth + 1, bound = allocated.newBound, tcoIdent = Nothing }) initialized.nextId body
  in
    { stmts: foldMap StmtLeaf declarations <> initialized.stmts <> result.stmts, expr: result.expr, exprType: result.exprType, nextId: result.nextId }

module Subject (consume) where

import Prelude
import Data.FoldableWithIndex (foldlWithIndex)

consume :: Array Int -> Int
consume values = foldlWithIndex (\index total value -> total + (index + 1) * value) 7 values

-- @dependencies: prelude effect console refs arrays foldable-traversable either exceptions maybe
-- @inline Main.direct never
-- @inline Main.indexed never
-- @inline Main.mapper never
-- @inline Main.factory never
-- @inline Main.withUnknown never
-- @inline Main.withFactory never
-- @inline Main.withBarrier never
-- @inline Main.captured never
-- @inline Main.shared never
-- @inline Main.mayFail never
module Main where

import Prelude
import Data.Array as Array
import Data.Either (Either(..))
import Data.Foldable (for_)
import Data.Maybe (Maybe(..))
import Data.Traversable (traverse)
import Data.TraversableWithIndex (traverseWithIndex)
import Effect (Effect)
import Effect.Console (logShow)
import Effect.Exception (message, throw, try)
import Effect.Ref as Ref
import Effect.Unsafe (unsafePerformEffect)
import Subject as Subject

type Trace = Ref.Ref (Array Int)

direct :: Ref.Ref (Array Int) -> Effect Int
direct reference = do
  values <- Ref.read reference
  pure (case traverse (\value -> Just (value + 1)) values of
    Nothing -> -1
    Just produced -> Subject.consume produced)

indexed :: Ref.Ref (Array Int) -> Effect Int
indexed reference = do
  values <- Ref.read reference
  pure (case traverseWithIndex (\index value -> Just (value + index)) values of
    Nothing -> -1
    Just produced -> Subject.consume produced)

captured :: Int -> Array Int -> Int
captured delta values = case traverse (\value -> Just (value + delta)) values of
  Nothing -> -1
  Just produced -> Subject.consume produced

shared :: Array Int -> Int
shared values = case traverse (\value -> Just (value + 1)) values of
  Nothing -> -1
  Just produced -> Subject.consume produced + Array.length produced

mayFail :: Array Int -> Int
mayFail values = case traverse (\value -> if value == 2 then Nothing else Just (value + 1)) values of
  Nothing -> -1
  Just produced -> Subject.consume produced

mapper :: Trace -> Boolean -> Int -> Maybe Int
mapper trace failing value = unsafePerformEffect do
  Ref.modify_ (\events -> Array.snoc events value) trace
  if failing && value == 2 then throw "mapper failure" else pure (Just (value + 1))

withUnknown :: Trace -> Boolean -> Array Int -> Int
withUnknown trace failing values = case traverse (mapper trace failing) values of
  Nothing -> -1
  Just produced -> Subject.consume produced

factory :: Trace -> Int -> Array Int -> Array Int
factory trace tag values = unsafePerformEffect do
  Ref.modify_ (\events -> Array.snoc events tag) trace
  pure values

withFactory :: Trace -> Array Int -> Int
withFactory trace values = case traverse (\value -> Just (value + 1)) (factory trace 1 values) of
  Nothing -> -1
  Just produced -> Subject.consume produced

withBarrier :: Trace -> Array Int -> Effect Int
withBarrier trace values = do
  let result = traverse (\value -> Just (value + 1)) values
  Ref.modify_ (\events -> Array.snoc events 9) trace
  pure (case result of
    Nothing -> -1
    Just produced -> Subject.consume produced)

main :: Effect Unit
main = do
  for_ [ [], [ 1, 2, 3 ], [ 2147483647, -2147483648, -1, 0 ] ] \input -> do
    reference <- Ref.new input
    a <- direct reference
    b <- indexed reference
    values <- Ref.read reference
    logShow [ a, b, captured 3 values, shared values, mayFail values ]
    Ref.read reference >>= logShow
    logShow (Array.reverse input)
  trace <- Ref.new []
  input <- Ref.new [ 1, 2, 3 ]
  values <- Ref.read input
  logShow (withUnknown trace false values)
  Ref.read trace >>= logShow
  Ref.write [] trace
  failure <- try do
    current <- Ref.read input
    pure (withUnknown trace true current)
  logShow (case failure of
    Left error -> message error
    Right value -> show value)
  Ref.read trace >>= logShow
  Ref.write [] trace
  logShow (withFactory trace values)
  Ref.read trace >>= logShow
  Ref.write [] trace
  empty <- Ref.new []
  current <- Ref.read empty
  logShow (withUnknown trace true current)
  Ref.read trace >>= logShow
  withBarrier trace values >>= logShow
  Ref.read trace >>= logShow

# 🌈 PureScript universal multi-runtime benchmark ## Project goal This project is a **proof of concept** demonstrating the power of abstraction and portability offered by **PureScript**. The goal is to show how the exact same pure functional code (without any manual FFI) can be compiled and executed natively on radically different ecosystems. Backends consume either standard `CoreFn` or, for the local AOT backends, the typed `TAST/tcorefn` representation exported by a local PureScript fork (may be subject to an official PR soon). ## Comprehensive benchmarks The benchmark suite runs a **wide variety** of computationally intensive tasks: AST evaluation, massive list processing, tail call optimization, deep record updates... These tests apply massive **pressure** on the call stack, garbage collector, disk I/O, event loops, and runtime execution engines to measure the raw ability of the compiler and the underlying virtual machine. > [!NOTE] > **Reading the benchmark tables** > > - **Status, only for gopurs, purust, phpurs, sharpurs and javapurs:** **Stable** = measured and considered fully optimized; **WIP** = measured, with optimization work remaining; **Backlog** = planned work without a published measurement or ratio. Status labels belong only to the relevant backend columns. References and external backends have no status. Stable is currently empty, including for Go: the available analyses still identify optimization opportunities. > - **Ratios:** `/C` uses the optimized imperative C reference; `/JS` uses the first JavaScript column. **Below 1× is faster; above 1× is slower.** Extended Results uses its own JS reference and has no C reference. > - **Totals:** sums of the available per-test medians: **Total WIP** for the controlled backends, **Total** for references and external backends. Backlog never contributes. Empty Stable groups are shown as *Coming soon...* and have no defined total, ratio or mean. These totals do not represent an application benchmark. > - **Summaries:** `μ` = arithmetic mean, `Q₂` = median, `G` = geometric mean of the case ratios. Each case has equal weight. All four ratios use exactly the same measured cases on both sides: Go/C and Go/JS both cover all 37 measured Go cases. The full total of a reference table is not used as a denominator for a different set of cases. Very small reference times can produce large ratios. > - **Missing data:** `—` means unavailable or not applicable, never zero. Bounds (`< …`) are excluded from summaries. `n=a/b` indicates coverage: measured cases out of listed cases for a time total, or matched references out of measured cases for a ratio. Historical diagnostic measurements remain in the reference tables; their controlled-backend counterparts belong to unmeasured Backlog. > - **Display precision, in every table:** values ≥ 1 use two decimal places (`12.000045 → 12.00`); positive values < 1 keep two significant digits after leading zeros (`0.000045`, `0.009492 → 0.0095`). Zero is `0.00`. > - **Opaque inputs, in every table:** inputs must remain unknown to the optimizer at runtime. Algebraic simplification is allowed; substituting the driver’s known input is not. > - **Calculations:** use archived timings before display rounding, including for threshold checks. `≈` marks a fallback to published precision. ### Core stresstest benchmark results (pure computational) **Core tests (`src/`)** cover features common to all tested targets (`./bin/run`) #### JavaScript JS Benchmark | Hand-written PureScript
